**Read the last rows of the `Deeper` column as the whole ruling in miniature.** Nine capabilities travel; four of them leave the sheet. The nine that stay share one scrim, one focus trap, one dirty draft and one `Запази`; the four that leave are each a different decision about a different object. **A fifth that wants to be a nested sheet has to answer why it is not the same task** — the fourth already did: `⋯ → Премести на друг ден` re-decides placement in another day's lane and commits it there, which is why it survived Ruling A while the `Ден` picker did not (§3.3.9).

### Promotion and demotion — exact triggers

| From              | To                 | Trigger                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ----------------- | ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| —                 | Fitted             | tap an agenda card · tap a grid block · `Enter` on a focused card                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Fitted            | Full               | **any Regime B touch** — the `Ден` pill, the `Времетраене` menu, a service row, a running-late chip, a duration-bearing add-on, `⋯ → Промени`. Not a mode switch: the sheet un-fits _because a draft opened_, and the thing you touched is already in the draft when it arrives                                           |
| Full              | Fitted             | **on successful save** — the sheet demotes rather than dismisses, so the barber sees the result in context                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Full              | **a pushed page**  | tap a service row, a client row, `Промоция`, `＋ Добави услуга`, `＋ Добави клиент`, `⋯ → Всички промоции`. **If the sheet is resting at `[fitted]`, it promotes to full height first (~180 ms), then pushes** — a page must not be born inside a 300pt window                                                            |
| **a pushed page** | Full               | `‹` · leading-edge swipe · `Esc` · browser Back · **a swipe-down on the child pops to root and does NOT close the sheet** — the sheet's own dismiss gesture is suspended while a child is presented. ⚠ **Do NOT restore the smaller detent on pop:** a sheet that yo-yos per navigation is worse than one that stays tall |
| Any               | dismissed          | ✕ · backdrop · `Esc` · header drag down — all four through the dismiss guard when dirty                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ~~Any~~           | ~~read-only peek~~ | **DELETED.** There is no read-only tier. See below                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

### Appointments that genuinely must not be edited

> **Governing ruling: in this product "read-only" is always a _permission or lifecycle_ state, never a _mode_** — which is exactly how Apple uses it for subscribed calendars, Microsoft for invitations you did not organise (behind a warning dialog, harder to bypass than a mode switch), and Acuity for its `View Only` access level. **And because read-only controls are announced inconsistently and styled not at all, the controls are ABSENT, not disabled.**

The sheet carries `data-locked="settled | partly | cancelled | denied | offline"` — a **reason**, rendered as one footnote, never a tier.

| State                            | What is absent                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | What survives                                                                                                                                                                                           | Footnote                                                                                                                                       |
| -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Completed / no-show**          | the date pill's `aria-expanded` and its whole tap target; `Времетраене`'s menu trigger; **every `›` on every service and client row — the rows stop being `button`s, so no page can be pushed from a settled sheet**; `＋ Добави услуга` / `＋ Добави клиент` / `＋ Добави бележка`; the `Промоция` row's push; the commit control | the same rows as plain read rows, `☎`, `⋯`                                                                                                                                                              | `Часът е приключен — вече не се променя.`                                                                                                      |
| **Partly settled**               | **per row, not per sheet.** The settled seat's row loses its `›` and its removal; the date pill and `Времетраене` are inert for the whole appointment                                                                                                                                                                              | the scheduled seat's row still pushes its page and still edits; per-seat verbs stay                                                                                                                     | `Един от местата вече е приключен — часът не се мести.`                                                                                        |
| **Cancelled**                    | as completed, plus the frame has nothing to draw — a cancelled appointment has released its interval                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | the time range **in the pinned summary strip, struck through**, because _what it was_ is why the sheet was opened; `⋯` collapses to `Дублирай`                                                          | `Часът е отменен — вече не се променя.`                                                                                                        |
| **Permission denied on a write** | nothing. **The sheet always opens; only writes are refused**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | everything, plus a `role="alert"` in the region that earned the refusal                                                                                                                                 | `Нямаш право да променяш този час.`                                                                                                            |
| **Offline**                      | the commit control — replaced by a sentence; the frame's handles and body-drag; the client-search page's search field; the `Промоция` row's push. Everything else renders and the draft still accepts edits                                                                                                                        | the whole ladder; **the service page is fully live**, because editing a draft needs no network                                                                                                          | `Няма връзка. Часът се вижда, но не може да се запази.` + the cache's age                                                                      |
| **Role-gated money**             | for a `barber`: the `Цена` row on the **service page**, and the **ad-hoc discount arm** of the promo page                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | everything else on both pages — including **honouring a grant the client already holds**, which is applying a promise the shop made, not discounting, and which a `barber` may therefore do (comment 3) | none on the service page — an absent control needs no apology; the promo page footnotes `Само рецепция или управител може да добавя отстъпки.` |

**Fresha is the correct precedent for the terminal lock** (_"locking the appointment details from further changes"_), because the lock protects a completed **financial** transaction, not a UI invariant.

### Clean vs. dirty, shown four ways at once

NN/g on mode visibility: _"redundancy in indicators is a wise idea; we strongly recommend at least two visual indicators."_ We use four, all in the lower half of the screen where the thumb and the eye already are.

| Indicator                     | Clean                         | Dirty                                        |
| ----------------------------- | ----------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| The edited block in the frame | `--staff-event-tint` at 15%   | `[data-dirty]` → `--sys-color-accent` at 15% |
| The bar's primary             | the state machine's next verb | `Запази`                                     |
| The bar's leading slot        | `[☎]` `[⋯]`                   | `[⌫]` discard appears                        |
| The notify row above the bar  | absent                        | present, when the change is client-visible   |

**The action bar changing shape _is_ the mode indicator** — and unlike an `Edit` button it is a _consequence_ of what you did, not a _precondition_ of doing it. That is the whole trade.

## 3.3 Anatomy, region by region

Throughout, the namespace is **`staff.visit.*`** — a sibling of `staff.day.*`. Greenfield: the **thirteen** existing `staff.day.visit*` keys **move into it**, the **six** genuine orphans (`visitArrived`, `visitCount`, `visitDuration`, `visitOpen`, `visitService`, `visitWhen` — verified unreferenced by any template) finally bind or are replaced, and `staff.day.act.*` stays where it is because the agenda rows use it too.

⚠ **2026-08-26 (comments 5 + 11): `visitWhen` is now REPLACED, not bound, and it is the second orphan to get that treatment.** With no `Кога` summary row (Ruling A collapsed the region into the `Ден` row's own calendar) and no visible section title (comment 11 deleted all four), **there is nothing left on this surface that renders the word `Кога`.** It goes the same way `visitArrived` already went: a key that survives only because a template once needed it is a key that dies. `staff.visit.when` is deleted from `bg.json` and `en.json`; the date group's `aria-label` is `staff.visit.day`.

**A note on this whole part.** Every primitive, directive input, CSS class, token, icon name and callable below is marked `[exists]` or **`[new]`** at first mention. Nothing here is an inventory of what ships today; roughly a third of it is a build order.

### 3.3.0 · The one recipe, stated once

> **Ruling (owner ask #1, 2026-08-26): every grouped run in this sheet is `ui-list-group` + `ui-list-row`, unmodified. No card. No dividers. No `ui-divider`. The prototype's card-with-hairlines is deleted, not restyled.**

**How to read every box below.** `┌ ┐ └ ┘` are a **`ui-list-group`'s outer corners** at `--control-radius-prominent` — _a card exploded into segments_, never a card. `├────┤` is the **half-unit seam** between two segments; **nothing is drawn on that line.** There is no other box in this sheet, no border, no elevation and no rule anywhere in it.

The recipe, so nobody re-derives it wrong:

| Property                      | Value                                                                                                                                                          | Source                                                                                                                                                   |
| ----------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| The wrapper is **chromeless** | `display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: calc(var(--sys-space-unit) / 2)` — **no fill, no border, no elevation**                                           | [list-group.css:5-9](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-group/list-group.css:5)                                                                         |
| Each row owns its surface     | `background: var(--sys-color-surface-secondary)`                                                                                                               | [list-group.css:33-36](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-group/list-group.css:33)                                                                      |
| Inner corners                 | `--control-radius-subtle`                                                                                                                                      | [list-group.css:36](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-group/list-group.css:36)                                                                         |
| Outer corners                 | `--control-radius-prominent` on the **first** row's top pair and the **last** row's bottom pair — _"a card exploded into segments"_                            | [list-group.css:45-54](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-group/list-group.css:45)                                                                      |
| Press morph                   | a pressed `[data-interactive]` row rounds to the full prominent radius; the state layer follows via `border-radius: inherit`                                   | [list-group.css:60-74](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-group/list-group.css:60)                                                                      |
| Row metrics                   | `min-block-size: var(--control-size-large)`, `padding: var(--sys-space-compact) var(--sys-space-regular)`, `font: var(--sys-font-callout)`, `font-weight: 500` | [list-row.css:2-14](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-row/list-row.css:2)                                                                              |
| The seam **is** the separator | _"NO `ui-divider`s"_ — the component's own contract                                                                                                            | [list-group.ts:24-26](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-group/list-group.ts:24)                                                                        |
| Semantic form                 | `ul[uiListGroup]` > `li[uiListRow]` keeps AT counts real                                                                                                       | [list-group.ts:38](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-group/list-group.ts:38), [list-row.ts:75](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-row/list-row.ts:75) |

⚠ **The `display: contents` gotcha, named so it is never rediscovered.** [list-group.css:26-28](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-group/list-group.css:26) reads `.ui-list-group > :not(.ui-list-row) { display: contents }`. That rule exists so an Angular component host wrapping a row disappears from layout and the row inside it still gets the recipe — and `:first-child` / `:last-child` are then evaluated **on the wrapper**, which is correct. But it has a sharp edge:

- **A non-row child gets no surface, no corners, and no seam.** A disclosure panel, a token editor, a frame — anything that is not a `.ui-list-row` and does not _contain_ one as its direct child — vanishes from the flex layout and paints nothing.
- Therefore: **either the thing is a `ui-list-row`, or it takes `.staff-sheet__disclosure`**, which re-paints the six declarations by hand. There is no third option and no clever selector.
- **If a second surface ever wants that panel, promote it to a `[uiListDisclosure]` slot contract on `ui-list-group`. Not before.**

⚠ **2026-08-26 (second pass): that line is now much more likely to stay unreached — and that is the good outcome, not a missed opportunity.** The panel had three prospective consumers this morning (the `Кога` disclosure, the service token editor, the people token editor). Ruling C sends the two token editors to **pushed pages** and Ruling A collapses `Кога` into the `Ден` row, so `.staff-sheet__disclosure` ends the day with **exactly one consumer: the date calendar.** One consumer is not a slot contract. It is a class.

⚠ **`uiVariant="prominent"` may not be used inside a group.** The component's contract says so in as many words — _"Prominent rows stay STANDALONE … a group is a run of plain rows"_ ([list-group.ts:26-27](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-group/list-group.ts:26)) — and `prominent` fills the row with `--sys-color-primary` ([list-row.css:57-61](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-row/list-row.css:57)). §3.10 previously listed `ui-list-row uiVariant="prominent"` for the money total; **that was a contradiction and it is corrected in R5.**

**One consumer class carries what the recipe cannot**, and after the twelve-comment pass there is exactly one: **`.staff-sheet__disclosure`** **`[new]`** — a panel that is _not_ a row, re-painting surface, subtle corners and row padding by hand so it reads as the segment beneath the one that opened it. Its only consumer is the date calendar of Ruling A, which is precisely why the calendar reads as _part of the run_ rather than as a panel dropped into it: it inherits the half-unit seam and the inner/outer corner treatment for free. The sheet's other own classes — `.staff-sheet__pill` **`[new]`**, `.staff-sheet__figures` **`[new]`**, `.staff-sheet__consequence` **`[new]`** — style content _inside_ rows and pages, and never fight the group. The markup for each region sits in that region below.

⚠ **Deleted 2026-08-26 (Ruling C): `.staff-sheet__tokens`.** It was the second consumer class — _"a row that **is** a token field"_ — and it is gone with the token field itself, taking `.staff-sheet__token-label`, `data-token-kind`, `data-unresolved`, `data-ambiguous` and `data-open` with it (§3.6, §3.10). **The class count is net zero:** three born (`__pill`, `__consequence`, `.staff-frame__owner`), three deleted. That closes Q13.

### R0 · The shell

> **⚠ Amended 2026-08-26, second pass (comments 4 + 11 + Ruling C). The shell changes in three ways and every one of them is a subtraction of machinery.** The large title leaves and the header title becomes **static and always visible**; the pinned `[sheet-accessory]` strip takes over what the title block used to say; and the shell gains a **navigation stack** so the things that used to open a second sheet travel inside this one instead. **We are not inventing this anatomy — the design system already ships it.** See the ruling below the code.

```html
<ui-modal-sheet
  sheetId="staff-visit-sheet"
  labelledBy="staff-visit-title"
  [open]="true"
  [fitted]="tier() === 'peek'"
  [resetScrollOnOpen]="true"
  [titleAlwaysVisible]="depth() === 0"   <!-- root: static. child: collapses -->
  [uiDismissGuard]="guardDismiss"        <!-- NEW directive -->
  [closeLabel]="t('staff.visit.close')"
  (dismissed)="close()">

  <!-- The id moves HERE from the deleted h2. The bar title is
       aria-hidden, but aria-labelledby resolves through it — exactly what
       ui-phone-field's country picker already does. -->
  <span sheet-title id="staff-visit-title">{{ headerTitle() }}</span>

  <!-- NEW slot on ui-modal-sheet. See the ruling below: the component's
       own [uiTrailing] slot is already occupied by its close button. -->
  <button sheet-action uiButton uiMenuTrigger uiButtonStyle="plain"
          uiControlSize="regular" [uiIconOnly]="true"
          [attr.aria-label]="t('staff.day.moreActions')">
    <ui-icon uiName="action.more" />
  </button>

  <!-- ⚠ The slot attribute sits on an ALWAYS-PRESENT wrapper. Content
       inside an @if never matches an ng-content selector — the same
       gotcha ui-phone-field documents at phone-field.html:105. The strip
       is absent on a new appointment, and .modal-sheet__accessory:empty
       collapses it to nothing at zero cost. -->
  <div sheet-accessory>
    @if (summary(); as summary) { … R1 … }
  </div>

  <!-- Ruling C: the page stack lives INSIDE this sheet. One scrim, one
       focus trap, one Запази. Depth is exactly one. -->
  <ui-sheet-nav>                          <!-- NEW pattern component -->
    <ng-template uiSheetPage="root"> … the ladder … </ng-template>
    <ng-template uiSheetPage="service"> … </ng-template>
    <ng-template uiSheetPage="serviceSearch"> … </ng-template>
    <ng-template uiSheetPage="client"> … </ng-template>
    <ng-template uiSheetPage="clientSearch"> … </ng-template>
    <ng-template uiSheetPage="promo"> … </ng-template>
  </ui-sheet-nav>
</ui-modal-sheet>
```

> **Ruling (comment 4): the static header title is pinned visible via `titleAlwaysVisible`, and `labelledBy` re-points at the `[sheet-title]` span. Neither is a new idea — [ui-phone-field's country picker ships this exact anatomy today.](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/phone-field/phone-field.html:88)**

Verified, and it settles four questions at once:

| Question the deletion raises                                                                                                                                                                     | Answer, in the repo                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| With no `uiSheetLargeTitle`, does the header break?                                                                                                                                              | **No — it degrades to the right thing on its own.** `ui-sheet-header` looks for the sentinel and, finding none, _"falls back to collapsing whenever the scroller is scrolled at all (an inline-title bar shows its chrome as soon as content runs underneath it)"_ ([sheet-header.ts:50-54](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/sheet-header/sheet-header.ts:50), [:105-109](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/sheet-header/sheet-header.ts:105)). The sentinel machinery is not worked around; it is simply never registered.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| The compact bar title is `opacity: 0` at rest ([sheet-header.css:83](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/sheet-header/sheet-header.css:83)). How does a _static_ title show?                          | `[titleAlwaysVisible]`, true at depth 0, stamps `data-title-always`, and the shell's own rule — commented **"Inline-title mode … the compact bar title shows from the start"** — sets it opaque ([modal-sheet.css:103-109](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/modal-sheet/modal-sheet.css:103)). **The input we are told to remove is the input that removes the interaction:** pinned on, there is no collapse to get wrong.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `id="staff-visit-title"` was on the `h2` ([staff-dashboard.html:1224](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.html:1224)). Deleting it orphans `labelledBy`. | It moves to the `[sheet-title]` span. The header wraps that span in `aria-hidden="true"` ([modal-sheet.html:49](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/modal-sheet/modal-sheet.html:49)), which does **not** break the name: a node referenced _directly_ by `aria-labelledby` contributes its text regardless. `ui-phone-field` relies on this and says so in its own comment — _"aria-labelledby resolves through the (aria-hidden) bar title"_ ([phone-field.html:102](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/phone-field/phone-field.html:102)).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Ruling C's **pushed pages DO carry a large title.** Does the root header start observing theirs?                                                                                                 | **Yes — and `ui-sheet-nav` must own that, which is one more reason it is a component and not a pile of `@if`s in this feature.** The header re-resolves its sentinel on any subtree change: _"re-resolve the sentinel whenever the scroller's contents change so observation survives the swap"_ ([sheet-header.ts:135-142](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/sheet-header/sheet-header.ts:135)). So a pushed page's `uiSheetLargeTitle` **will** be picked up, and that is the wanted behaviour — a child page is a navigation surface and its title _is_ the object. **Ruling:** `titleAlwaysVisible` is bound to `depth() === 0`, not to a literal `true` — the root's title is static, a child's collapses under its own bar. The root's title is not re-derived on the way back; it never changed. |

**And the scrim comes along for free, which is the detail that would otherwise have been a bug.** `.modal-sheet__accessory` is deliberately transparent — _"the pinned accessory floats TRANSPARENT over the scrolling content (owner ruling: no solid slab under the bar)"_ ([modal-sheet.css:119-127](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/modal-sheet/modal-sheet.css:119)) — so a bare text strip pinned over a scrolling ladder would be unreadable. But `data-title-always` is one of the three selectors that turn the chrome's smootherstep gradient on ([modal-sheet.css:97-101](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/modal-sheet/modal-sheet.css:97)), and that gradient spans the whole chrome group plus a 3rem overhang. **Making the title static lights the scrim that makes the strip legible.** One input, two problems.

> **Ruling (comment 11, at the shell level): `ui-section-header` leaves this surface entirely.** Not restyled, not toned down — removed. It is documented as the **marketing** eyebrow/title/lede trio whose `accent` tone is _"the marketing brand-moment eyebrow"_; putting it inside a form sheet was a category error, not a styling near-miss. Every group's name survives as `[attr.aria-label]` on its `ul[uiListGroup]` and **nothing else**. `ui-list-group` renders `ul` > `li` already, so AT counts stay real and each run is a named list. The owner's instinct is Apple's: Calendar's event editor has **no section headers at all** — the rows label themselves and the seams do the grouping. **A caps eyebrow over a group whose first row already says what it is, is the eyebrow admitting the row failed — and none of these rows failed.**

#### The `⋯` cannot go in `[uiTrailing]`

`ui-sheet-header` does expose a `[uiTrailing]` slot — and `ui-modal-sheet` fills it itself with the close button ([modal-sheet.html:52-64](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/modal-sheet/modal-sheet.html:52)). Consumer content lands in the plain `<ng-content />` in the scroll body ([modal-sheet.html:71](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/modal-sheet/modal-sheet.html:71)); the only other named slots are `[sheet-title]`, `[sheet-accessory]` (a **pinned full-width row under the bar**, [modal-sheet.html:66-68](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/modal-sheet/modal-sheet.html:66)) and `[sheet-overlay]`. **Ruling:** `ui-modal-sheet` gains a **`[sheet-action]`** slot projected into the header's `[uiTrailing]` beside close — a small, well-owned DS change. Putting `⋯` into `[sheet-accessory]` instead would draw a full-width strip under the bar to hold one glyph, and pinning a bar action into the scroll body is not an option at all.

⚠ **2026-08-26: the accessory argument is no longer hypothetical — the slot is now OCCUPIED.** Comment 4 puts the summary strip there (R1), which retires the _"it would draw a full-width strip to hold one glyph"_ objection and replaces it with a harder one: **the slot is spent.** `[sheet-action]` was the right call before the strip existed and it is the only call now.

**Ruling C adds a second, symmetrical DS change: `ui-sheet-header` gains a `[uiLeading]` slot.** It projects `[uiTitle]` and `[uiTrailing]` and nothing else today ([sheet-header.ts:71-72](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/sheet-header/sheet-header.ts:71)), so a pushed page has nowhere to put its `‹`. Same shape of change as `[sheet-action]`, same owner, and the two should land together. **`ui-sheet-nav` is the consumer of both** — a pushed page's bar is _leading `‹` · title · trailing empty_, and the root page's is _leading empty · title · trailing `⋯` + `✕`_. Neither bar is assembled by this feature; the pattern component owns the swap, or every consumer re-derives the focus move, the `inert`, the history entry and the reduced-motion path by hand.

#### Connectivity — the one ruling, applied everywhere

**Ruling: the sheet opens offline, the draft still accepts edits, and the _commit_ refuses up-front. It never queues.**

⚠ **Amended 2026-08-26 (owner ask #5).** The earlier wording — _"opens offline, read-only"_ — described a mode, and there is no mode on this surface. Offline removes exactly two things: **the commit control**, replaced by a sentence, and **the frame's handles**, because a picture with grab points on it lies about what a drag will do. Everything else stays live, because editing a client-side draft needs no network.

Three reasons, in order. First, the cache means the _data_ is genuinely there and genuinely current-as-of-last-sync; refusing to open would hide a phone number from a barber standing next to a landline. Second, every write in this sheet passes through a callable, and a callable offline throws `functions/unavailable` with **no `code` in `details`** — `translateFunctionsError` then falls all the way through to `errors.unknown` = _"Възникна грешка — моля, опитайте отново."_ ([translate-domain-error.ts:44](../../libs/infrastructure/i18n/src/lib/translate-domain-error.ts:44)), which is the exact useless message the barber must never be handed after committing a drag. Third, queuing is the worst of the three: `decideBooking` re-decides placement server-side, so a queued edit is a promise the client is in no position to make.

The mechanism is a **new** `StaffDayStore.online` signal over `navigator.onLine` plus the `online`/`offline` events — genuinely all it needs, because a false negative (online flag true, network dead) still lands on the callable's own refusal.

| Surface                            | Offline                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ---------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Fitted                             | opens; `☎` live (a `tel:` needs no network); every verb and every chip **absent**, not disabled                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Full                               | the whole ladder renders and the draft accepts every edit; **the date calendar still expands** (it is drawn from the loaded week, and its occupancy marks already have a `·` state for not-yet-known); the frame **draws and does not drag** — its handles and the body-drag are absent, not disabled; the action bar shows `staff.visit.offline` = `Няма връзка. Часът се вижда, но не може да се запази.` in place of `Запази` — **the wording refuses, it does not promise a queued save** |
| Услуги / Клиенти (the rows)        | fully live — they edit a draft. **The service page is fully live too**, and this is the point: a pushed page needs no network, so the one region with the most editing in it loses nothing                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| The pushed search pages            | the **add-service** page serves the **cached catalogue** and says so (`Няма връзка — показваме запаметения каталог.`); the **add-client** page's search field is **absent** rather than empty, because client search is a callable (§3.6.5)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| The `Промоция` row                 | shows `Няма връзка` and **does not push** — a page that cannot fetch a grant has nothing to show                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Any nested surface (chair, cancel) | opens on cached data only; the search row is **absent**, not empty                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Zero results                       | never shown offline — the offline line replaces it, because "no results" and "no network" are the two answers a barber must never confuse                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

#### The `⋯` menu

`ui-menu` `[exists]`, `uiPlacement="bottom"` `[exists]`, `uiAlignment="trailing"` `[exists]` ([menu.ts:140-141](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/menu/menu.ts:140)). It carries, in order: `Промени`, every legal status verb not already primary, `Не дойде` **whenever the graph allows it** (the grace gate demotes it out of the dock; it does not remove it — a client who has just phoned to cancel is the commonest early no-show there is), `Същото като миналия път`, **`Смени стола`**, `Премести на друг ден`, `Отдели в собствен час`, **`Всички промоции`**, `Дублирай`, and — last, `uiMenuItemRole="destructive"` `[exists]` — `Превърни в блокирано време`.

**Two items changed weight on 2026-08-26, and both changes are load-bearing rather than cosmetic.**

- **`Смени стола` is promoted from a convenience to the only shop-wide staffing control.** Comments 2 and 7 delete the `Стол` row and take barbers out of the people field, so a visit's staffing is authored **per service** (on that service's page) and reassigned **for the whole visit** here. The split is the menu's own doctrine: `ui-menu` is documented for _"a command, option, or state"_, and **a shop-wide reassignment is a command** — it rewrites every leg's barber in one action. Reassigning **one** leg is a _value_, and a value lives on the row that owns it. R19's one-verdict-per-barber list (`Свободен` / `Зает — Петър 10:30` / `Извън смяната`) is unchanged and now carries more weight than it did this morning.
- **`Всички промоции` is new (comment 3)** — a **read-only** catalogue page pushed from here: code, name, terms, validity, `minSpend`. It is deliberately reachable with **no appointment context**, because the question at the chair is _"is there still a code for a first haircut?"_, and answering it must not require pretending to apply something. ⚠ **It is not a promo state on an appointment and the honesty gate is not weakened:** nothing promo-shaped renders in `ПАРИ` before M8. This page ships in M7 and has nothing to apply and nothing to pretend.

**`Добави човек към този час` is deliberately not in this menu**, and there is no `＋` row anywhere that could stand in for it — on a committed appointment the clients group simply has no `＋ Добави клиент` row. (Amended 2026-08-26: the carrier used to be _"the people field has no caret line"_; the field is gone, the exclusion is not.) See 3.3.9.

### R1 · The header title and the pinned summary strip

> **⚠ REVERSED 2026-08-26 (comment 4). The large-title block is DELETED.** The owner's objection — _"the title is the client's name and the client is editable below, so the title is subject to change"_ — is correct, and it generalises past its own example into a law this document already enforces twice elsewhere.
>
> **Ruling: a static sheet title in the 52pt header bar (`Час`), and the facts the subtitle carried move into a pinned, non-interactive `[sheet-accessory]` summary strip.** The client's name goes down into `КЛИЕНТИ`, where it is edited.

```
║                       ▬▬▬▬▬                              ║  grabber
║   ✕                    Час                        ⋯      ║  52pt · STATIC, always visible
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║  Мартин Илиев · 10:00 – 10:45 · 45 мин   ● Потвърден     ║  [sheet-accessory]
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝  PINNED — never scrolls away
```

Titles: **`Час`** (an existing appointment) · **`Нов час`** (new) · **`Блокирано време`** (a block). _Gloss: `Час` appointment · `Нов час` new appointment · `Блокирано време` blocked time._

#### The defence, in four moves

**1 · Apple's rule for a _sheet_ title is "name the task, not the data."** `New Event`, `Edit Event`, `New Contact`. A title derived from data is what a **navigation** title does — Contacts' detail view — and that surface is _not_ editable in place: you tap `Edit`, and the large title becomes fields. **Ours is always editable (§3.2). It is a form, and it takes a form's title.**

**2 · The objection generalises, and the generalisation is already this document's law.** Any value editable below must not also be the largest text above, because the reader cannot tell whether the big text is a heading or a value. **That is the identical law that deletes the `Стол` row (comment 7) and the barbers-in-two-places duplication (comments 2).** Keeping a live title would make this sheet break its own rule in its most prominent 44 pixels — the one place a reader looks first.

**3 · Nothing is lost at a glance, and something is gained.** This is the move that turns a subtraction into an upgrade: **a large title collapses away on scroll by design** ([sheet-header.ts:40-59](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/sheet-header/sheet-header.ts:40)). The strip is inside `.modal-sheet__chrome`, which is `position: sticky` ([modal-sheet.css:63-64](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/modal-sheet/modal-sheet.css:63)), so `Мартин Илиев · 10:00 – 10:45 · 45 мин` is **still on screen at row 40 of a dirty draft**, which the large title never was. And it updates live _without_ the owner's objection applying to it, because **a pinned metadata strip is self-evidently a summary, not a heading.** The thing that made the title wrong is exactly the thing that makes the strip right.

**4 · It removes machinery.** Four mechanisms leave this sheet and none of them is replaced:

| Leaves                                                                | Because                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `h2 uiSheetLargeTitle` and the **collapse sentinel** it registers     | there is no large title to observe. `ui-sheet-header` finds no `[uisheetlargetitle]` and falls back to inline-title behaviour on its own ([sheet-header.ts:105-109](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/sheet-header/sheet-header.ts:105)) — nothing is worked around                  |
| the `titleAlwaysVisible` **interaction**, at the root                 | it is pinned on at depth 0 (R0). A title that is always visible has no collapse to get wrong, no `IntersectionObserver`, no `rootMargin` arithmetic against the bar height. The collapse survives one level down, on the pushed pages, where a large title is the right primitive |
| _"focus lands on the large title, not the primary CTA"_               | focus lands on the **strip** (`tabindex="-1"`, labelled). The guarantee it protected — **never one blind `Enter` away from a destructive verb** — is discharged identically and more cheaply, because the strip holds no control at all                                           |
| `--sys-font-largeTitle` / `--sys-tracking-largeTitle` on this surface | 800 weight at 2.25rem is for the pushed pages now, where the title _is_ the object you navigated to (Ruling C)                                                                                                                                                                    |

**The two rejected options, named so nobody re-proposes them.** _(b) a live-derived title_ is rejected because it answers the owner by asking him to accept the thing he objected to. _(c) no title at all_ is rejected on two hard grounds: a sheet with no title **has no accessible name**, and — under Ruling C — the header bar's title is **what a pushed page's `‹` returns you to**. Deleting it would leave the back button pointing at nothing.

#### The strip

|                |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Primitives** | `[sheet-accessory]` `[exists]` ([modal-sheet.html:66-68](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/modal-sheet/modal-sheet.html:66)) · `ui-stack` `[exists]` · `[uiText][uiFont="footnote"]` `[exists]` · **`span uiBadge [uiTone]="statusTone(status)" uiProminence="decreased"`** `[exists]` · `.staff-sheet__figures` **`[new]`** for tabular numerals on the time range                                                                                                    |
| **Tokens**     | none new. The strip's inset and rhythm are `.modal-sheet__accessory`'s own `--ui-sheet-inset` + `--sys-space-compact` ([modal-sheet.css:123-128](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/modal-sheet/modal-sheet.css:123))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Copy**       | `staff.visit.summaryStrip` = `{{client}} · {{start}} – {{end}} · {{minutes}} мин` **`[new]`** · `staff.visit.arrivedAt` = `Дойде в {{time}}` **`[new]`** · `⁺¹` glyph when `crossesMidnight` `[exists]`, [staff-dashboard.html:1229](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.html:1229). ⚠ `staff.visit.subtitle` **is deleted** — the strip supersedes it, and the service name it carried is now a row of its own in `УСЛУГИ` |
| **Empty**      | New-entry: title `Нов час` and **no strip at all** — not an empty one, not a placeholder. `.modal-sheet__accessory:empty { display: none }` ([modal-sheet.css:130-132](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/modal-sheet/modal-sheet.css:130)) collapses it for free, so the absence costs nothing and asserts nothing                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Settled**    | `Часът е приключен` states are unchanged in substance: a **cancelled** appointment renders its time range **struck through** in the strip, because _what it was_ is why the sheet was opened (§3.2)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **A11y**       | The strip is the **focus landing** on open: `tabindex="-1"` and `[attr.aria-label]` bound to the same composed sentence, so the screen reader hears _"Мартин Илиев, 10:00 до 10:45, 45 минути, потвърден"_ rather than four fragments. The badge carries the tone as `data-tone` **and** the label as text — colour is never alone. The `⁺¹` is `aria-hidden` and the accessible name spells it out                                                                 |

⚠ **The one gotcha that will otherwise cost an afternoon: the `sheet-accessory` attribute must sit on an ALWAYS-PRESENT wrapper.** Content inside an `@if` never matches an `ng-content` selector, so `@if (summary()) { <div sheet-accessory>…</div> }` projects **nothing, silently, forever**. The `@if` goes _inside_ the wrapper. This is not a theory — `ui-phone-field` hit it and left the warning in its own template: _"The slot attribute sits on an ALWAYS-PRESENT wrapper: content inside an @if block never matches an ng-content selector"_ ([phone-field.html:105-107](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/phone-field/phone-field.html:105)).

**And the whole anatomy already ships, which is the strongest argument for it.** `ui-phone-field`'s country picker is _static bar title + pinned accessory_, wired exactly this way — `[titleAlwaysVisible]="true"`, `[labelledBy]="sheetTitleId"`, `<span sheet-title [id]="sheetTitleId">`, `<div sheet-accessory>` — and its own comment calls it the **"inline-title utility-picker anatomy"** ([phone-field.html:88-107](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/phone-field/phone-field.html:88)). Comment 4 does not ask us to invent a header. It asks us to stop being the one sheet that does not use the one we have.

**Why `ui-badge` and not `ui-status-indicator`.** `UiStatusIndicatorTone` is `'success' | 'warning' | 'destructive'` and nothing else ([status-indicator.ts:8](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/status-indicator/status-indicator.ts:8)); the component takes exactly one input, `uiTone`. It _does_ carry a `[uiDetail]` projection slot ([status-indicator.ts:23-25](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/status-indicator/status-indicator.ts:23)), so the shape would fit the arrival stamp — what does not fit is the tone union. `statusTone()` already returns a `UiBadgeTone` and already returns `'neutral'` for both `confirmed` and `completed` ([staff-dashboard.ts:325-331](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.ts:325)). Wiring the status indicator here would be a type error on the two commonest statuses in the shop, and fixing it would mean widening a DS union to serve one call site. **The badge already ships in this exact sheet** ([staff-dashboard.html:1284](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.html:1284)). Reuse it, and put the arrival stamp beside it as text, where a detail belongs. The 2026-08-26 move from a title block to a pinned strip does not disturb this: **the badge is the same component in the same sheet at a different altitude**, and the tone-union argument is a type argument, not a layout one.

**Three facts already on the VM finally surface in this sheet**: `durationMinutes`, `arrived` and `rebooked` ([staff-dashboard.ts:130](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.ts:130), [:184](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.ts:184), [:167](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.ts:167)). **Not five.** `priceLabel` is already rendered on the agenda card behind the `price` field toggle ([staff-dashboard.html:997-1004](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.html:997)) and `email` behind the `email` toggle ([staff-dashboard.html:877-886](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.html:877)). The sheet shows them unconditionally, which is a change in _reliability_, not a first appearance — and the document must not claim the barber is seeing a price for the first time. ⚠ **2026-08-26: only `durationMinutes` and `arrived` land in R1.** The strip carries the client, the range, the minutes and the status; **the price left it with the subtitle** and is now `В салона` in `ПАРИ` (R5), where a derivation belongs. `rebooked` lands on the client row (§3.6).

**The arrival stamp needs one new VM field.** `Appointment.arrivedAt` is a real, persisted `ZonedDateTime` ([appointment.ts:162](../../libs/domain/scheduling/src/lib/appointment.ts:162)), round-tripped through the repository ([appointment-repository.adapter.ts:225](../../libs/infrastructure/firestore/src/lib/appointment-repository.adapter.ts:225)) — and the mapper flattens it to a boolean and throws the instant away ([staff-dashboard.ts:2253](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.ts:2253)). `DayRowVm.arrivedAtLabel: string | null` **`[new]`** restores it from data that is already on the wire, and it renders **in the strip**, after the badge. The orphan `staff.day.visitArrived` is the bare word `Дойде` and is **replaced**, not bound — a stamp without a time is the fact the boolean already carried. (It is the first of two orphans to get that treatment; `visitWhen` is the second — see §3.3's opening note.)

### R2 · `Ден`, the frame, the typed clock — in that order

> **⚠ Third pass, 2026-08-27 (owner comments on the rebuilt frame).** Five corrections to the pass below, which is itself a correction of the pass below that. Each is named where it stood.
>
> | Was                                                                                           | Now                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
> | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
> | The window is the roster ± an hour                                                            | **The whole CIVIL day, 00:00–24:00.** A constant. It can never disagree with the roster, has no fallback to get wrong, and nothing can fall outside it — which matters because the grid _drops_ what falls outside the window. The shift is drawn inside it as shaded closed hours: the shop's day is a region _of_ the day, not the whole of what exists.                                                                                                                                                                              |
> | The date navigator is a `ui-list-group` row sitting above the frame                           | **The frame's own head**, inside its box: one border, one radius, a hairline between head and picture, `gap: 0`. A list-group row above the frame read as a separate card floating over it. The month drops out of the head _over_ the picture, not beside it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
> | Three steppers a `tight` gap apart                                                            | **Touching** (`gap: 0`), leading, each still clearing 44px of hit area. Ink small, target not.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
> | The date pill hugs its own text, `ср, 26.08`                                                  | **Fills the head's remaining width**, and says `ср, 26 август`. ⚠ Bulgarian renders `month: 'short'` NUMERICALLY — the pill promised a month name and printed a number. `long` is the shortest form that is a word in both languages; `weekday: 'short'` was already the three-letter form.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
> | The pinned summary strip carries the name, `⋯` and `✕`; the sheet's title bar is `bareHeader` | **Reversed.** The sheet states its name like every other sheet on this page: a large title in the content (`uiSheetLargeTitle`) that collapses into the bar, plus the shell's own close button. The strip is deleted. It duplicated the bar's job, carried a _second_ dismiss, and — projected as one element — could never reach the `sheet-accessory` slot, so the `✕` it held scrolled away with the content. The `⋯` moved to the dock, where the verbs it belongs to already live; `‹` moved onto the pushed page it returns from. |
>
> **Consequence worth stating:** the sheet's `✕` now closes from _any_ depth rather than popping a pushed page. The rule it used to discharge — _back is not intended to dismiss a sheet_ — is discharged by the page's own `‹` instead, so a child is never left with the dismiss as its only exit.

> **⚠ Reversed AGAIN, later on 2026-08-26 (owner comments on the built sheet).** Four more changes, and the region's own name is now wrong: `Ден` is not a rung any more.
>
> | Was                                                                                                        | Now                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
> | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
> | The ladder opens on `Ден`                                                                                  | **Reversed.** It opens on the **PARTICIPANTS** — barbers, then clients, in two groups modelled identically. _"barber and client details should be topmost."_ Who is doing this and for whom is the first question a sheet about an appointment answers.                                         |
> | The date navigator is its own rung above the frame                                                         | **Reversed.** It is the frame's **HEADER**, inside `section.staff-frame`, sitting directly on the picture it navigates — Outlook's calendar bar belongs to the grid beneath it. The inline `ui-calendar-grid` moves with it and still expands as a sibling segment of the same run.             |
> | `header.staff-frame__owner` — the chair's avatar, tone swatch and name, between the date row and the frame | **Deleted.** _"day nav should be as a header of the frame not the barber with his avatar."_ It named a barber the participants group now names properly, and it put a PERSON between a date and the day that date draws. The chair survives in `frameSummary()` for screen readers.             |
> | The frame draws a **100-minute window** centred on the appointment                                         | **Reversed.** It draws the **whole working day** — the roster unioned with the visit, an hour of margin either side — and the grid **centres it on the edited block once, on open**. _"the selected event should be centered! and also whole day should be visible not only small time frame."_ |
>
> **The window is SCROLLED, never compressed, and that is load-bearing.** `--staff-frame-minute` stays at 2.4px, so the box still shows about a hundred minutes at a time and a 30-minute block is still 72px tall to grab. Fitting ten hours into the 240px box would put the five-minute grain at a third of a pixel, which is the one thing the 5-minute ruling (§3.4) cannot survive. What changed is what is IN the frame, not how big a minute is — and it is what makes the afternoon reachable at all: the grid _drops_ what falls outside the window, so before this the shop's afternoon was not merely off-screen, it was not in the frame and could not be dragged into.
>
> **Centring is once per appointment, never per draft.** The grid latches on `uiEditableEventId`; a drag never changes an appointment's id. Re-centring on anything the draft touches re-centres on every snap — the block moves in pixels under a finger that has not moved, the pointer handler reads a different minute from the same position and publishes again. That is the same feedback loop `frameWindow` already carries a warning about, and it pins a CPU.
>
> **Two consequences worth stating.** The frame now draws the day's OTHER visits (they were being dropped for falling outside the 100 minutes), which is what makes "who is before and after" answerable without leaving the sheet. And `frameVerdict`'s `outsideRoster` warning is only reachable because of the hour of margin: a window clipped exactly to the shift is a wall, not a warning.

> **⚠ Reversed 2026-08-26 (owner comments 5, 8, 9, 11).** Four things this region used to be are now false. Each is named where it stood, because a silent deletion is how a document starts lying to the next reader.

> | Was                                                                        | Now                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

The occlusion argument that put them first left the building with `До`.                                                                                  |

> **What survives verbatim, and is not up for renegotiation:** the frame and the typed path are on screen together, always — no toggle, no preference, no default (owner asks #3 + #4, 2026-08-26) — and the time is **editable in exactly one place per fact**. The `[ ▤ ] [ ⌨ ]` segmented switch and the per-device `timeEditor` preference stay dead. There is no `±` nudge pair anywhere on this surface: **the event body drags** (§3.4.9, §3.4.5).

_Gloss: `Ден` day · `вт, 26 авг` Tue, 26 Aug · `отваря` opens · `подготовка` setup · `разчистване` cleanup · `Начало` start · `Времетраене` duration · `до` until · `Промяната на времето не променя цената.` changing the time does not change the price._

Two `ui-list-group`s and one frame between them. No card, no divider, and nothing at either edge of any row.

```html

  @if (dayOpen()) {
  <div id="staff-visit-day" class="staff-sheet__disclosure">
    … the calendar …
  </div>
  }
</ul>

<!-- 2 · THE FRAME. Outside every group: it is not a row and never was. §3.4 -->

        (comment 11) and both rows name themselves, so a group label would

<ul uiListGroup>

    {{ t('staff.visit.start') }}
```

⚠ **`ui-menu` may never be a direct child of a `ui-list-group`, and the reason is a specificity collision nobody would find twice.** `.ui-list-group > :not(.ui-list-row) { display: contents }` ([list-group.css:26-28](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-group/list-group.css:26)) scores 0,2,0 and outranks `.ui-menu { position: relative; display: inline-flex }` ([menu.css:5-8](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/menu/menu.css:5)) at 0,1,0. A `display: contents` element **generates no box and is therefore not a containing block**, so `.ui-menu__surface`'s `position: absolute` ([menu.css:15-17](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/menu/menu.css:15)) would resolve against whatever positioned ancestor happens to be further up — the sheet — and the menu would open somewhere else entirely, **on this surface only.** So the menu lives **inside the row's `[uiTrailing]` slot**, where the flattening rule cannot reach it (it matches direct children only), and its anchor is the trailing pill. That also makes `Времетраене` structurally identical to `Ден`: _the trailing pill is the trigger_, in both rows, which is why the glyph is the same `⌄`.

**`.staff-sheet__pill` `[new]`** — the one shape both triggers wear. Six declarations and **zero new tokens**: `--sys-color-accent` at 12% as the fill ([theme-light.css:24](../../libs/ui/tokens/theme-light.css:24)), `--sys-color-accent-label` as the ink — _not_ `--sys-color-accent`, whose own token comment records it measuring **3.04:1 on the page** as type and failing the 4.5:1 floor ([theme-light.css:26-33](../../libs/ui/tokens/theme-light.css:26)) — `--control-radius-capsule` ([tokens.css:101](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:101)), a `--control-size-small` (36px at density 1, [tokens.css:66](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:66)) block floor inside the 44px row, inline padding, and the row's own `[data-interactive]` press grammar. It is **not** `ui-chip`: `button[uiChip]`'s whole API is `uiSelected` + `uiControlSize` ([chip.ts:27-28](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/chip/chip.ts:27)) and `uiSelected` binds `aria-pressed` on the host — this is a disclosure trigger for a form value, not a toggle button, and bending a two-input component into a third meaning is how a design system stops being one.

`[uiLeading]` / `[uiTrailing]` are the row's real projection slots ([list-row.ts:77-79](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-row/list-row.ts:77)); `uiSize`, `uiAlignment`, `uiVariant`, `uiInteractive`, `uiSelected` are its **whole** API ([list-row.ts:97-104](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-row/list-row.ts:97)) — `uiSize="regular"` is what makes these 44px rows rather than 52px ones ([list-row.css:16-18](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-row/list-row.css:16)), and `uiAlignment` is cross-axis placement, not text centring.

**`[uiTabularNumerals]` does not exist.** Neither does any tabular-numerals modifier in the DS. Every clock and money figure in this sheet takes **`.staff-sheet__figures { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums }`** **`[new]`** — the same property `formatMoney`'s own docblock says the app's prices are styled for ([format-money.ts:10-16](../../libs/domain/kernel/src/lib/format-money.ts:10)). Promoting it to a `[uiTabularNumerals]` modifier is a reasonable DS follow-up and is **not** a dependency of this work.

**Icon registry.** `action.add` = `add` `[exists]` ([icon-registry.ts:126](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/icon/icon-registry.ts:126)); `field.expand` = `arrow_drop_down` `[exists]` ([icon-registry.ts:118](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/icon/icon-registry.ts:118)) draws **both** pills' `⌄`; `nav.disclosure` = `chevron_right` `[exists]` ([icon-registry.ts:106](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/icon/icon-registry.ts:106)) no longer appears anywhere in this region — the `Ден` row lost its `›` with the nested sheet. `frame.handleStart` / `frame.handleEnd` are **`[new]`** and map to `keyboard_arrow_up` / `keyboard_arrow_down`. **`action.remove` → `remove` is withdrawn**: it existed only to draw the `−` of the deleted nudge pair.
