The frame does **not** collapse while the calendar is open. Nothing in this sheet collapses anything else any more: the region-wide disclosure was the only mechanic that did, and it is gone. Opening the calendar pushes the frame down the scroll view, which is what a scroll view is for.

#### Five rulings, re-pointed

**1 · Each fact is editable in exactly one place.** The old formulation — _"the summary row carries the time only while the disclosure is CLOSED"_ — was a mechanic invented to keep one number from appearing twice. With no summary row there is nothing to suppress: the frame draws the block, `Начало` states the one authored instant, `Времетраене` states the span and annotates the end it yields. The pinned `[sheet-accessory]` strip (comment 4) does render `10:00 – 10:45 · 45 мин` — and that is not a violation, because **the rule was always about editors, not about chrome.** Two places you can _change_ the same number is the defect; a pinned, non-interactive summary of the whole sheet changes nothing and is the reason the strip beat a large title.

**2 · The order is `Ден` → frame → `Начало`/`Времетраене`** — reversed from _"the fields sit ABOVE the frame"_ on 2026-08-26 (comment 9). The three reasons that produced the old order are each answered rather than waved through:

| Original reason                                                                            | Status                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Causality** — read the numbers, then a picture of them                                   | **Re-pointed, not broken.** The frame is now where you _place_ the appointment by dragging, and `Начало` is its typed twin sitting immediately beneath it. The read is _which day → where in the day → how long_: cause and effect are adjacent in both directions. |
| **Occlusion** — a focused `<input type="time">` raises the keypad and would hide the frame | **Dissolved by Ruling B.** There is no keypad-raising field left in this region. `Начало` raises the _platform time picker_ — a wheel on iOS, a dial on Android — dismissed in place; `Времетраене` is a menu. The keypad problem left with `До`.                   |
| **Tab order / WCAG 2.5.7** — the no-drag path must come first                              | **Still conformant.** SC 2.5.7 requires the single-pointer alternative to _exist_, not to _precede_. See ruling 3.                                                                                                                                                  |

**3 · The typed rows are the WCAG 2.5.7 compliance argument for the body-drag, and this must never be forgotten.** SC 2.5.7 Dragging Movements (AA): _"All functionality that uses a dragging movement for operation can be achieved by a single pointer without dragging, unless dragging is essential."_ **Owner ask #4 on its own fails 2.5.7. Ask #3 is what rescues it.** Therefore, verbatim and undiminished by the reorder: **`Начало` and `Времетраене` may never be hidden behind a disclosure, a preference, a toggle, or a width breakpoint.** Any future proposal to collapse them is a conformance regression and is refused on that ground alone. Only their position on the page moved; the clause did not. (The frame's own handles are independently `role="slider"` and arrow-key operable — §3.4.8 — so the drag has a keyboard path as well as a no-drag path.)

**4 · One source of truth, and it is now ONE authored signal fewer.** `draftStartMinute` and `draftDurationMinutes` are authored; **`draftEndMinute` is a `computed()` and is not writable anywhere** (Ruling B). **The frame writes on snap. The rows write on `change` / on select. Both READ the same signals. Neither reads the other's DOM.** There is no synchroniser because there is nothing to synchronise — and _"I moved the start and the end didn't follow"_ is now unrepresentable rather than tested for.

**5 · Focus owns the value.** While `Начало` has focus its text is the barber's, not the signal's: the signal only changes on `change`, so no keystroke twitches the block. A `pointerdown` anywhere in the frame **commits the focused field's current text and blurs it** before the gesture begins, so a drag can never fight a caret. Unfocused, it re-renders live from the signals during a drag — and `Времетраене`'s trailing value re-renders live too, so watching `45 мин · до 10:45` count as you pull the end handle is the whole payoff of showing both editors at once.

#### The height budget, stated so nobody discovers it in review

| Piece                                   | compact 0.92 | regular 1.0 | spacious 1.08 |
| --------------------------------------- | -----------: | ----------: | ------------: |
| `Ден` row (`--control-size-regular`)    |         40.5 |        44.0 |          47.5 |
| Group gutter (`--sys-space-regular`) ×2 |         29.4 |        32.0 |          34.6 |
| Frame owner header (§3.4.2)             |         47.8 |        52.0 |          56.2 |
| Frame (`--staff-frame-height`)          |        220.8 |       240.0 |         259.2 |
| `Начало` row + seam + `Времетраене` row |         82.8 |        90.0 |          97.2 |
| Decoupling footnote (conditional, once) |          ~18 |         ~20 |           ~22 |
| **Region total, calendar closed**       |     **~439** |    **~478** |      **~517** |
| _The calendar, while open_              |   _~360–400_ |  _~390–440_ |    _~420–475_ |

Two numbers deserve to be argued with rather than skimmed.

**The region grew by ~34px at density 1** (from ~444), and the growth is the frame's owner header (comments 2 + 7 moved the barber's identity onto the picture) plus a second typed row where there used to be one field row. **What pays for it is the deleted large-title block** (comment 4), which this region does not control — so if R1's replacement header + accessory strip comes in taller than the block it replaced, this table is where the overrun shows up. Nothing else in the sheet is load-bearing on that arithmetic.

**The open calendar is ~390–440px at density 1**, and that number is the whole of Ruling A. `ui-calendar-grid[data-size='regular']` caps at `7 × --control-size-regular + 6 × --sys-space-tight` = **332px at density 1** ([calendar-grid.css:63-65](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/calendar-grid/calendar-grid.css:63)) with square cells ([calendar-grid.css:68-76](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/calendar-grid/calendar-grid.css:68)), so a month is 5 or 6 rows of 44px plus a relative-chip row, a month header, the weekday key and the occupancy footnote. **A grid that size cannot be always-open**: it is more than a phone viewport of this sheet, spent permanently to serve a minority edit, and it would push the frame, the services, the clients and the money below the fold on **every** open. It costs one 36px pill at rest instead, and that is the trade Ruling A is buying.

On a 375×812 phone this region ends above the fold with the first service row showing beneath it — **and that is the whole argument for the frame's 100-minute window rather than a taller one.** A frame one row taller would push the services group off the first screen, and the barber would learn that this sheet always needs a scroll.

#### The frame's arithmetic, at all three densities

`--sys-space-unit: calc(0.25rem * var(--sys-density))` ([tokens.css:50-51](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:50)) and `[data-density]` sets **0.92 / 1 / 1.08** ([tokens.css:231-236](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:231)). Nothing in this app has one pixel size. Both frame tokens are **`[new]`**:

```css
--staff-frame-minute: calc(var(--sys-space-unit) * 9 / 15); /* NEW */
--staff-frame-height: calc(var(--sys-space-unit) * 60); /* NEW */
```

|                                |   compact (0.92) |    default (1.0) |  spacious (1.08) |
| ------------------------------ | ---------------: | ---------------: | ---------------: |
| `--sys-space-unit` (16px root) |           3.68px |           4.00px |           4.32px |
| Frame height                   |      **220.8px** |        **240px** |      **259.2px** |
| Minute height                  | **2.208 px/min** | **2.400 px/min** | **2.592 px/min** |
| 15-minute slot                 |           33.1px |           36.0px |           38.9px |
| **Window**                     |      **100 min** |      **100 min** |      **100 min** |

**The window is density-invariant, and that is the point of deriving both numbers from the same unit.** Compact does not show the barber a different hour; it shows him the same hundred minutes, smaller. A hand-tuned `240px` beside a hand-tuned `2.4px` would have broken that on the first density change and nobody would have noticed until a shop switched.

The frame is a _close-up_ and must read as one: the day grid runs `--staff-slot-height: calc(var(--sys-space-unit) * 7)` ([staff-time-grid.css:19](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/time-grid/staff-time-grid.css:19)) = 1.717–2.016 px/min. At `* 9` the frame is **1.286× denser** than the grid it zooms into — enough to be a different instrument, close enough that the eye carries proportion across. (§3.10 proposes refactoring the _grid's_ row to `calc(var(--staff-minute-height) * 15)` with `--staff-minute-height: calc(var(--sys-space-unit) * 7 / 15)`, preserving the 28px slot byte-for-byte. That token is **`[new]`** too and is a separate change from this one.)

#### The handles

Drawn at `calc(var(--sys-space-unit) * 10)` × `calc(var(--sys-space-unit) * 5)` — **36.8×18.4 / 40×20 / 43.2×21.6**.

**Ruling: the drawing scales with density; the touch target does not.** A handle's hit slop is `min-block-size: max(44px, var(--control-size-regular))` and the same on the inline axis — an **absolute** 44px floor. `--control-size-regular` is `calc(var(--sys-space-unit) * 11)` ([tokens.css:75](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:75)) = **40.5 / 44 / 47.5px**, so a shop on compact density would otherwise ship a 40.5px drag target on a gesture that resizes someone's afternoon. Density is a reading preference. HIG's 44 is a finger, and fingers do not have a density setting.

That floor sets the collapse threshold, and it must be derived at **0.92**, the worst case: two 44px targets need 88px of block height, and at 2.208 px/min that is **39.9 → 40 minutes**. (At 1.0 it is 36.7; at 1.08, 33.9. Quoting 37 would ship a broken control to every compact shop.)

**Below 40 minutes the handles shrink in place**, by the single formula §3.4.4 derives — `hitHeight = min(44, blockHeight / 2 + 22)` — so the two never overlap at the block's centre, and **the typed rows are the guaranteed path below the threshold** (ruling 3 above — they are never hidden, at any size). They do **not** relocate to the gutter. **88px of block is also the body-drag's suppression floor** — the same number, deliberately reused rather than re-invented: below it the handles own the whole block and moving is `Начало` typed, which **holds the duration and slides the whole block** (§3.4.9, Ruling B).

#### What replaces the >180-minute override

The old ruling — _"above three hours the frame is not the editor; the sheet opens on the typed clock instead"_ — had no content once the clock is always present, and it is deleted along with the preference it read. Its useful half survives, re-cut:

> **Ruling: above 180 minutes the frame opens anchored to the START edge and the body-drag is suppressed.** The handles stay live and the jump carets do the travel. A move whose destination is two windows away cannot be aimed, and offering the gesture anyway would be a control that only works by accident. `Премести на друг ден` and the typed `Начало` (which holds `Времетраене` and slides the block) remain the paths.

#### `.staff-sheet__time-field` — the rename survives; this sheet is no longer a consumer

> **⚠ Amended 2026-08-26 (Ruling B, owner comment 8).** This section used to be titled _"unchanged, and now unconditional"_ — the `От`/`До` pair being always rendered was the whole of it. **The pair is deleted from the appointment sheet.** What was going to be one class with two consumers is one class with one.

**The rename still happens, and it is still not a copy.** `.staff-block__field` already exists ([staff-dashboard.css:934-937](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.css:934)) and already wraps exactly this — a labelled `input[uiTextField] type="time" step="300"` with `flex: 1 1 0; min-inline-size: 0` so the pair splits the row instead of hugging leading ([staff-dashboard.html:1459-1484](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.html:1459)). **Ruling: rename it `.staff-sheet__time-field` anyway**, in the same pass as `.staff-cancel__body` → `.staff-sheet__body` ([staff-dashboard.css:924](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.css:924)), which the visit sheet is already borrowing under the wrong name today ([staff-dashboard.html:1222](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.html:1222)). `__block` / `__cancel` / `__visit` were never three components; they were one sheet body wearing three names, and the rename is what stops a fourth.

**Its one consumer is the block sheet, and that is a ruling, not an accident.** A block has no catalogue, no services, no derivable length, and **two edges the barber genuinely holds in his head** — _"I'm out from two to four."_ `От`/`До` asks him for the fact he knows. An appointment's length is a function of its services, so it asks for `Начало` + `Времетраене` and derives the end (Ruling B, §3.5). The rule is not _"duration everywhere"_; it is **ask for the fact the user knows**. **Say this out loud in the ADR, or somebody will "harmonise" the two sheets and break the good one.**

**What the appointment sheet uses instead** is `.staff-sheet__pill` — a trailing capsule, not a labelled field that splits a row — wrapping the same `input[uiTextField] type="time" step="300"`. `input[uiTextField]` takes two inputs, `uiControlSize` and `uiInvalid` ([text-field.ts:27-28](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/text-field/text-field.ts:27)) — there is no `ui-text-field` component and no `[uiCombobox]` anywhere in this repo.

**What is deleted along with the pair:** its `ui-stack uiAxis="horizontal"`, `draftEndValue`, `endMinAttr` / `endMaxAttr`, `endInvalid`, and the `commitTyped('end', …)` arm. **`draftEndMinute` becomes a `computed()` and is writable nowhere** — which is what makes the whole desync class unrepresentable rather than tested for. There is still no `openEditor()` signal, no `data-editor` attribute, no `staff.visit.timeEditor` key in `localStorage`, and no migration to write. What survives from §3.5 verbatim: `min`/`max` as native attributes (on `Начало` alone now), `change` and never `input`, and `1030` / `10.30` / `10 30` normalised on `beforeinput`. **Duration carry-over survives as an invariant rather than as a rule** — there is nothing left to carry, because the duration is the thing that is stored.

#### Press feedback on the frame

**Every interactive surface introduced in this part carries an ungated `:active` mirror, and every hover treatment is `@media (hover: hover)`-gated.** This is not advice; it is how the DS already works — `button.css:240-245` restates the entire hover tint ladder on `:active` with no media gate, for the stated reason that _"touch devices never satisfy `(hover: hover)`, so without this a tap shows only the press-scale transform and never the fill: the button looks inert until release"_ ([button.css:236-245](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/button/button.css:236)), and `[data-interactive]`'s hover layer is gated at [modifiers.css:227](../../libs/ui/modifiers/modifiers.css:227).

`data-dragging` and `data-moving` are **not** press states — they fire after the gesture is recognised, which on a slop-tolerant handle is 60–120ms of nothing and on the body-drag is a quarter of a second. The two frame handles, **the block body**, every `ui-list-row` in every group, **both `.staff-sheet__pill` triggers (`Ден` and `Времетраене`)**, every `button[uiDay]` in the inline calendar — `uiInteractive` is the grid's own stated contract for exactly this, _"never a bespoke hover"_ ([calendar-grid.ts:27-30](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/calendar-grid/calendar-grid.ts:27)) — every `uiMenuItem` in the duration menu, the relative-date chips, every pushed page's rows (§3.6), the add-on chips and the running-late chips each get their `:active` fill in the same rule that defines their hover, un-gated.

### R3 · `УСЛУГИ`

> **⚠ REVERSED 2026-08-26 (owner comments 1 + 10, Ruling C). The token field is deleted, and the inline editor under it is deleted with it.** This region used to rule: _"services are a TOKEN FIELD, not a picker. You type, matches appear, a choice becomes a token, a token is removed inline, and a token **opens in place** to override its price, its duration and its barber."_ **Every clause of that is withdrawn** — quoted here rather than deleted, because a silent deletion is how a document starts lying to the next reader.
>
> **Ruling: a service is a two-line `button[uiListRow]` carrying `›`, and it PUSHES a page inside this sheet's own navigation stack — depth exactly one, one path, no second commit.** Adding one pushes a search page with checkbox multi-select. The nested multi-select picker sheet stays dead and the leg sheet stays dead; what replaces them is **navigation**, which every platform solved decades ago. Full anatomy, both pushed pages, every state and the a11y contract: **§3.6**.
>
> | Was                                                                                     | Now                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
> | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
> | A `УСЛУГИ` eyebrow over the group                                                       | **Deleted** (comment 11). The run's name survives as `aria-label` on the `ul[uiListGroup]` and nowhere else; the last row reads `＋ Добави услуга`, which is the group labelling itself.                                                     |
> | `span[uiToken]` inside a `.staff-sheet__tokens` row with `role="grid"`                  | **Deleted**, along with `.staff-sheet__token-label`, the per-token `✕` and `⌄`, `data-token-kind`, `data-unresolved`, `data-ambiguous` and `data-open` (§3.3.0, §3.10).                                                                      |
> | The caret line — `▏Търси услуга…` as the field's always-last line                       | **Deleted.** `staff.visit.searchServices` re-homes as the **pushed search page's** field placeholder (§3.6.4).                                                                                                                               |
> | The opened token's `.staff-sheet__disclosure` editor, folded into the draft by `Готово` | **Deleted, both halves.** The editor is a pushed page (§3.6.3), and there is **one commit boundary for the whole modal task**: no `Готово`, no `Приложи`, no `Отказ` on a child. `staff.visit.done` is deleted from `bg.json` and `en.json`. |
> | `[uiCombobox]` and the APG grid-combobox popup                                          | **Cancelled as staff-sheet dependencies** (§3.6.7). `ui-token` is still worth building — **for `/book`** — and it leaves M6 for the `/book` backlog.                                                                                         |
>
> ⚠ **This reversal does not touch Ruling A, and the law is one sentence:** _a **value** with a spatial editor of its own expands in place; a **row that owns several values** pushes a page._ The date is one value and a calendar is its picture, so it expands (R2, §3.5 › `Ден`). A service is three values plus a destructive verb, so it travels. Apple splits its own event editor on exactly that line — Starts expands, Travel Time pushes — and §3.6.1 defends it at length. **`⌄` and `›` are not two styles of one idea; they are the two halves of this law.**

```
║  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  ║
║  │ Класическо подстригване                            │  ║  52 · two lines
║  │ 30 мин · 20,00 €                               ›   │  ║  → pushes a page
║  ├──────────── half-unit seam ────────────────────────┤  ║
║  │ Оформяне на брада                                  │  ║
║  │ 15 мин · 8,00 € · Нико                         ›   │  ║  barber named ONLY
║  ├────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤  ║  when it differs
║  │ ＋ Добави услуга                                   │  ║  → pushes the search
║  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  ║
║  ( ● Един след друг )  ( Едновременно )                  ║  only when ≥2 legs
```

_Gloss: `Добави услуга` add a service · `Един след друг / Едновременно` one after another / at the same time._

**One `ui-list-group`, one row per leg, one add row, and nothing else.** No field, no caret line, no conditional editor segment — the group is a flat run of rows and every one of them is a `<button>`. The arrangement pair sits _outside_ the group, because it is a chip run and not a row, and it renders only when two or more legs share a subject.

```html
<ul uiListGroup [attr.aria-label]="t('staff.visit.services')">
  <!-- 1 · one row per leg. `button[uiListRow]` is a real selector [exists] -->
  @for (leg of legs(); track leg.id) {
  <li>
    <button
      uiListRow
      uiSize="large"
      uiAlignment="leading"
      [uiInteractive]="true"
      (click)="pushService(leg.id)"
      [attr.aria-label]="legName(leg)"
      [attr.aria-description]="t('staff.visit.editService')"
    >
      <ui-stack uiSpacing="none">
        <span uiText uiFont="callout" uiWeight="medium">{{ leg.name }}</span>
        <span
          uiText
          uiFont="footnote"
          uiForegroundStyle="secondary"
          class="staff-sheet__figures"
          >{{ legLine(leg) }}</span
        >
      </ui-stack>
      <span uiTrailing
        ><ui-icon uiName="nav.disclosure" aria-hidden="true"
      /></span>
    </button>
  </li>
  }

  <!-- 2 · the add row. ABSENT on a settled appointment — never disabled (§3.6.5) -->
  <li>
    <button
      uiListRow
      uiSize="large"
      [uiInteractive]="true"
      (click)="pushServiceSearch()"
    >
      <span uiLeading><ui-icon uiName="action.add" aria-hidden="true" /></span>
      {{ t('staff.visit.addService') }}
    </button>
  </li>

  <!-- 3 · nothing else. There is no editor segment: the editor is a PAGE
          (§3.6.3), and the total lives in ПАРИ and appears ONCE. -->
</ul>
<ui-flow uiSpacing="compact">
  <!-- arrangement, only when ≥2 legs share a subject -->
  <button uiChip [uiSelected]="arrangement() === 'sequential'">…</button>
  <button uiChip [uiSelected]="arrangement() === 'parallel'">…</button>
</ui-flow>
```

**Every input above already exists, and that is the point of the reversal rather than a side effect of it.** `uiSize` / `uiAlignment` / `uiInteractive` on `ui-list-row` ([list-row.ts:97-104](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-row/list-row.ts:97)), whose selector already accepts `button[uiListRow]` and `li[uiListRow]` ([list-row.ts:75](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-row/list-row.ts:75)); `[uiLeading]` and `[uiTrailing]` are its two projected slots ([list-row.ts:77-79](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-row/list-row.ts:77)); `uiSpacing="none"` is a real `ui-stack` value ([stack.ts:9-13](../../libs/ui/layout/src/lib/stack/stack.ts:9)); `nav.disclosure` → `chevron_right` ([icon-registry.ts:106](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/icon/icon-registry.ts:106)) and `action.add` → `add` ([icon-registry.ts:126](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/icon/icon-registry.ts:126)) are both registered. **Nothing here is a new component.**

**The row's second line, not a token's value cell.** R9 is re-cut a third time, and its _sentence, not form_ grammar is what survives each re-cut: it was the honesty line, then the token's value cell, and it is now the **second line of the row**. `serviceLine` = `{{minutes}} мин · {{price}}`, extended to `15 мин · 8,00 € · Нико` **only when that leg's barber differs from the chair the frame is drawing** — when they all agree, the frame's owner header has already said it once (comments 2 + 7, §3.7), and repeating it on every row is precisely the duplication those comments objected to. The figures sit at `--sys-color-secondary-label` `[exists]` inside `.staff-sheet__figures` for tabular numerals, and an overridden price renders `18,00 € (беше 20,00 €)` through the surviving `moneyWas` shape — renamed `priceOverridden` — beside the `по избор` marker. **An override is therefore legible without opening anything**, which the token's value cell only ever managed by being open.

**Glyph discipline is load-bearing, and it is §3.6.1's law rendered at 20px.** `⌄` (`field.expand` → `arrow_drop_down`, [icon-registry.ts:118](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/icon/icon-registry.ts:118)) means _a menu drops here, or a picker opens here_. `›` (`nav.disclosure`) means _you go somewhere and come back_. A barber learns in one tap which rows travel, and after that he never guesses again. **R2's three-mark chevron contract survives, narrowed to rows and re-pointed:** `›` no longer means _"a separate sheet"_; it means _"a page inside this sheet's own nav stack."_ The row carries **no `aria-expanded`** — deliberately: it does not expand, and lying about it is worse than saying nothing.

**The `⊕ Добави услуга` ghost row stays deleted, and so does the caret line that replaced it.** `.staff-sheet__ghost-row` was a centred, link-coloured row inside the group that opened a sheet; the token field's placeholder replaced it and opened nothing; **`＋ Добави услуга` is now an ordinary `button[uiListRow]` with `action.add` in `[uiLeading]`**, and it pushes the search page. One grammar for adding, shared with `КЛИЕНТИ` and learned once. `staff.visit.searchServices` = `Търси услуга…` survives as **that page's** field placeholder, where it finally describes a destination that exists.

### R4b · Disclosure grammar — chevrons and tinted pills (2026-08-27)

> **The chevron answers its trigger, house-wide.** One rule in `icon.css`: a `field.expand` chevron inside anything reporting `aria-expanded` rotates 180° when open. Every `uiMenuTrigger` gets `aria-expanded` from the directive for free, so this reaches the leg-barber and duration menus, the barber row, the toolbar's date pill, the booking pulldowns and the phone field's country picker with **no per-site opt-in**. Verified reaching the toolbar without touching it.
>
> ⚠ **Keyed on the INTENT, never the glyph**, which required stamping `[attr.data-name]="uiName()"` on `UiIcon` — the DOM previously carried only the resolved ligature as text, so no rule could say "the disclosure chevron" without also catching the view picker's calendar glyph, the `⋯` and the filter funnel. `field.expand` is the only intent meaning _a menu drops from here_: `nav.disclosure` travels, `nav.back` returns, `calendar.previous`/`next` page, and `frame.handleStart`/`handleEnd` name **the direction a drag moves**. Those last two now share a ligature with `field.expand` and are still untouched, which is the whole argument for intent-keying.
>
> **No reduced-motion block.** The global kill-switch shortens the duration to 1ms without touching the transform, so the chevron snaps to its open position instead of sweeping. Zeroing the rotation there would delete the _state_, not the motion.
>
> ⚠ **`field.expand` is `keyboard_arrow_down`, not `expand_more`.** Both draw the same chevron; only one is in the pinned `material-symbols@0.45.8`. An unresolvable ligature does not tofu or throw — it renders **its own name in capitals** — and it looked correct in the browser only because the CDN face is newer than the pinned package. `icon.spec.ts` validates every registry value against the package's own `index.d.ts` and is the only thing that catches it.
>
> **THE PILLS ARE NEUTRAL AT REST AND TINTED WHEN OPEN** — the previous recipe had it backwards. iOS Calendar's Starts/Ends pills are `tertiarySystemFill` grey with `.label` ink until tapped; that one pill turns tinted while its picker is open and reverts when its sibling takes over. **The tint IS the disclosure state.** This repo had already reached the same conclusion twice without connecting it here: `list-row.css:78-85` removed a permanent accent wash because _"a permanently-washed row is a permanently selected-looking one… Emphasis must not borrow a state's signal"_, and the booking select pulled accent off a resting value for the same reason. A pill tinted at rest has spent the colour it needs to say it is open. §1's _"two independent tinted pills"_ is where the error came from — a misreading that collapsed Apple's two states and kept the wrong half.
>
> Rest is `--sys-color-fill` (systemFill parity, translucent, so one pill composites correctly on both the list-group row and the frame head). Open is `accent 18%` — the rung `button.css:405-412` already defines as _"the open/pressed resting state for triggers and layout toggles"_. ⚠ **The value stays foreground ink and the CHEVRON carries the accent**: `--sys-color-accent-label` on an 18% wash measures ≈3.9:1, below the 4.5 floor, and paling the wash to reach it makes the state unreadable. The glyph is a graphic and answers to 3:1, which raw accent clears. Fixing the fill also fixed the state layer for free — `uiInteractive` mixes `currentColor`, so hover and press were orange here and neutral on every other row of the sheet.

### R4a · `БРЪСНАРИ` — the picker (2026-08-27)

> **⚠ Built as an Outlook combobox first, then reversed the same day.** _"no revert it but make it like dropdown / ui menu select for barber just like it is in the view toolbar, reuse that component."_ The combobox is recorded here because its constraints are still true and will be met again by anything that tries a token field on this surface.
>
> **What ships:** one row per chair on the visit, each row a `uiMenuTrigger` opening the SAME `ui-menu` the view toolbar's scope switcher uses — portrait, tone badge cornered on it, name, a check on the current one. **One menu per row**, which is what makes a split visit unambiguous: the menu on Иван's row re-chairs Иван's legs and leaves Нико's alone. The single field had to guess whose legs a pick meant, and the rule it settled on (_the primary barber's_) was never stated on screen.
>
> **The row carries the name and nothing else.** It used to carry the barber's services on a second line; `УСЛУГИ` is four rows below, so it said the same thing twice and stood two lines tall to do it.
>
> **⚠ Two structural notes, both earned the hard way:**
>
> 1. **`ui-avatar` falls back to a monogram whenever `uiSrc` is absent.** It is a fallback, not an error, so a face-shaped control with no `src` fails _silently and looks deliberate_ — which is how every barber in this sheet wore initials while the toolbar two inches above showed photographs. The scope switcher had always passed `[uiSrc]="option.avatarSrc"`; the visit sheet passed only `[uiName]`. Anything drawing a person here takes the portrait from the same `scopeOptions()` resolution.
> 2. **`ui-list-group` flattens exactly ONE wrapper** (`.ui-list-group > :not(.ui-list-row) > .ui-list-row`, wrapper set to `display: contents`). A row that is also a menu trigger has TWO — `li > ui-menu > button` — because `uiMenuTrigger` must live inside the `ui-menu` that anchors the surface. The chain misses and the row renders as bare text beside properly carded neighbours. `display: contents` on the `ui-menu` would flatten it and also kill the `position: relative` the surface is positioned against, so the segment styling is restated locally for that one extra level. `--ui-list-group-wrapper` is named in list-group.css:24 as prose but does not exist; when it does, the local rule goes.
>
> **Why the combobox lost, kept for the next attempt.** `uiTextField` is an attribute on a bare `<input>` with `template: ''` — a replaced element that cannot have children, so a token can never sit inside one (`ui-phone-field` hit the same wall and answered it with a frame box around a chromeless input). `ui-menu` is the only anchored surface the DS ships, it is `position: absolute` inside its own trigger — `.modal-sheet__scroll` clips it — and it moves DOM focus to its first item on open, which is fatal for a field you keep typing in. Nothing in the repo uses the native top layer. A searchable popover on this surface therefore needs a new DS primitive, not a composition of existing ones.
>
> ⚠ **Still open:** `uiClients` is bound by no caller, so the pushed client search shows only its empty row and the guest-create row. `uiBarbers` is now bound; the client one needs the same treatment against a real people source.

> | `staff.visit.searchBarbers` (`Бръснари`) as a `role="rowgroup"` label | **Deleted with the suggestion grid.** With one source there is one group, and a label over the only group is comment 11's eyebrow problem wearing a different hat.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
>
> ⚠ **The chair is named ONCE, and not here.** `.staff-frame__owner` **`[new]`** — the frame's own gutter header, `ui-avatar uiControlSize="small"` inside the existing `span.staff-scope__face` + `span.staff-scope__swatch[data-barber-tone]` (§3.4, §3.7). The frame draws **one chair's column**; naming that column is labelling a picture, not restating a value, and `staff.visit.chairValue` re-homes there rather than dying. A shop-wide reassignment stays a _command_ — `⋯ → Смени стола` (R19) — and reassigning one leg stays a _value_, on that leg's page.

```
║  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  ║
║  │ (av) Мартин Илиев                                  │  ║  52 · two lines
║  │ +359 88 123 4567 · Нов                    ☎    ›   │  ║  ☎ is its own target
║  ├──────────── half-unit seam ────────────────────────┤  ║
║  │ ＋ Добави клиент                                   │  ║  → pushes the search
║  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  ║
║  Или остави празно — клиент без запазен час.             ║  when no client
```

_Gloss: `Нов` new · `Добави клиент` add a client · `Или остави празно — клиент без запазен час.` "Or leave it empty — a client without a booking."_

**There is no field and no caret line.** The caret line was the token field's affordance and it retired with it; the affordance is now the last row, and it is the same row `УСЛУГИ` uses. One grammar for adding, learned once.

```html
<ul uiListGroup [attr.aria-label]="t('staff.visit.clients')">
  @for (c of clients(); track c.id) {
  <li>
    <button
      uiListRow
      uiSize="large"
      uiAlignment="leading"
      [uiInteractive]="true"
      (click)="pushClient(c.id)"
      [attr.aria-label]="clientName(c)"
    >
      <span uiLeading><ui-avatar uiControlSize="small" … /></span>
      <ui-stack uiSpacing="none">
        <span uiText uiFont="callout" uiWeight="medium">{{ c.name }}</span>
        <span uiText uiFont="footnote" uiForegroundStyle="secondary">
          {{ c.phone }}
          <span uiBadge uiProminence="decreased">{{ c.flag }}</span>
          <!-- Нов · 2 неявявания -->
        </span>
      </ui-stack>
      <span uiTrailing>
        <!-- A PEER target, not the row's action. Two targets in one row is
             legal because both clear 44×44 and their names differ:
             „Обади се на Мартин Илиев“ against the row's composed name. -->
        <a
          uiButton
          uiButtonStyle="plain"
          [uiIconOnly]="true"
          [href]="'tel:' + c.phone"
          (click)="$event.stopPropagation()"
          [attr.aria-label]="callLabel(c)"
        >
          <ui-icon uiName="location.call" />
          <!-- [exists] icon-registry.ts:228 -->
        </a>
        <ui-icon uiName="nav.disclosure" aria-hidden="true" />
      </span>
    </button>
  </li>
  }

  <!-- ABSENT on a committed appointment: growing a live party stays excluded
       (§3.3.9). One missing row, never a disabled control. -->
  @if (!committed()) {
  <li>
    <button
      uiListRow
      uiSize="large"
      [uiInteractive]="true"
      (click)="pushClientSearch()"
    >
      <span uiLeading><ui-icon uiName="action.add" aria-hidden="true" /></span>
      {{ t('staff.visit.addClient') }}
    </button>
  </li>
  }

```

**R4's original objection to chips was right, and a row is what finally answers it.** The objection was that _"every participant carries a second load-bearing fact — a phone number, a chair, a request flag, a no-show count — and a chip has no room for it."_ True, and it stayed true of the token that was proposed as the fix: a label, a value cell, a `⌄` and a `✕` on one 44pt line at 375pt is four controls fighting for one row. **A two-line `ui-list-row` has room by construction** — the phone and a `span[uiBadge]` ([badge.ts:48-50](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/badge/badge.ts:48)) reading `Нов` or `2 неявявания` ride the second line, and everything else (last visit, `↺ Същото като миналия път`, `Без клиент (на място)`, removal) is the client **page's** contents. This line is a row, not a dossier. **`ui-chip` is left with exactly three jobs on this surface and none of them is here:** the arrangement pair, the applied-promo run, and §3.5's relative date row. `uiChipRole="token"` stays withdrawn.

**On a committed appointment the `＋ Добави клиент` row is absent** — growing a live party stays excluded (§3.3.9) — and on a settled or cancelled one the client rows render as **read rows**: no `›`, not buttons, and **no page can be pushed from them**, which is enforced by the rows not being interactive rather than by a guard inside the page. That is the whole of _"`⊕ Добави човек` does not grow a live one"_, expressed as one missing row rather than as a disabled control.

**Two removal rules survive verbatim across all three re-cuts, and are restated here so they are not lost with the container that carried them.** The **client on a party of one is never removable** — its remove row is **absent** from the client's page, replaced by `Без клиент (на място)`, which clears `BookingContact` and swaps the subject to `SeatSubject.anonymous`. And a **participant whose seat has a resolved outcome is not removable**, decidable row by row via `isResolved` ([transition-appointment.ts:87-92](../../apps/functions/src/lib/booking/transition-appointment.ts:87)); its remove row is absent, it carries a status glyph, and it routes to the existing per-seat cancel path. ⚠ _The carrier changed twice — a token's `✕`, then a page's destructive row — and the rule never did._

**Scope note.** This field now has **one** source. `UserSearchPort.search` **already ships and is already provided** ([user-search.port.ts:12-17](../../libs/application/governance/src/lib/ports/user-search.port.ts:12), [app.config.ts:225](../../apps/web/src/app/app.config.ts:225)) — nothing named `findClients` was ever needed. What it does _not_ clear is the rule: `/users` `allow list` is `receptionist | admin | sysadmin` ([firestore.rules:96-97](../../firestore.rules:96)), which excludes the barber this sheet is designed for. ⚠ **Re-pointed 2026-08-26:** the role case bites on the **pushed search page**, not on this group — the group renders and the client rows are fully live for everyone. On that page a `barber` gets **no results section at all**, no client-shaped copy, and the quick-create row promoted to first position as `⊕ Добави клиент „{{query}}“`. **Never an error**, because a failure message trains a retry that will always be refused. §3.7 › _The clients field's other states_ owns the full table, and Q16 owns the decision about whether the `searchClients` callable is bought at all.

### R5 · `ПАРИ`

**Ask #6 is deferred to M8, the last milestone. Nothing promo-shaped renders ON AN APPOINTMENT in M1–M7** — no discount line, no promo chip run, no "you saved" figure, not even a zeroed row, **and not the `Промоция` row itself**. Until the scheduling side has a caller into `ApplyDiscountsUseCase`, this region is a subtotal and a total, and the honesty gate says a subtotal that admits it is one beats a discount line that is always empty. Read the wireframe as a specification, not a schedule.

> **⚠ EXTENDED 2026-08-26 (owner comment 3). The owner asked for two things with two different costs, so they ship as THREE named surfaces across two milestones.** He asked to _apply_ a promo code and to _browse_ every promo the shop has. Applying needs the domain behind it; browsing needs nothing but a read.
>
> | Surface            | What it is                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Where                | Milestone |
> | ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------- | --------- |
> | **Apply**          | the `Промоция` row below, which **pushes a page**: a `Код за отстъпка` field, then the client's usable grants as `[uiSelected]` rows, then the shop's active promos under a rowgroup label, then the ad-hoc arm last | this group           | **M8**    |
> | **Browse**         | `⋯ → Всички промоции` — the **same page in read mode**, reachable with no appointment context at all: code, name, terms, validity, `minSpend`, nothing selectable                                                    | the sheet's `⋯` menu | **M7**    |
> | **Honour a grant** | not a surface but a permission: a `barber` may apply a code the client **already holds**                                                                                                                             | the apply page       | **M8**    |
>
> **Ruling: the row's trailing value is the applied promo's name, or the literal `Няма` — never a placeholder and never a bare `›`.** It is the same law as the `Ден` pill (Ruling A): **a row that owns a value always shows the value it owns.** And the glyph is `nav.disclosure` (`›`), never `field.expand` (`⌄`), because this row **travels** — one level deep, in the same `ui-sheet-nav` stack as the service and client pages, because **depth is exactly one, everywhere** (Ruling C).
>
> **Browsing is the half a barber needs most**, and it is the half that costs almost nothing: the question at the chair is _"is there still a code for a first haircut?"_, and M7 answers it a whole milestone before anything can be applied.

```

║  │ Услуги                                     28,00 € │  ║  44 · regular
║  ├────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤  ║
║  │ Промоция                                  Няма  ›  │  ║  44 · M8 · pushes a page
║  ├────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤  ║
║  │ Отстъпки                                   −8,00 € │  ║  M8 only — the engine's line
║  ├────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤  ║
║  │ Депозит (платен)                          −10,00 € │  ║  conditional
║  ├────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤  ║
║  │ В салона                                   10,00 € │  ║  52 · weight 600, never prominent
║  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  ║
║                                                          ║
║  ( Пети час −100% ) [✕]   ( Промо час −20% )             ║  M8 · the applied run
```

_Gloss: `Услуги` services · `Промоция` promo · `Няма` none · `Отстъпки` discounts · `Депозит (платен)` deposit (paid) · `В салона` at the shop._

```html

    {{ t('staff.visit.moneyServices') }}<span uiTrailing

    >
  </li>

       over a 0,00 € cart is a control with nothing to do; it appears with
       the first service. Offline it reads `Няма връзка` and does not push. -->
  @if (promoRowVisible()) {
  <li>
    <button
      uiListRow
      uiSize="regular"
      [uiInteractive]="true"

    >
      {{ t('staff.visit.promo') }}
      <span uiTrailing>
        {{ appliedPromoName() ?? t('staff.visit.promoNone') }}
        <ui-icon uiName="nav.disclosure" aria-hidden="true" />
      </span>
    </button>
  </li>
  } @if (discounts()) {
  <li uiListRow uiSize="regular" …>…</li>
  }
  <!-- M8 -->
  @if (deposit()) {
  <li uiListRow uiSize="regular" …>…</li>
  }

  <li uiListRow uiSize="large" class="staff-sheet__figures" data-total>
    {{ t('staff.visit.moneyDue') }}<span uiTrailing>{{ dueTotal() }}</span>
  </li>
</ul>
<ui-flow uiSpacing="compact">
  <!-- the applied-promo run, M8 only -->

       `ui-chip` has no [uiTrailing] and is not getting one (§3.8, §3.10) -->
```

> **Ruling: the total row is `plain` with a weight bump, never `uiVariant="prominent"`.** `prominent` is the primary-CTA fill — `--sys-color-primary` on the whole row ([list-row.css:57-61](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-row/list-row.css:57)) — and `ui-list-group`'s own contract reserves it for **standalone** rows ([list-group.ts:26-27](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-group/list-group.ts:26)). Putting it in the middle of a money group states _"tap me"_ about a derivation. `.staff-sheet__figures[data-total] { font-weight: 600 }` — one declaration, and the `large` rung carries the rest. **§3.10's component table is corrected accordingly.**

**The money group is a derivation, and derivations must not be editable.** A total you can type over is a total nobody can reconcile against the lines that produced it. ⚠ **Re-pointed 2026-08-26 (Ruling C):** this paragraph used to read _"price override lives inside the service token's editor."_ **There is no token and no inline editor.** Price override lives on the **service's own pushed page** (§3.6.3, §3.8) — one level deep, `‹` to come back, committed **live into the draft** with no `Готово` and no second commit boundary — because that is where the line that produced the figure is. And the `Цена` row is **absent** for a `barber`, not disabled: a read-only control is announced as _"disabled"_ by TalkBack and styled by nothing, so **the role gate removes the row rather than greying it** (§3.2, §3.8).

> **Ruling: the role split is not the obvious one, and drawing it wide was the earlier mistake.** _"Discounting"_ was covering two acts the domain already distinguishes.
>
> | Act                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Who                                 | Why                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
> | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
> | **Honouring a grant the client already holds** — `CouponGrantRepository.findUsableForUser` ([coupon-grant-repository.port.ts:22](../../libs/application/engagement/src/lib/ports/coupon-grant-repository.port.ts:22)) | **`barber` too**                    | This is not discounting. The shop made the promise; the barber is keeping it. Refusing a code the client is holding, at the chair, because the receptionist stepped out, is the shop breaking its own word |
> | **Authoring an ad-hoc discount** — a number a human invents at the counter                                                                                                                                            | `receptionist \| admin \| sysadmin` | This is spending the shop's money, and it is the act the original rule was about. Same three-role list `firestore.rules` already uses ([firestore.rules:96-97](../../firestore.rules:96))                  |
> | **Browsing the catalogue** (`⋯ → Всички промоции`)                                                                                                                                                                    | everyone who can open this sheet    | Reading a price list is not a permission                                                                                                                                                                   |
>
> **A barber may stretch his own time; he may not discount the shop's money — but he may keep a promise the shop already made.** The ad-hoc arm is **absent** for a barber, with `staff.visit.promoApplyDenied` = `Само рецепция или управител може да добавя отстъпки.` as the page's footnote. **Refusal copy, never a disabled control** — the same construction as the missing `Цена` cell, for the same reason.

⚠ **The honesty gate is not weakened by any of this, and the two places it bites are worth naming.** **(a) The `Промоция` row does not render before M8** — not greyed, not showing `Няма` over a domain that cannot hold an answer. M7's browse page is a _catalogue_ reachable from `⋯`; nothing on the appointment changes when you read it, which is exactly why it can ship a milestone early and why it is not a promo _state_ on a visit. **(b) The row is absent over an empty cart even after M8** — a new appointment with no services renders `0,00 €` and no `Промоция` row at all. It appears with the first service.

`В салона` reuses `booking.review.payAtShop` (`В салона:`) so the staff and client surfaces agree word for word. Every figure here is `formatMoney(money, locale)` — the function takes a locale ([format-money.ts:18](../../libs/domain/kernel/src/lib/format-money.ts:18)) and every `28,00 €` in this document is the **bare `bg`** rendering, never `bg-BG` (§2.3); §3.8 names the source once.

### R6 · Notes — two of them, never merged

> **⚠ AMENDED 2026-08-26 (owner comments 12 + 11). The team note is an ON-DEMAND reveal, and its visible heading is deleted.** The owner asked for it in one sentence — _"when there is no note, show an `Add note` button; tapping it replaces itself with the textarea"_ — and it is **adopted verbatim, in place, with focus.** The two-notes ruling itself is untouched: they are still two constructions, they are still never merged, and the client's `<blockquote>` is not what comment 12 is about.
>
> | Was                                                                  | Now                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
> | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
> | A visible `Бележка на екипа` heading inside the group, above the box | **Deleted** (comment 11). It survives as `aria-label` on the `ul[uiListGroup]` and nowhere else. A caps-less label over a two-line box was the label admitting the box could not speak — and once the box is an `＋ Добави бележка` row, it speaks. |
> | An always-rendered `textarea`, empty on most appointments            | **Replaced by a row at rest.** `＋ Добави бележка` is the empty state; tapping it swaps itself for the textarea **and focuses it in the same frame** — never a second tap.                                                                          |
> | —                                                                    | **`staff.visit.addNote`** = `Добави бележка` **`[new]`**, `action.add` in `[uiLeading]`. The same add-row grammar as `＋ Добави услуга` and `＋ Добави клиент`, learned once and reused three times.                                                |
>
> ⚠ **The client's note keeps its label, and the asymmetry is deliberate rather than an oversight.** Comment 11's law is _a group whose first row already says what it is does not need an eyebrow_ — and `＋ Добави бележка` says what it is. **A `<blockquote>` cannot: it is someone else's words and it has no row to speak for it**, so `staff.visit.clientNote` = `Бележка от клиента` stays a visible label. That is the law applied, not an exception to it.

```
── the client's note, only when there is one ────────────────────────────
   Бележка от клиента
   „Закъснявам 5 минути.“                                    <blockquote>

── the team note, empty ─────────────    ── after the tap, or when set ──
┌──────────────────────────────────┐    ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
│  ＋ Добави бележка               │    │ [ Не обича машинка отзад.      ] │
└──────────────────────────────────┘    │   Само за екипа — клиентът не я  │
                                        │   вижда.                         │
                                        └──────────────────────────────────┘
```

_Gloss: `Бележка от клиента` note from the client · `Закъснявам 5 минути.` "I'm running 5 minutes late." · `Добави бележка` add a note · `Не обича машинка отзад.` "Doesn't like clippers at the back." · `Само за екипа — клиентът не я вижда.` team only — the client does not see it._

```html
<!-- 1 · the client's words. OUTSIDE every group, read-only, only when present. -->
@if (clientNote()) {
<p uiText uiFont="footnote" uiForegroundStyle="secondary">
  {{ t('staff.visit.clientNote') }}
</p>
<blockquote>{{ clientNote() }}</blockquote>
}

<!-- 2 · the team note. One group, one row, two faces. The group's name is
        its aria-label and nothing else (comment 11). -->
<ul uiListGroup [attr.aria-label]="t('staff.visit.teamNote')">
  @if (noteOpen() || draftNote()) {
  <li uiListRow uiSize="large" uiAlignment="leading">
    <textarea
      uiTextField
      rows="2"
      #noteEl
      [attr.placeholder]="t('staff.visit.teamNotePlaceholder')"
      (change)="commitNote($any($event.target).value)"
    ></textarea>
  </li>
  } @else {
  <li>
    <button
      uiListRow
      uiSize="large"
      [uiInteractive]="true"
      (click)="openNote()"
    >
      <span uiLeading><ui-icon uiName="action.add" aria-hidden="true" /></span>
      {{ t('staff.visit.addNote') }}
    </button>
  </li>
  }
</ul>
```

**Two rules make the reveal work, and both are one line of behaviour each.** `openNote()` sets the signal **and focuses `#noteEl` in the same frame** — the owner asked for the button to _become_ the field, and a reveal that costs a second tap has not done that. And **the textarea does not collapse back to the button when it is emptied mid-session**; it collapses on the next open. A control that vanishes from under the caret is worse than a two-line empty box.

**Two different constructions, deliberately.** The client's note is a bare `<blockquote>` **outside any group** — it is prose, not a row, and a `ui-list-row` would dress someone else's words as a control. The team note is a **single-row `ui-list-group`**: a lone row in a group takes the full prominent radius on _both_ ends, which is exactly the card shape wanted, and it costs no new class. **That holds in both of its faces** — the `＋ Добави бележка` button and the textarea are the same lone row, so the shape does not change when the note appears.

The client's note is **read-only** and marked up as a `<blockquote>` — it is someone else's words and the markup should say so. Overwriting it destroys evidence, and once merged it cannot be unmerged. The prose is already on the VM and already sheet-only by design (`DayRowVm.note`, [staff-dashboard.ts:180](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.ts:180)); the staff note is a **`[new]`** field with no home in the document today.

**Settled / cancelled.** `＋ Добави бележка` is **absent**, alongside `＋ Добави услуга` and `＋ Добави клиент` (§3.3.9). An existing team note renders as read text; the client's blockquote renders exactly as it always does, because it was never a control.

### R7 · The honesty line and the destructive group

```
║  Клиентът не получава известие за промяната.             ║  footnote/secondary
║                                                          ║
║  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  ║
║  │ Не дойде                                           │  ║  plain, destructive
║  │ Откажи часа                                        │  ║  plain, destructive
║  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  ║
```

`staff.day.blockEffect` already tells the truth about blocking — _"Времето спира да е свободно за записване. Никой не получава известие."_ **An edit sheet that moves someone's 16:00 silently is a worse version of the same problem.** Building the channel is out of scope; stating its absence is not.

> **Ruling: two `button[uiListRow]` rows in one `ui-list-group`. The seam separates them; there is no divider and there never was one to keep.**

⚠ **`uiRole` is a `uiButton` input, not a `ui-list-row` one.** `UiListRowVariant` is `'plain' | 'neutral' | 'prominent'` and nothing else ([list-row.ts:10](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-row/list-row.ts:10)) — there is no destructive variant and one must not be invented for two rows. The red comes from the DS modifier that already exists for exactly this: **`[uiForegroundStyle]="'destructive'"`**, which writes `data-foreground-style` and resolves to `--sys-color-destructive` ([foreground.directive.ts:10-11](../../libs/ui/modifiers/src/lib/foreground.directive.ts:10), [modifiers.css:90-92](../../libs/ui/modifiers/modifiers.css:90)). §3.10's component table is corrected accordingly.

Destructive verbs sit **at the bottom of the scroll, in their own group, in red** — Apple's placement. But _unlike_ Apple, reachable in one flick rather than gated behind fourteen rows of travel, and guarded by the existing cancel-reason sheet rather than by distance.


**Exactly one commit-shaped child, DOM-last.** Verified: the dock rule applies `margin-inline-start: auto` to `[data-spread]`, `[data-button-style='borderedProminent']` **and** an explicit `uiPrimary` marker — and the component's doc header still claims a spread primary _"flexes into all leftover row space"_ ([sheet-action-bar.ts:25](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/sheet-action-bar/sheet-action-bar.ts:25)) — a **stale line M0 0.4 removes**, since the CSS says the opposite (_"Like every control the primary HUGS its label by default"_) and the mobile audit records the owner ruling that `[data-spread]` deliberately does not grow. What actually docks them is the auto margin — so two commit-shaped children both try to dock trailing. `☎` and `⋯` are `uiIconOnly` `bordered` at `--control-size-large` and carry none of those three markers. `ui-sheet-action-bar` takes one input, `uiVisible` ([sheet-action-bar.ts:72](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/sheet-action-bar/sheet-action-bar.ts:72)), and is already used by this sheet today.

**The primary verb stays at `--control-size-large` and stays in the thumb dock, always.** Demoting it to the small rung in the upper third of the sheet to reclaim vertical space would be reclaiming space by shrinking the control a barber hits forty times a day. The three rungs are `calc(var(--sys-space-unit) * 9 / 11 / 13)` ([tokens.css:66](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:66), [:75](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:75), [:76](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:76)) — 33.1/40.5/47.8 compact, 36/44/52 default, 38.9/47.5/56.2 spacious. **The 160px comes from folding three stacked overflow buttons into the `⋯` menu instead** — which is where the space actually was.

**The button's label is the state.** Outlook's morphing commit, adopted: the verb tells you what you are about to make. And **the disabled reason lives in the label**, never in a tooltip — `Избери услуга` rather than a greyed `Запази`. Offline, the label is replaced by a sentence and there is no commit control at all: a `Запази` that cannot save is the disabled promise this document keeps refusing.

**The notify switch rides _above_ the bar as a `ui-list-group` row with `button[uiSwitch] uiTrailing`** — both exist, both are already used by the block sheet at [staff-dashboard.html:1443-1455](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.html:1443) — Mangomint's placement, the side effect visible at the moment of commit — and it is **never** `[uiSpread]`, so it cannot steal the dock. Defaults **on** when the time changed, **off** otherwise. When no channel exists the switch is **replaced** by `staff.visit.notifyNone` = `Няма как да го известим — имаме само телефон.` **`[new]`**

_Gloss: `Ден` day · `Услуги` services · `В салона` at the shop · `Часът е приключен — вече не се променя.` the appointment is finished — it no longer changes._

⚠ **Re-cut 2026-08-26 (comments 4, 5, 7, 11 + Ruling C).** This wireframe used to draw a `Кога` summary row carrying `10:00 – 10:45 · 45 мин` over a `Стол Иван` line, with a chevron-less `Ден` row beneath it. **All three are gone.** The range and the minutes are in the pinned `[sheet-accessory]` strip (R1); the chair is the frame's `.staff-frame__owner` header (§3.4.2, comments 2 + 7); and there is no region-wide disclosure left to be chevron-less about, so **`staff.visit.when` is deleted outright** (§3.3, §3.10). What survives is the _shape_ of this state, not the rows it was drawn on.

**The identical ladder, with every `›`, every `⌄` and every `＋` absent, and one footnote saying why.** `data-locked="settled"` is a _reason_, not a tier: nothing is disabled, nothing is greyed, and there is no mode to leave. The rows that survive are text in a row's clothing, which is what a settled fact is. `Промоция` is drawn only when a promo was actually applied, and it renders its value without pushing (§3.8). **And `[fitted]` is a height, not a truncation** (§3.2): the sheet opens short and scrolls to the rest exactly as a live one does — what changed is _what the rows are_, not how many of them there are. It also never leaves that height, and not because anything forbids it: promotion is triggered by _any Regime B touch_, and on a settled appointment there is no Regime B control left to touch.

> **Ruling: on a settled appointment the rows stop being `button`s, so no page can be pushed.** Not _"the page opens read-only"_, not _"the controls are disabled"_ — the service row and the client row render as `li[uiListRow]` instead of `button[uiListRow]`, and an `li` has nothing to tap. §3.2's tier table states it for the whole sheet and §3.6.5 states it again for the services group; **this is one rule written three times on purpose, because it is the rule that makes a guard inside the pushed page unnecessary.** There is no `pushService` to refuse, because there is no `pushService`.

Three consequences, each of which used to need a control state of its own:

- **The `Ден` pill loses its `aria-expanded`, its `aria-controls` and its whole tap target.** It is not a disabled pill; it is not a pill at all — just the date, rendered in the row's trailing slot. The calendar segment is unreachable because nothing opens it (Ruling A, §3.5 › `Ден`).
- **`Времетраене` loses its menu trigger** and reads `45 мин · до 10:45` as plain text. The end is derived either way (Ruling B), so nothing on that row was ever storage worth protecting.
- **The frame draws and does not drag.** Its handles and its body-drag are **absent**, exactly as they are offline (below) — a picture with grab points on it is a lie about what a drag will do. `errors.booking.staffEdit.resolved_seat` = `Часът вече е започнал и не може да се мести` **`[new]`** is the _server's_ refusal, not this surface's copy; if it ever renders here, something upstream let a dead row through and the alert region says so.

_Gloss: `Приключен` finished · `Един от местата вече е приключен — часът не се мести.` one of the seats is already finished — the appointment does not move._

**This is a real state, not a hypothetical.** `isResolved(seat)` is per-seat ([transition-appointment.ts:87-92](../../apps/functions/src/lib/booking/transition-appointment.ts:87)), the per-seat verb path refuses a resolved seat outright ([transition-appointment.ts:199-207](../../apps/functions/src/lib/booking/transition-appointment.ts:199)), and the party-level path deliberately steps _over_ resolved seats rather than restamping them ([transition-appointment.ts:286-289](../../apps/functions/src/lib/booking/transition-appointment.ts:286)). The model already knows how to hold a half-finished party; the sheet must too.

> **Ruling: one resolved seat locks the whole appointment's _time_, and nothing else — and the lock is expressed by what a row IS, never by what a control is allowed to do.**

⚠ **Re-cut 2026-08-26 (Ruling C).** This ruling used to read _"the settled seat's token loses its `✕` and its `⌄`; the scheduled seat's token stays fully live."_ **There are no tokens, no per-participant `✕` and no per-participant `⌄`** (§3.6.1, §3.7). Stated in §3.2's vocabulary instead: **the settled seat's row is an `li[uiListRow]`; the scheduled seat's row is a `button[uiListRow]`.** The settled one carries no `›`, pushes no page, and therefore offers no `Премахни клиента` — removal lives at the bottom of a page that cannot be reached, which is exactly how §3.7 › _Removal_ already rules a resolved seat unremovable and routes it to the existing per-seat cancel path (`cancelSeatId`, [staff-dashboard.ts:2395](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.ts:2395)). The live one is untouched: it pushes, it edits, it removes.

**Everything else is per row, not per sheet.** Per-seat verbs on the still-scheduled seats stay live, because the server will accept them. What is genuinely per-_sheet_ is exactly one thing: **the time.** The `Ден` pill goes inert, `Времетраене` loses its menu trigger, and the frame draws without handles — because the frame edits one interval that every seat shares, and moving it would rewrite the start of work that has already happened. **Locking time while leaving verbs alive is exactly the boundary the callable already draws, and the UI has no business drawing a different one.**

_Gloss: `Отказан` cancelled · `вчера в 18:40` yesterday at 18:40 · `Часът е отменен — вече не се променя.` the appointment is cancelled — it no longer changes · `Времето е свободно.` the time is free · `Дублирай` duplicate._

**The contradiction, resolved.** `staff-dashboard.ts` carries a standing _"cancelled rows stay visible"_ ruling and this sheet is reachable from those rows; §3.9 #16 says a cancelled appointment is **not drawn** in the frame. Both are right and they do not meet, because **on a cancelled appointment there is no frame at all.** ⚠ **Re-cut 2026-08-26:** this used to be resolved by _"the `Кога` row does not disclose on a cancelled appointment either"_ — there is no `Кога` row and no region-wide disclosure (comments 5 + 11), so the resolution is now the plain one it was standing in for.

Why not draw it greyed: the frame's job is to answer _"can this go here"_ against the chair's real occupancy, and a cancelled appointment has released its interval — the answer is _"yes, trivially, and so could anything else."_ A ghost block in that window would show a barber a shape that no longer holds any time.

**What it was still renders, and in two places, neither of them a control.** The time range is in the pinned `[sheet-accessory]` strip, **struck through** (§3.2's tier table), because _what it was_ is the fact the barber opened the sheet to read; the date stays in the `Ден` row for the same reason. Both are text.

**The footnote is two sentences and both are load-bearing.** §3.2 names the first — `Часът е отменен — вече не се променя.` — which is the lock, and it is the same sentence shape every `data-locked` reason wears. `Времето е свободно.` belongs to this state alone: it is the answer to the question a barber opens a cancelled row to ask, and no other surface answers it.

The `⋯` menu collapses to one item: `Дублирай` — recreate this booking as a new one. That is the only legal act on a cancelled row, and it is a common one. **It opens a fresh `Нов час` draft; it is not a pushed page** — a duplicate is a _different appointment_, and §3.2's depth-one law is about subviews of _this_ object (§3.6.3).

**No new status, no new field.** "Running late" _is_ the move. `Appointment` already computes the arrival delta from `arrivedAt` against the slot start ([appointment.ts:199-200](../../libs/domain/scheduling/src/lib/appointment.ts:199)). ⚠ **Re-homed 2026-08-26 (comment 4):** the delta reads **in the pinned strip beside the badge**, not on a `Кога` summary row — the strip is the one place this sheet states the whole visit in a line, and it is pinned, so the delta stays legible at row 40 of a dirty draft. A chip **seeds the draft and un-fits the sheet** rather than writing immediately (§3.2 › _Promotion and demotion_, §3.9 #2): one tap still gets the barber exactly as far as it used to, and the difference is that he sees the collision before he commits.

**Peek, row error:**

```
║  ⚠ Часът не може да мине от „приключен“ към „потвърден“. ║  role="alert"
```

`rowError(id)` ([staff-dashboard.ts:2647](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.ts:2647)) → `translateDomainError`, rendered **in the region that earned the refusal** — the existing ruling, already wired at [staff-dashboard.html:1297-1301](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.html:1297).

**Peek, PERMISSION DENIED on a write:**

```
║  ⚠ Нямаш право да променяш този час.                     ║  role="alert",
                                                              controls stay,
                                                              no retry offered
```

**Ruling: the sheet always opens; only writes are refused, and the refusal renders in the row that earned it.** A read denial cannot reach this surface — `/appointments` reads are gated on `worksTheBook()` = `barber | receptionist | admin | sysadmin` ([firestore.rules:47-49](../../firestore.rules:47), enforced at [firestore.rules:166](../../firestore.rules:166)), so a role without it has no lane, no row, and therefore no sheet to open. There is nothing to render "denied" _into_.

The gap runs the other way, and it is real: `transitionAppointment` gates on `STAFF_ROLES`, which **includes `content_manager`** — a role that cannot read a client's name but can currently transition their booking. That is a server defect, not a sheet state; §3.12 M2 owns narrowing it to `worksTheBook`. Until it lands, this sheet has no way to reach a `content_manager` anyway.

The genuine denial a barber will hit is the **client search** (`/users` `allow list` excludes `barber`, [firestore.rules:96-97](../../firestore.rules:96)), and it renders on the **pushed add-client page** as a _different search_ — no results rowgroup at all, and `⊕ Добави клиент „{{query}}“` promoted to first position — never as an error. ⚠ **Re-homed 2026-08-26 (Ruling C):** the carrier moved from the people field's suggestion grid to a page; the rule did not, and the reason is unchanged — a failure message would train a retry that will always be refused. §3.7 › _The clients field's other states_ owns it.

**UNDO, itself refused:**

```
║  ⚠ Не можа да се върне — времето вече е заето.           ║  role="alert", 8s
║     Часът остава 10:35 – 11:00.                          ║  state, restated
```

`Върни` is a real second write through the same callable, obeying the same refusals — so in the eight seconds the toast is up, someone can take the slot the undo wants back. **Ruling: the undo fails loudly, the appointment stays where the _first_ write put it, and the alert restates that position in words.** Three consequences, all deliberate:

- **The `Върни` affordance disappears** the moment its own write is refused. Offering a second attempt at an act the server has just declined is how a barber ends up tapping four times into a wall.
- **Nothing is retried automatically.** The undo's inverse is a placement decision, and `decideBooking` re-decides it; a silent retry would race the person who just took the slot.
- **The alert says where the appointment _is_, not what failed.** "Не можа да се върне" is the diagnosis; "Часът остава 10:35 – 11:00" is the thing the barber has to act on, and it must not require re-reading the row to find.

The same rule governs the 8-second save toast's `Върни`. There is no third level of undo.

_Gloss: `Стефан е при Нико, 10:35 – 11:15.` Stefan is with Niko, 10:35 – 11:15 · `Промяната мести и двамата.` the change moves both of them._

Q1 rules _"the appointment, opened at a seat"_, and the VM honours it: `toRow` filters to one barber's share of the party and stamps `seatId`, `partySize` and `seatsHere` on the row ([staff-dashboard.ts:105-118](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.ts:105)) — **a two-chair party is already two rows in the day.** The frame is one chair's column and stays one chair's column.

**Four rulings:**

1. **The frame draws the chair you opened, and names the others in words.** Not columns. §4.4's arithmetic holds — three lanes on a 375px phone is a chart, not a control — and a party is at most a handful of seats, which a sentence carries better than a grid.
2. **The handles bound the _whole party's_ envelope, not this seat's** — and §3.4.2's bullet is amended to say the same. The staff-edit payload replaces all seats, so a drag that shortens one leg past another leg's start would write an arrangement the domain will refuse. The end handle stops at `max(end)` across every seat and the start handle at `min(start)`; the readout stays this seat's own `до 11:00 · 25 мин`, because that is the interval under the finger.
3. **When the legs disagree, the line under the frame says so before the drag, not after the refusal.** `ⓘ Стефан е при Нико, 10:35 – 11:15. Промяната мести и двамата.` — the same _"terms change, named"_ grammar the chair-move menu uses. ⚠ **This is compatible with comment 6, and it is the case that comment 6 carved out:** the frame carries **no standing caption** (§3.4.2) — the line is silent by default and speaks only when it carries a verdict the frame cannot draw. A second leg in another chair is exactly that verdict.
4. ⚠ **NEW, 2026-08-26 (comments 2 + 7): the chair selector is DELETED.** This wireframe used to carry a `Стол Иван ▾ … и още 1 стол` selector under the `Кога` row, swapping which seat the frame drew. **It goes with the `Стол` row itself.** The chair is _labelled_ on the picture — `.staff-frame__owner` (§3.4.2) — and that header is explicitly **not interactive**, because a tappable one would imply it edits _this frame's_ chair alone and no such value exists. The two jobs the selector actually did are both already served: **seeing the other leg** is `toRow`'s, since a two-chair party is already two rows in the day, each opening this sheet at its own seat; and **changing the chair** is `⋯ → Смени стола`, which rewrites every leg at once (R19, promoted by the same two comments). A third path whose entire effect was on _what got drawn_ is a control over a picture.
