| 3   | commit on `change`, never `input` — and the block sheet changes with us                  | **Survives verbatim.** Typing "1" must not throw the block to 01:00. The shipped block pair binds `(input)` ([staff-dashboard.html:1468](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.html:1468), [:1481](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.html:1481)) and **has the bug today**; moving it to `(change)` is part of the rename PR, not a divergence. Parse via `minuteOfClock()` ([staff-dashboard.ts:388-395](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.ts:388), already built). |
| 4   | on `blur` with an unparseable value, re-render from the signal                           | **Survives.** No red, no error copy — the field simply refuses to lie.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| 5   | `1030`, `10.30` and `10 30` normalise on `beforeinput`                                   | **Survives.** Outlook's `125p` is the highest-value/lowest-cost idea in the corpus. **Bulgarian natural-language parsing is still explicitly out of scope.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| 6   | one source of truth: `draftStartMinute` / `draftEndMinute`                               | **Re-cut.** The authored pair is `draftStartMinute` / **`draftDurationMinutes`**; **`draftEndMinute` is a `computed()` and is writable nowhere.** Neither editor observes the other; the frame writes on snap, the rows on `change`/select.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| 7   | duration carry-over, with an escape (`Времетраене` pins the duration)                    | **Dissolved into an invariant.** The duration is the stored fact, so it is always pinned and there is no escape to learn. Moving `Начало` slides the block.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| 8   | the duration menu lists outcomes, and picking one moves the **end**                      | **Re-pointed.** The menu still lists outcomes — that half was right, and it is the reason this ruling survived at all — but picking one writes the **duration**, and the end is what moves as a consequence. The presets are the ladder above, not "the distinct durations across the selected services".                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| 9   | price and duration are decoupled, stated once                                            | **Survives verbatim.** `staff.visit.durationKeepsPrice`, first duration edit, then never again.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

#### The markup

```html
<!-- Order: `Ден` (above, with the frame between). §3.3 R2 carries the region. -->
<ul uiListGroup>
  <li uiListRow uiSize="regular">
    {{ t('staff.visit.start') }}
    <span uiTrailing>
      <span class="staff-sheet__pill staff-sheet__figures">
        <input
          uiTextField
          type="time"
          step="300"
          [value]="draftStartValue()"
          [attr.min]="startMinAttr()"
          [attr.max]="startMaxAttr()"
          (change)="commitTyped('start', $any($event.target).value)"
        />
      </span>
    </span>
  </li>

  <li uiListRow uiSize="regular">
    {{ t('staff.visit.durationPick') }}
    <span uiTrailing>
      <ui-menu
        uiAlignment="trailing"
        [uiPresented]="durationMenu()"
        (uiDismissed)="durationMenu.set(false)"
      >
        <button
          uiMenuTrigger
          type="button"
          class="staff-sheet__pill staff-sheet__figures"
          (click)="durationMenu.set(true)"
        >
          {{ t('staff.visit.durationValue', { duration: durationLabel(), end:
          endLabel() }) }}
          <ui-icon uiName="field.expand" aria-hidden="true" />
        </button>

        @for (step of durationLadder(); track step.minutes) {
        <button
          uiMenuItem
          [uiSelected]="step.minutes === draftDurationMinutes()"
          [disabled]="step.belowFloor"
          (click)="setDuration(step.minutes)"
        >
          <span>{{ step.label }}</span>
          <span class="staff-sheet__figures">{{ step.endLabel }}</span>
          @if (step.isCatalogSum) {
          <span uiText uiFont="caption" uiForegroundStyle="tertiary">
            {{ t('staff.visit.durationCatalogSum') }}
          </span>
          } @if (step.belowFloor && step.isFloor) {
          <span uiText uiFont="caption" uiForegroundStyle="tertiary">
            {{ t('staff.visit.durationFloor', { minutes: floorMinutes() }) }}
          </span>
          }
        </button>
        }

        <button uiMenuItem (click)="openMinutesEntry()">
          {{ t('staff.visit.durationOther') }}
        </button>
        <button uiMenuItem (click)="openUntilPicker()">
          {{ t('staff.visit.durationUntil') }}
        </button>
      </ui-menu>
    </span>
  </li>
</ul>
```

**No `@if` on either row. The pair is unconditional** — that is ruling 3 of §3.3 R2 (WCAG 2.5.7) expressed in markup, and the `openEditor()` signal that used to guard it does not exist any more.

**Status of what that markup names.** `ui-list-row` with `uiSize` ([list-row.ts:97](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-row/list-row.ts:97)), `input[uiTextField]` with its single input `[uiInvalid]` ([text-field.ts:28](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/text-field/text-field.ts:28)), `ui-menu` with `uiPresented` / `uiAlignment` / `(uiDismissed)` ([menu.ts:138-144](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/menu/menu.ts:138)), `uiMenuTrigger` ([menu.ts:32](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/menu/menu.ts:32)), `uiMenuItem` with `uiSelected` ([menu.ts:50-72](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/menu/menu.ts:50)) and `ui-icon uiName="field.expand"` ([icon-registry.ts:118](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/icon/icon-registry.ts:118)) all **exist**. **New:** the classes `.staff-sheet__pill` and `.staff-sheet__figures`, the i18n keys listed in §3.10, and the signals `draftStartValue` / `startMinAttr` / `startMaxAttr` / `commitTyped` / `draftDurationMinutes` / `durationLadder` / `floorMinutes` / `durationMenu`. **Deleted:** `draftEndValue`, `endMinAttr`, `endMaxAttr`, `endInvalid`, the `commitTyped('end', …)` arm, and `ui-stack uiAxis="horizontal"` from this group.

**The height budget for this region is stated once, in §3.3 R2**, together with the frame's and the calendar's — it is one column of stacked heights and splitting it across two sections is how the two copies drift.

### `Ден` — a tinted pill whose calendar expands inline

> **⚠ Reversed 2026-08-26 (Ruling A, owner comment 5).** This section used to read, in full: _"A `ui-list-row` with `›`, opening the existing `ui-calendar-scroller` in a **nested sheet**."_ **That is reversed.** The `›` becomes a tinted pill with `⌄`; **the nested sheet is deleted**; `ui-calendar-scroller` **leaves this surface** and `ui-calendar-grid uiSize="regular"` replaces it. _A sheet on top of a sheet to pick one date is the modal problem with extra layers._
>
> **What survives: "No gesture."** A cross-day move changes the `dayKey`, the busy projection and possibly the roster — it is a different operation with different refusals, and it is not something a finger should be able to do by accident on a surface whose whole point is that the block drags.

#### Why inline, and why not the three obvious alternatives

Apple's compact rule is a **space** argument — _"Use a compact date picker when space is constrained"_ — and its style descriptions are the **behaviour** argument: `.compact` for _"specific date and time selections"_, `.graphical` for _"browsing through days."_ Our date is changed rarely and, when it is changed, it is **browsed** — _"next Tuesday?"_, _"same time next month"_. The two axes cross. The answer that satisfies both is a trigger costing one 36px control at rest and a grid costing nothing until it is asked for.

| Rejected                                            | On what ground                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| The system **`.compact`** control (a modal popover) | On a 390pt phone it delivers only the bad half of its size-class split — dimming, blur, lost context, commit-by-outside-tap — because the popover that redeems it on iPad never appears. **In a sheet that is always editable, an overlay that hides the sheet to edit one field makes an editor stop being an editor.** |
| An always-open **`.inline` / `.graphical`** grid    | ~390–440px permanently (§3.3 R2's budget) — more than a phone viewport of this sheet — to serve a minority edit, pushing the frame, the services, the clients and the money below the fold on **every** open.                                                                                                            |
| A **wheel**                                         | `.wheels` still ships FB13227254 (element counts swapped between components). The inline reveal is a grid of labelled day buttons: **the only style with no open Apple bug and no modal focus-trap obligation.** Accessibility pointing the same way as taste is how you know the answer is right.                       |
| A **nested sheet** (what this section used to say)  | _"Display only one sheet at a time… close the first before displaying the new one."_                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

And the reveal is **inline** because that is both what Apple's own apps do and what Apple's own guidance says: _"Avoid switching views to show a picker. A picker works well when displayed in context, below or in proximity to the field people are editing."_ Calendar and Reminders both expand beneath the row **inside the same scroll view**.

> **This does not contradict Ruling C**, and the reconciliation is the law that keeps the two apart: **a _value_ with a spatial editor of its own expands in place; a _row that owns several values_ pushes a page.** The date is one value with a calendar — it expands. A service is three values plus a destructive verb — it travels (§3.6). Apple obeys exactly this split inside one sheet: _Starts_ expands, _Travel Time_ pushes.

#### The interaction, stated once

|                       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Rest**              | `li[uiListRow] uiSize="regular"` labelled `Ден`; the trailing slot holds a `button.staff-sheet__pill` at `--control-size-small` (36px at density 1) inside the 44px row. Accent-tinted fill, `--sys-color-accent-label` ink, `--control-radius-capsule`. **Always value-bearing:** `вт, 26 авг`. Never a placeholder, never a bare `›`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Trigger semantics** | `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls`; **re-tap collapses.** The layout change is announced, per the HIG's _"Inform VoiceOver when visible content or layout changes occur."_                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **The expansion**     | A **sibling segment of the same `ui-list-group`**, never a child of the row — so it inherits the half-unit seam and the inner/outer corner treatment for free and reads as part of the run rather than a panel dropped into it. Because `.ui-list-group > :not(.ui-list-row) { display: contents }` ([list-group.css:26-28](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-group/list-group.css:26)), it takes **`.staff-sheet__disclosure`** — and it is now that class's **only** consumer in the sheet (§3.3.0).                                                                               |
| **The grid**          | **`ui-calendar-grid uiSize="regular"`** — the component's own doctrine for _"a calendar embedded in a card alongside other content"_, as against `large`, where _"the grid IS the screen"_ ([calendar-grid.ts:9-17](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/calendar-grid/calendar-grid.ts:9)). Cells are `button[uiDay] uiInteractive uiRadius="capsule"` — the component's stated cell contract, _"never a bespoke hover"_ ([calendar-grid.ts:27-30](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/calendar-grid/calendar-grid.ts:27)) — each wrapping a `ui-date-badge`, with the ungated `:active` mirror. |
| **Month jump**        | The `⌄` beside `август 2026` swaps the grid for a month + year list. _"Same time next month"_ is a real barbershop move, and `‹ ›` alone makes it four taps.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **The relative row**  | Above the grid, three `button[uiChip] uiControlSize="small"`: `Днес` · `Утре` · `В {{weekday}}`. Reminders' _Today / Tomorrow / This Weekend_, and Apple's concession that most date changes are ±1–2 days and should not require aiming at a cell.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Invariant**         | Moving `Ден` **holds the duration** and slides the whole block. The services' summed span is the invariant to preserve — the same invariant `Начало` holds.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

**Why `ui-calendar-scroller` leaves.** Its own docblock describes the shape it is: _"A continuously scrolling run of months — the Calendar-app shape"_, whose slot contract is a page-owning `[uiCalendarLede]` heading that _"scroll[s] AWAY at the top"_, wrapping `ui-calendar-grid uiSize="large"` ([calendar-scroller.ts:7-33](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/calendar-scroller/calendar-scroller.ts:7)). **That is a screen.** It is the right component for `/book`, where picking a day _is_ the task and the horizon is genuinely open; it is the wrong one for a 340px segment inside a form whose real answer is almost always this week or next. Nothing is deleted from the design system — the scroller keeps its consumer and its reasons. It simply is not this surface's control.

**`ui-chip` is the wrong component for the pill and must not be bent into it.** Its whole API is `uiSelected` + `uiControlSize` ([chip.ts:27-28](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/chip/chip.ts:27)) and `uiSelected` binds `aria-pressed` on the host: this is a **disclosure trigger for a form value**, not a toggle button. It is a plain `button` in the row's `[uiTrailing]` slot with `.staff-sheet__pill` **`[new]`** — six declarations and **no new token** (`--sys-color-accent`, `--sys-color-accent-label`, `--control-radius-capsule` and `--control-size-small` all exist). The relative-date chips **are** genuine chips and keep `ui-chip`; that is one of its three remaining jobs on this surface (§3.10).

#### Occupancy — kept whole from the old ruling

**Ruling: the day picker carries an occupancy signal or it is a trap.** Asking a barber to pick a day blind and _then_ meet a refusal is the worst ordering available. But it signals only **what it has actually loaded** (§3.3.9). The cells of the days already subscribed through `StaffDayStore`'s visible week take a three-state load mark off the `barberBusy` projection the day grid already reads — free / partly booked / nothing sellable (a whole-day `ScheduleException`) — carried by `ui-date-badge`'s **one** dot slot (`[uiMarker]`, which already merges with today's dot rather than drawing two, [date-badge.ts:36-40](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/date-badge/date-badge.ts:36)) and by `uiState="unavailable"`, whose contract is exactly _"the number stays legible but reads as untappable"_ and which explicitly **does not** gate the tap — the consumer still sets `disabled` ([date-badge.ts:42-46](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/date-badge/date-badge.ts:42)). Every other day takes a neutral `·` meaning _not known yet_, and a closed day takes `—`. **Three states, no counts** — a number here is a second schedule rendered badly — plus the footnote `Заетостта се вижда само за заредената седмица.`

**Answering for a whole scrolling horizon would mean firing `barbers × days` listeners from inside a picker; §3.12 does not size that and this design does not ask for it.** Bounding the calendar to a month makes that cheaper than it was against the scroller, not more expensive. Size **S**, scoped to the loaded week: the projection and its index (`barberBusy: barberId, dayKey`) both ship.

### All-day — the ruling in full

**An all-day appointment does not exist and must not be built.** §2.2 Q5 lists the five things that break. The toggle switches **aggregate**, not a field, and it appears in exactly three places, none of them the visit ladder:

**(a) `staff-block-sheet`'s existing switch — unchanged.** `staff.day.blockAllDay` = `Почива цял ден` ([staff-dashboard.html:1443-1454](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.html:1443)), and flipping it on **removes** the two time fields (`@if (!blockAllDay())`, [:1457](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.html:1457)) rather than disabling them — Apple's and Google's behaviour, already correct. `blockTime(barberId, locationId, [])` → **empty `ranges` means the whole day** ([staff-day.store.ts:762-764](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-day.store.ts:762)) → `{kind:'time_off'}` → sanitised to public `{kind:'closed'}` ([schedule-exception-document.ts:82-98](../../libs/application/booking/src/lib/ports/schedule-exception-document.ts:82)) → renders in the grid's **existing** all-day rail (`allDay` / `allDayLabel` / `allDayAlways` at [staff-time-grid.ts:236-246](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/time-grid/staff-time-grid.ts:236), drawn at [staff-time-grid.html:81-85](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/time-grid/staff-time-grid.html:81)).

**(b) A kind switch at the top of creation.** `( Час ) ( Блокирано )` as a `role="radiogroup"` of `uiChip`s. **That segment is the all-day toggle**, positioned where it changes _what you are making_ rather than mutating what already exists.

**(c) `⋯ → Превърни в блокирано време` in the visit sheet.** Two effects, both named, routed through the existing cancel sheet pre-armed with `staff_barber_absence`.

**⚠ Blocking time is not free, and the design as written destroys data.** `blockTime` builds `ScheduleExceptionId.of(\`${barberId}__${day.key()}\`)`([staff-day.store.ts:754](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-day.store.ts:754)) — **one exception document per barber per day** — and the writer is a plain`setDoc`([schedule-exception-writer.adapter.ts:47-50](../../libs/infrastructure/firestore/src/lib/schedule-exception-writer.adapter.ts:47)). A second block created from the frame's long-press entry point **silently overwrites the first**, and`clearBlock(barberId)` ([staff-day.store.ts:786-800](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-day.store.ts:786)) clears the barber's _entire day_, not one block.

> **Ruling: before a second block can exist on one day, `ScheduleException` must accumulate ranges and `clearBlock` must take one.** The domain shape is already right — `{kind:'admin', ranges}` is plural — so the fix is a read-modify-write in `blockTime` (merge the new range into the day's existing `ranges`, coalescing overlaps) plus `clearBlock(barberId, range?)` where an absent range keeps today's clear-the-day meaning behind the existing armed confirmation. **Size M**, and it must land with the frame's long-press entry point, not after it. Both this and the ranges migration need a milestone of their own; neither is implied by `staffEditAppointment`.

**The one thing that must be added on top.** A whole-day entry carries no reason anyone can read later: `blockTime` passes `note: ''` ([staff-day.store.ts:764](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-day.store.ts:764)) and `exceptionToDocument` never has a field to put it in ([schedule-exception-document.ts:70-80](../../libs/application/booking/src/lib/ports/schedule-exception-document.ts:70)) — **correctly**: that function is the GDPR boundary, and `sick`, `time_off`, `training` and `travel` all collapse to one `closed` effect on purpose. So: a **new staff-only sibling collection** `scheduleExceptionNotes/{locationId}_{barberId}_{dayKey}` holding `{ title, note, authorUid, writtenAt }`, readable under `isStaff()`, never sanitised into the public document, with its own rules block. Until it ships, a `blockNote` copy key has nowhere to land and must not be added. **Do not widen the public doc.**

### Time override

The owner's phrase maps to a mechanism, and the mechanism is **not** the one the rest of §3.5 describes. Two different things have been carrying the same word:

| Owner's phrase         | Concrete mechanism                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Where                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Terms override**     | a leg's `terms.durationMinutes` / `terms.price` diverge from the catalogue value, persisted verbatim by `appointmentToDocument` ([appointment-document.ts:67-72](../../libs/application/booking/src/lib/ports/appointment-document.ts:67)) | §3.8, with the provenance fields. **Row 1 of the over/under-length table above is the one path by which `Времетраене` writes one** — a single-service appointment whose span is changed _is_ a terms override, named as such with `по избор`, and never a silent reshaping |
| **Placement override** | put the appointment where the availability engine would refuse it — `allowOutsideWindow` and `allowOverlap` (**both new**, flags on the new `staffEditAppointment` callable)                                                               | M2                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

> **Ruling: "time override" means _placement_.** Editing `Начало` or `Времетраене` inside the roster is not an override at all — it is editing, and Fresha is right that the two should not be distinguishable in the UI. What makes an edit an _override_ is that a refusal was consciously overruled, and that is the pair of booleans, plus the persisted provenance marker they set. There is no override "mode": the frame and the two rows simply stop refusing once the barber acknowledges the named conflict (§3.9 #17). **If the owner meant something else by the phrase, that is Q19 in §4.2 — it is not answerable from the code.**

### Press parity

Every interactive surface introduced above — the `Ден` pill, every `button[uiDay]` in the inline calendar, the three relative-date chips, the `Времетраене` pill and every row of its menu, and the kind-switch chips — takes the DS's one hover/press grammar: `[data-interactive]`, whose hover state is gated `@media (hover: hover)` ([modifiers.css:227-235](../../libs/ui/modifiers/modifiers.css:227)) and whose **`:active` mirror is ungated** ([modifiers.css:243-250](../../libs/ui/modifiers/modifiers.css:243)). Nothing here invents a hover treatment, and nothing here ships a hover effect without its press twin.

---

## 3.6 The services section

> **REVERSED, 2026-08-26 (owner comments 1 + 10). A service is a `ui-list-row` carrying `›`, and it pushes a page inside this sheet's own navigation stack.** The token field is dead on this surface: `span[uiToken]`, `[uiCombobox]`, the APG grid popup, the per-token `✕` and `⌄`, `data-open` and `.staff-sheet__tokens` all leave. **§3.6.4's "inline expansion, never a popover" is overturned**, and so are R2's token extension and R3's reinforcement of the same date. §3.6.1 quotes what they said and names the four things that were not on the table when they were written.
>
> **What the superseded ruling was right about survives untouched: the nested multi-select picker sheet is still dead, and the leg sheet is still dead.** Neither comes back. What replaces them is neither a sheet nor an expansion — it is **one level of navigation inside the sheet that is already open**, which is the shape Apple ships, the shape five of five competitors ship, and the only shape that gets the sticky header, the Back affordance, the whole viewport, the focus move and the scroll restore _for free_ instead of simulating each of them badly.

### 3.6.1 The reversal — comments 1 and 10, which are one comment

The owner wrote two sentences about one control. _"I don't like the look of this component"_ is what a token looks like when it is asked to carry a label, a value, a `⌄` and a `✕` at 44pt inside 375pt of screen. _"It shows another section under current section which might not be instantly visible"_ is an unprompted, precise statement of a documented failure mode. **The second sentence is the one that decides it**, and it decides it against text this document wrote on the same day.

**Quoted, so nothing is deleted in silence.**

> **§3.6.4 (superseded 2026-08-26):** _"Inline expansion — the token expands in place into a full-width editor inside the same group — **✓**"_ … _"The editor is `.staff-sheet__disclosure`, not a sheet."_ … _"Two-level commit survives. `Готово` folds the override into the draft."_
>
> **R2's token extension (superseded 2026-08-26):** _"Its editor opens **beneath the token's own line**, in the same scroll view, and never as a popover or a sheet."_
>
> **R3's reinforcement (superseded 2026-08-26):** _"Inline token expansion is the strongest form this ruling has ever taken… Everything this surface can edit is edited on this surface."_

All three are withdrawn. Here is what they did not have.

**1 · The arithmetic on the phone the owner is holding.** 375×667. The sheet at its tallest is ≈600pt; minus the 52pt header bar; minus a decimal keypad (~215–260pt) the moment `Цена` takes focus → **≈290pt of live content.** The services region sits below the date group and below the frame. **An inline editor opening there is born below the fold and then shoved under the keyboard.** There is no styling that fixes that, because it is not a styling problem — it is a subtraction. NN/g measured the consequence rather than asserting it: users spend _"about 57% of their page-viewing time above the fold"_, and accordions on mobile _"can also cause disorientation and too much scrolling."_

**2 · Auto-scroll does not rescue it, and the reason is the decisive part of the whole argument.** A tap-to-reveal owes three things: the anchor stays visible, the revealed content comes into view, and the way back maps onto the reveal. **Auto-scroll satisfies the second by breaking the first**, and NN/g documents the backfire exactly — moving the expanded content to the top _"mak[es] the users think that they navigated to a new page"_, after which they press Back expecting a collapse and leave the surface entirely. NN/g's own repairs for a mobile accordion are: a sticky control, Back that collapses, and content that fills the viewport.

> **Those three are the defining properties of a pushed screen. If the fix for inline expansion is to simulate navigation, then navigate.** A real push gets the sticky bar, the Back button, the viewport, the focus move, the scroll restore and the screen-reader page announcement for free — and not one of them can be got subtly wrong.

**3 · Five of five competitors converged, and none of them expands inline.** Fresha: _"tap on a service to open the edit service view."_ Phorest: _"Tap the service you want to edit. Tap Edit service… tap on any of the fields on the next screen."_ Square, Mangomint and Vagaro give the service its own screen too. **5/5 give the service a surface of its own. 0/5 expand the row beneath itself.** §1.4's cross-vendor table was read for its _fields_ and not for its _containers_; read for containers it says one thing unanimously.

**4 · Apple's own event editor already contains this exact taxonomy, and we were reading half of it.** Its rows split into two families and never mix them: a **value with a spatial editor of its own** (Starts, Ends) expands **in place**; a **multi-field sub-object** (Travel Time, Invitees, Time Zone) **pushes a page**. Price + duration + barber + a destructive verb is the second family, and the HIG says so in the imperative: _"If you need to let people drill into a list or table **row's subviews**, use a **disclosure indicator** accessory control."_ Back-inside-a-sheet is a named, specified thing in the same document: _"Back — Navigates to a previous step in a multi-step flow; not intended to dismiss a sheet."_

**The four mechanics, re-judged.** The old table's three refusals stand; only its `✓` moves.

| Mechanic                                                          | Verdict, 2026-08-26                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ui-menu` anchored to the row                                     | ✗ — a menu presents _"a command, option, or state"_; menus never host text entry, and price is typed money                                                                                                                                                              |
| Popover anchored to the row                                       | ✗ — _"Avoid displaying popovers in compact views… use all available screen space by presenting information in a full-screen modal view like a sheet instead."_ At 375pt a popover **is** a bottom sheet, which is the nested picker this section already killed         |
| Nested `ui-modal-sheet` / `ui-detent-sheet`                       | ✗ — _"Display only one sheet at a time… close the first before displaying the new one."_ And `ui-detent-sheet` is the **non-modal** sheet — no scrim, no focus trap, no `aria-modal` — so stacking it over a modal sheet is the anti-pattern with a second scrim on top |
| Inline expansion in the same scroll view                          | ✗ **(was ✓)** — the fold arithmetic above, plus _"Use no more than one disclosure button in a single view"_, and a per-row expander in a repeated list is **N** of them                                                                                                 |
| **A pushed page in the sheet's own nav stack, depth exactly one** | **✓**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

#### The law that keeps this from contradicting §3.5

This is the objection a reviewer raises first, so it is answered before it is raised. §3.5's date calendar expands **inline**, in the same scroll view, from its own pill (Ruling A, 2026-08-26). This section pushes a page. Both are right, and they are the same doctrine:

> **A _value_ with a spatial editor of its own expands in place. A _row that owns several values_ pushes a page.**

The date is **one** value and a calendar is its picture; it expands. A service is **three** values plus a destructive verb; it travels. Apple obeys exactly this split inside one sheet — Starts expands, Travel Time pushes — and so do we. **R3's picker clause survives, narrowed to pickers, which is what it always said:** _"the picker expands in place, beneath its own row, inside the same scroll view."_ Nothing about time pushes; nothing about a sub-object expands. `⌄` and `›` are not two styles of the same idea — they are the two halves of this law, and §3.6.2 makes the glyph carry it.

### 3.6.2 Anatomy — the service row

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Класическо подстригване                             │  52px, two lines
│  30 мин · 20,00 €                                ›   │  → pushes a page
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤  full-bleed seam
│  Оформяне на брада                                   │
│  15 мин · 8,00 € · Нико                          ›   │  barber named ONLY
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤  when it differs
│  ＋ Добави услуга                                    │  → pushes the search
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
( ● Един след друг )  ( Едновременно )                    only when ≥2 legs
```

_Gloss: `Добави услуга` add a service · `Един след друг / Едновременно` one after another / at the same time._

```html
<ul uiListGroup [attr.aria-label]="t('staff.visit.services')">
  @for (leg of legs(); track leg.id) {
  <li>
    <button
      uiListRow
      uiSize="large"
      uiAlignment="leading"
      [uiInteractive]="true"
      (click)="pushService(leg.id)"
      [attr.aria-label]="legName(leg)"
      [attr.aria-description]="t('staff.visit.editService')"
    >
      <ui-stack uiSpacing="none">
        <span uiText uiFont="callout" uiWeight="medium">{{ leg.name }}</span>
        <span
          uiText
          uiFont="footnote"
          uiForegroundStyle="secondary"
          class="staff-sheet__figures"
          >{{ legLine(leg) }}</span
        >
      </ui-stack>
      <span uiTrailing
        ><ui-icon uiName="nav.disclosure" aria-hidden="true"
      /></span>
    </button>
  </li>
  }
  <li>
    <button
      uiListRow
      uiSize="large"
      [uiInteractive]="true"
      (click)="pushServiceSearch()"
    >
      <span uiLeading><ui-icon uiName="action.add" aria-hidden="true" /></span>
      {{ t('staff.visit.addService') }}
    </button>
  </li>
</ul>
```

Every input above is real: `uiSize` / `uiAlignment` / `uiInteractive` / `uiVariant` on `ui-list-row` ([list-row.ts:97-104](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-row/list-row.ts:97)), whose selector already accepts `button[uiListRow]` and `li[uiListRow]` ([list-row.ts:75](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-row/list-row.ts:75)); `[uiLeading]` and `[uiTrailing]` are its two projected slots ([list-row.ts:77-79](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-row/list-row.ts:77)); `uiSpacing="none"` is a real `ui-stack` value ([stack.ts:9-13](../../libs/ui/layout/src/lib/stack/stack.ts:9)); `nav.disclosure` → `chevron_right` ([icon-registry.ts:106](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/icon/icon-registry.ts:106)) and `action.add` → `add` ([icon-registry.ts:126](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/icon/icon-registry.ts:126)) are both already registered. **Nothing here is a new component.** That is the point of the reversal, not a side effect of it.

| Part                   | Treatment                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | Token / key            |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------- |
| Row                    | `button[uiListRow] uiSize="large" uiAlignment="leading"` — 52px, two lines, the whole row is the target                                                                                                                                                   | `--control-size-large` |
| Line 1                 | the service name, `--sys-font-callout` ([tokens.css:27](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:27)), weight 500, ellipsised at one line                                                                                                                          | —                      |
| Line 2                 | `{{minutes}} мин · {{price}}` + `· {{barber}}` **only when the leg's barber differs from the frame's chair**, `--sys-color-secondary-label` ([theme-light.css:22](../../libs/ui/tokens/theme-light.css:22)), `.staff-sheet__figures` for tabular numerals | `serviceLine`          |
| Overridden price       | the catalogue price beside it — `18,00 € (беше 20,00 €)` — through the surviving `moneyWas` shape, plus the `по избор` marker until saved                                                                                                                 | `priceOverridden`      |
| Trailing               | `ui-icon uiName="nav.disclosure"`, `aria-hidden` — the name is composed on the row, never spelled twice                                                                                                                                                   | —                      |
| Last row               | `＋ Добави услуга`, `action.add` in `[uiLeading]`, pushes the search page                                                                                                                                                                                 | `addService`           |
| **No** `✕`             | removal is a destructive row at the bottom of the service's own page (§3.6.3)                                                                                                                                                                             | —                      |
| **No** `aria-expanded` | deliberate: this row does not expand, and lying about it is worse than saying nothing                                                                                                                                                                     | —                      |

**Glyph discipline is load-bearing, and it is the whole of §3.6.1's law rendered at 20px.** `⌄` (`field.expand` → `arrow_drop_down`, [icon-registry.ts:118](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/icon/icon-registry.ts:118)) means _a menu drops here, or a picker opens here_. `›` (`nav.disclosure`) means _you go somewhere and come back_. A barber learns in one tap which rows travel, and after that he never has to guess again. **R2's three-mark chevron contract survives, narrowed to rows and re-pointed:** `›` no longer means "a separate sheet"; it means "a page inside this sheet's nav stack".

**R9 is re-cut a third time, and the sentence-not-form grammar is what survives each time.** It was the honesty line; then the token's value cell; it is now the row's **second line**. `с Нико · 8,00 €` becomes `15 мин · 8,00 € · Нико`, and the barber is named **only when the leg's barber differs from the chair the frame is drawing** — because when they all agree, the frame's owner header (§3.7) has already said it once and repeating it on every row is the duplication comments 2 and 7 objected to.

**The domain carries every field these rows read.** Each leg holds its own `barberId`, `startsAt` and `terms` ([seat.ts:59-75](../../libs/domain/scheduling/src/lib/seat.ts:59)), so _"Иван does the cut, Нико does the beard"_ is representable today, with no aggregate change.

### 3.6.3 The service page — pushed, depth one, no second commit

```
┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
│              ▁▁▁▁▁▁                   │  the same grabber, the same sheet
│  ‹                                    │  icon-only back · trailing EMPTY
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Класическо подстригване              │  large title = the service
│  10:00 – 10:45 · Иван                 │  consequence strip — live, quiet
│                                       │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │  Бръснар               Иван  ⌄  │  │  44 · ui-menu row
│  ├─────────────────────────────────┤  │
│  │  Времетраене         45 мин  ⌄  │  │  44 · ui-menu row, the §3.5 ladder
│  ├─────────────────────────────────┤  │
│  │  Цена                 28,00 €   │  │  44 · ui-text-field row
│  ├─────────────────────────────────┤  │
│  │  Още                         ⌄  │  │  Подготовка 5 мин · Разчистване 10 мин
│  └─────────────────────────────────┘  │
│                                       │
│  Промяната на времето не променя      │  once, on the first duration edit
│  цената.                              │
│                                       │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │  Премахни услугата              │  │  destructive, bottom of the scroll
│  └─────────────────────────────────┘  │
└───────────────────────────────────────┘
```

_Gloss: `Бръснар` barber · `Времетраене` duration · `Цена` price · `Още` more · `Подготовка` setup · `Разчистване` cleanup · `Промяната на времето не променя цената.` "Changing the time does not change the price." · `Премахни услугата` remove the service._

| Field               | Control                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Why this control                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Бръснар`           | `ui-menu` on the row — value + `field.expand` — while the shop has ≲8 barbers                                                                                                                                               | SwiftUI `Picker(.menu)`; Apple's own threshold is _"if a submenu contains more than about five items, consider creating a new menu"_. Fed by `CatalogReader.listActiveBarbers` ([catalog-reader.port.ts:31](../../libs/application/catalog/src/lib/ports/catalog-reader.port.ts:31)), already injected                                    |
| `Времетраене`       | `ui-menu`, `role="menuitemradio"`, the **same ladder §3.5 builds** (`S−2g … S+2g`, capped at 8, `Друго…` last)                                                                                                              | bounded and named ⇒ menu shape. `UiMenuItem` already emits the conditional role from `uiSelected()` ([menu.ts:53](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/menu/menu.ts:53)). **Not `ui-stepper`** — that is a `role="progressbar"` over step ordinals ([stepper.ts:66](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/stepper/stepper.ts:66)) and must not be bent |
| `Цена`              | `input[uiTextField] inputmode="decimal"` ([text-field.ts:11](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/text-field/text-field.ts:11)), EUR suffix, re-rendered through `formatMoney` on blur → `28,00 €`                                | _"tap in a field to type new information"_                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `Още`               | one disclosure holding setup / cleanup / add-ons                                                                                                                                                                            | it is the only place an add-on's minutes are seen — see **Add-ons** below                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `Премахни услугата` | destructive `button[uiListRow]` + `[uiForegroundStyle]="'destructive'"` ([foreground.directive.ts:10-11](../../libs/ui/modifiers/src/lib/foreground.directive.ts:10)), **at the bottom of the scroll**, never in the header | Calendar parity: _"tap Delete Event at the bottom of the screen"_. `UiListRowVariant` has no destructive member ([list-row.ts:10](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-row/list-row.ts:10)) and `uiRole` is a `uiButton` input, so the modifier is the correct carrier                                                                     |

**The consequence strip solves the one genuine argument inline expansion had.** Inline kept the frame visible, so a duration change showed its own effect. Rather than keep the parent on screen, **carry the consequence into the child**: `.staff-sheet__consequence` **[new]** is a non-interactive line under the child's large title, `--sys-color-tertiary-label` ([theme-light.css:23](../../libs/ui/tokens/theme-light.css:23)), live. On a duration change it animates to the new range and shows the delta for ~2s — `10:00 – 10:30 · Иван    −15 мин`. **This beats a popover on its own terms:** it shows the _changed_ value, not the stale one behind glass.

**Commit — one boundary for the whole modal task.** Menu selections write on select; `Цена` on blur or `Enter`. **There is no `Готово`, no `Готово`-shaped button, no `Приложи` and no `Отказ` on the child.** The HIG's reason is the exact hazard: _"avoid including buttons that people might mistake for the button that dismisses the modal view."_ Fresha's two-stage `Apply → Save` is both the precedent and the warning; Phorest's single commit is the cleaner half of the corpus. `Запази` in the dock stays the only thing that reaches the server.

> **REVERSED, 2026-08-26.** §3.6.4's ruling 3 read _"Two-level commit survives. `Готово` folds the override into the draft… **`apply` is renamed `done` = `Готово`.**"_ That is withdrawn and `staff.visit.done` is deleted from the catalogue. **R10 is re-amended a second time:** Fresha's field ladder is still stolen field for field — onto a pushed page, not inline and still not a sheet — and its **two-level commit is now rejected outright** rather than adopted.

**Dismissal, and it is not negotiable.** `‹` pops. A leading-edge swipe pops. **A swipe-down on the child pops to root; it does not close the sheet** — the sheet's own dismiss gesture is suspended while a child is presented, because _"Back… is not intended to dismiss a sheet."_ `Escape` pops the child; only at root does `Escape` close. Browser Back pops the child, because a history entry is pushed — which is NN/g's _"Back should collapse the accordion"_ honoured natively, for free, because it **is** navigation.

**Focus.** On push, focus moves to the child container (`tabindex="-1"`, labelled by its title) — **not** to the first control, so `Цена` cannot steal a keyboard on entry. On pop, focus returns to the originating row with `scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'})` only if it is off-screen. **One focus trap, on the sheet, never two.** `role="dialog"` and `aria-modal` stay on the sheet and are not repeated on the page.

**Screen reader.** After a menu selection a polite region announces the value and its consequence: _"Времетраене 30 минути. Край 10:30."_ **There is no live region on pop** — focus lands on the row whose accessible name now reads the new values, so the change is announced as a consequence of the focus move. That is the quiet elegance push has and expand does not.

**Motion.** The child enters from the trailing edge over ~300ms (`--sys-motion-duration-deliberate`, [tokens.css:205](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:205)) on `--sys-motion-ease-emphasized` ([tokens.css:215](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:215)); the root translates −30% with a 4% dim (`--sys-elevation-overlay`, [tokens.css:195](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:195)) and goes `inert`, keeping its scroll offset and its rendered frame — **no unmount, no re-layout, no reflow of the drawn block.** `prefers-reduced-motion` → a 150ms cross-fade with no translation.

**Detent.** If the sheet is resting at `[fitted]` when the row is tapped, promote it to full height first (~180ms), then push. **Do not restore the smaller detent on pop** — a sheet that yo-yos once per navigation is worse than one that stays tall.

> **Ruling: depth is exactly one, everywhere, and that is a law rather than a guideline.** _"If a modal task must contain subviews, provide a single path through the hierarchy."_ The service page, the add-service search, the client page, the add-client search and the promo pages are **all level 1**. **Nothing pushes from a pushed page.** The moment something wants to, it wants to be a different screen, and this sheet is not the place for it.

**Documented escape hatch, one line, so nobody re-litigates it at desk width.** At ≥768px — the tablet and desktop staff view — the same authored child content re-hosts in a **popover anchored to its row**, because the HIG's popover ban is compact-only: _"Reserve popovers for wide views."_ **One authored child, two presentations**, and the phone never sees the popover.

**Role gate: `Цена` is ABSENT for a `barber`, not disabled.** The row simply is not on the page. A barber may stretch his own time; he may not discount the shop's money — the same three-role list `firestore.rules` already uses ([firestore.rules:96-97](../../firestore.rules:96)). **A row that is absent is honest; a row that is disabled is a promise.**

**A duration override is a snapshot, and the copy says so.** Vagaro's rule is the domain justification for per-leg overrides existing at all: _price changes never affect appointments booked before them._ `ServiceTerms` is already that snapshot ([service-terms.ts:45](../../libs/domain/catalog/src/lib/service-terms.ts:45)) and `appointmentToDocument` persists it verbatim, field by field ([appointment-document.ts:67-72](../../libs/application/booking/src/lib/ports/appointment-document.ts:67)). **R11 is unchanged: price never moves with duration**, and `staff.visit.durationKeepsPrice` still fires exactly once, on the first duration edit.

**A conflict born here is shown here.** If a duration change on this page creates an overlap, the warning renders **on this page**, under `Времетраене`, and the consequence strip goes to the overrun tint. The barber sees it before he returns, not after. The dock's `Запази въпреки застъпването` relabel is §3.3.9's, unchanged.

### 3.6.4 Adding a service — the pushed search page

R13 and R26 both survive this reversal in full. **Only their container changed** — from the field's own popup to a page one level deep.

```
┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
│  ‹                                    │
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Добави услуга                        │  large title
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │  подстр▏                        │  │  role="combobox", autofocus
│  └─────────────────────────────────┘  │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │ ☑ Класическо подстригване       │  │  30 мин · 20,00 €
│  ├─────────────────────────────────┤  │  the page STAYS on select
│  │ ☐ Подстригване с машинка        │  │  20 мин · 15,00 €
│  ├─────────────────────────────────┤  │
│  │ ☐ Детско подстригване           │  │  20 мин · 14,00 €
│  └─────────────────────────────────┘  │
│  Комбинирани                          │  rowgroup label
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │ ⊘ Пакет          Не се комбинира │  │  blocked, not selectable
│  └─────────────────────────────────┘  │
└───────────────────────────────────────┘
```

> **Ruling: the results are a `ul[uiListGroup]` of `button[uiListRow] [uiSelected]` rows, not an APG grid popup.** The grid-combobox construction existed to solve _"a popup that must show `име │ мин │ цена` between a field and a keyboard"_. **There is no popup any more** — the results own the viewport — so the sanctioned construction for the thing we actually have is a list of multi-select rows. `uiSelected` is a real input ([list-row.ts:104](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-row/list-row.ts:104)) and is documented as _visual only_, so the checked state is carried honestly by `aria-checked` on a `role="checkbox"` row, not inferred from a tint.

> **Ruling: the rows carry checkboxes and the page stays open on select.** This is where **R13 lands, unchanged in substance.** Roselli rejects `listbox` + `aria-multiselectable` outright — _"tested poorly with users for more than two decades"_ — and recommends stacked checkboxes; Higley's numbers agree for small option sets. A barbershop catalogue is ~10–40 services. **A barber adding cut + beard + wash must not reopen a list three times**, which was Linear's rule when this lived in a popup and is the page's rule now. `‹` returns with everything he ticked.

**The keystroke loop, re-homed from the old §3.6.3.** Everything that was about _typing_ survives; everything that was about _tokens_ is gone.

| Event           | Behaviour                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| 1st character   | Results narrow immediately. The catalogue is resident, so services open on the **first** character; `SearchUsersUseCase`'s two-character minimum (`MIN_QUERY_LENGTH = 2`, [search-users.use-case.ts:9](../../libs/application/governance/src/lib/use-cases/search-users.use-case.ts:9)) governs the **client** page only |
| Ranking         | **category order then `sortOrder`** for services; **recency + frequency** for people (Outlook's MRU model). Never alphabetical                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `↓` / `↑`       | walks the result rows with focus staying in the field, `aria-activedescendant`; **we scroll the active row into view ourselves** — _"Browsers do not manage visibility of elements referenced by `aria-activedescendant`"_                                                                                               |
| **`Enter`**     | toggles the active row. With no active row and a non-empty query it takes the first result, or the create row where one is offered. **There is never a keystroke that does nothing** (R26)                                                                                                                               |
| **Tap**         | toggles, and **the page stays**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `Escape`        | first press clears the query; **second press pops the page.** The order is deliberate — `Escape` never throws away a page of ticks while there is still text to clear                                                                                                                                                    |
| Blur            | nothing. There is no pending text to resolve, because there is no token to mint                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **`Backspace`** | edits text. **Always.** The entire Downshift `preventKeyAction` guard, and the Fluent silent-removal bug class it existed to dodge, are **deleted along with the token run** — there is no token behind the caret to eat                                                                                                 |
| `;`             | **deleted.** Outlook's separator existed to commit a token mid-string; a checkbox list has no separator                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

**⚠ `cr-service-card` and `ui-grid[uiColumns]="2"` still leave this surface**, and `uiSelectionIndicator` still goes with them — that part of the old §3.6.5 is unaffected by the reversal. What is reused from [`booking-services-step`](../../libs/features/client/booking/src/lib/services-step/booking-services-step.ts) is its **predicates, not its cards**: `servicesConflict` ([service-conflicts.ts:68](../../libs/domain/catalog/src/lib/service-conflicts.ts:68)) → `conflictingWith` ([:102](../../libs/domain/catalog/src/lib/service-conflicts.ts:102)) → `selectabilityFor` ([:112](../../libs/domain/catalog/src/lib/service-conflicts.ts:112)), rendered through `blockersFor` / `isBlocked` ([booking-services-step.ts:208-230](../../libs/features/client/booking/src/lib/services-step/booking-services-step.ts:208)) with the shipped copy `booking.services.blockedBadge` = `Не се комбинира` ([bg.json:270](../../libs/infrastructure/i18n/src/assets/i18n/bg.json:270)). **Scope is one seat, by signature** — a Father & Son bundle stays legal when two guests each hold one member. The staff sheet still writes **no new conflict logic**; the same predicate already guards the server at [decide-booking.ts:299](../../apps/functions/src/use-cases/decide-booking.ts:299). A blocked row renders `⊘` and is not selectable, exactly as today.

> ⚠ **The custom, non-catalogue service is still designed and still GATED, and the gate is unchanged by the reversal.** `SeatProps.serviceId: ServiceId` is **non-nullable** ([seat.ts:62](../../libs/domain/scheduling/src/lib/seat.ts:62)), so _"беше и вежди, 5 лева"_ has nowhere to live. Notion's type-it-and-it-exists and Shopify's `Add custom item` are the right shapes and **neither is expressible today.** Ruling: the `⊕ Добави „вежди“ като еднократна услуга` row **does not render** until `serviceId` is nullable or a `SERVICE_CUSTOM` sentinel exists — a domain change, **size M, M9**, and **Q20**. Until then the no-match state is one sentence and nothing else. **It is now a row on a page rather than a token in a field; the gate, the size and the reason are identical.** A create row that cannot commit is the disabled promise this document keeps refusing.

**Outlook's three-state underline dies with the field it was drawn under.** `data-unresolved` and `data-ambiguous` are deleted, and so are `tokenNoMatch`'s ambiguity siblings. **There is no unresolved text on this surface any more**, because nothing is minted from free text: you either tick a catalogue row or you do not. The green-dotted _"I guessed"_ state was the best idea in the old field and it is **honestly obsolete** — its whole job was to confess that `Enter` had picked something for you, and a checkbox does not pick for you. The `no matches` state is `Няма услуга „{{query}}“.` as a single row, and `tokenNoMatch` survives renamed `noMatch`.

### 3.6.5 Every state

**Empty (a new appointment).** The group holds `＋ Добави услуга` and nothing else. No placeholder row, no ghost token, no zero-price line. `Пари` reads `0,00 €`. The dock's label is the reason: `Избери услуга`, never a greyed `Запази`.

**One service.** One row, `›`, and the add row. The arrangement chips do **not** render — there is nothing to arrange.

**Two or more.** The rows in leg order, then the add row, then the arrangement pair beneath the group.

**Overridden.** The second line carries `18,00 € (беше 20,00 €)` and the `по избор` marker until `Запази`. The row is otherwise identical — **an override is a value, not a state of the row.**

**Offline.** The rows are fully live and so is the service page: both edit a draft and neither needs the network. The **search page** serves the cached catalogue and says so — `Няма връзка — показваме запаметения каталог.` **"No results" is never rendered offline.** Those are the two answers a barber must never be left to tell apart. The refusal happens **once**, at the commit slot.

**Permission-denied (`barber`).** `Цена` is absent from the service page. The rows, the search and the durations are untouched.

**Settled / cancelled.** The rows render as read rows: no `›`, no chevron, not buttons. `＋ Добави услуга` is **absent**. **No pushed page can be opened from a settled sheet**, which is enforced by the rows not being interactive rather than by a guard inside the page. One footnote says why.

### 3.6.6 The accessibility contract, in full

The old contract discharged a burden of proof for an unsanctioned pattern. **That burden is gone with the pattern**, which is the honest headline of this section: what follows is shorter because the construction is standard, not because the standard was lowered.

```html
<!-- root page -->
<ul uiListGroup [attr.aria-label]="t('staff.visit.services')">
  @for (leg of legs(); track leg.id) {
  <li>
    <button
      uiListRow
      uiSize="large"
      uiAlignment="leading"
      [uiInteractive]="true"
      [attr.aria-label]="legName(leg)"
      [attr.aria-description]="t('staff.visit.editService')"
      (click)="pushService(leg.id)"
    >
      …
    </button>
  </li>
  }
</ul>

<!-- pushed page -->
<section
  uiSheetPage="service"
  tabindex="-1"
  [attr.aria-labelledby]="pageTitleId()"
>
  <h2 [id]="pageTitleId()">{{ openLeg().name }}</h2>
  <p class="staff-sheet__consequence">
    {{ t('staff.visit.serviceConsequence', …) }}
  </p>
  …
</section>
<p role="status" aria-live="polite" uiVisuallyHidden>
  {{ pageAnnouncement() }}
</p>
```

`[uiVisuallyHidden]` is a real directive ([visually-hidden.directive.ts:11](../../libs/ui/modifiers/src/lib/visually-hidden.directive.ts:11)). `uiSheetPage` is **new** — §3.6.7.

| Requirement                | Decision                                                                                                                         | Why                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| -------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| The row's accessible name  | **composed** — _"Класическо подстригване, 45 минути, 28,00 евро, Иван"_ — with a description of _"Отваря редактора на услугата"_ | one name per row; the two visual lines are one object, and AT should hear it as one                                                                                                                                                  |
| `aria-expanded` on the row | **absent, deliberately**                                                                                                         | the row does not expand. A truthful silence beats a false state                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Role of the run            | **a real `ul` > `li`** — `ui-list-group` renders them already                                                                    | AT counts stay real and each run is a named list, which the token `role="grid"` had to fake                                                                                                                                          |
| Role of the search results | **`role="checkbox"` rows in a list**, `aria-checked` bound                                                                       | Roselli's recommendation, unmediated. `uiSelected` paints; it does not announce ([list-row.ts:101-104](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-row/list-row.ts:101))                                                                     |
| Focus trap                 | **exactly one, on the sheet**                                                                                                    | `role="dialog"` / `aria-modal` stay on the sheet; a pushed page is a region inside it, never a second dialog                                                                                                                         |
| Focus on push              | the **page container**, not the first control                                                                                    | a decimal keypad on entry is a keyboard nobody asked for                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Focus on pop               | the **originating row**, whose name now reads the new values                                                                     | the change announces itself as a consequence of the focus move — **no live region on pop**                                                                                                                                           |
| Live region                | **`polite`, exactly one, shared** by selection announcements and consequences                                                    | react-select's `assertive` region **suppresses the field's own label announcement** ([JedWatson/react-select#3353](https://github.com/JedWatson/react-select/issues/3353))                                                           |
| Removal announcement       | `„Оформяне на брада“ е премахната. Остават 2 услуги.`                                                                            | the copy survives the reversal; the trigger moved from a `✕` to the page's destructive row                                                                                                                                           |
| Layout-change announcement | on push and on pop                                                                                                               | _"Inform VoiceOver when visible content or layout changes occur."_ Navigation is exactly that, and the platform primitive already exists for it                                                                                      |
| Target size                | **the whole 52px row**, plus 44×44 for every control on the page                                                                 | Primer **documents its own small/medium tokens failing** WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8's 24×24 floor and says they _"should not be used for removable interactive tokens"_ — an argument that ends when the tokens do                            |
| Hover                      | none required. Every affordance is permanently visible                                                                           | the standing repo rule applies: hover `@media (hover: hover)`-gated ([modifiers.css:227-235](../../libs/ui/modifiers/modifiers.css:227)), **`:active` ungated** ([modifiers.css:243-250](../../libs/ui/modifiers/modifiers.css:243)) |

**The Sentry ticket that justified the token's `⌄` is answered better by the page.** Sentry's power users filed [getsentry/sentry#82395](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/issues/82395) asking for a plain-text escape because tokenisation destroyed fast editing. Our old answer was _"every token opens"_. **Our answer now is that nothing was tokenised in the first place** — the values live on rows, and rows are reachable by `Tab`, by `↓`, by VoiceOver rotor and by tap without a single custom key handler.

### 3.6.7 The design-system work — one primitive born, two cancelled

> **Ruling: `span[uiToken]` (`ui-token`) and `[uiCombobox]` are CANCELLED as staff-sheet dependencies, 2026-08-26.** Neither has a consumer on this surface any more. `[uiCombobox]`'s entire justification was _"serving both token fields off one contract"_ — **there are no token fields.** The APG grid-combobox popup goes with it, and so does §3.6.1's old burden-of-proof argument and the a11y discharge that answered it.

> **This is a net simplification and it should be stated as one in review.** The twelve comments replace **two novel, unstandardised primitives** — a combobox-with-tokens pattern the APG has had open as [w3c/aria-practices#1512](https://github.com/w3c/aria-practices/issues/1512) since 3 September 2020, whose two largest shipping implementations both carry known unfixed defects and one of which (Primer's `TextInputWithTokens`) **is deprecated and being removed** — with **navigation**, which every platform solved decades ago. `ui-token`, `[uiCombobox]`, `uiToken`, `uiSheetPage` and any `SheetNav` symbol are all **verified absent from `libs/ui` today**; only one of them now needs to exist.

**Born: `ui-sheet-nav`** — a new `libs/ui/patterns` component that owns the page stack inside a modal sheet. It owns the stack, the header swap (leading `‹` plus title), the enter/exit transition with its `prefers-reduced-motion` branch, `inert` on the root page, the focus move and restore, the history entry, and the `Escape` / edge-swipe / swipe-down routing. Consumers project `<ng-template uiSheetPage="…">`. **It needs two additions to things that already exist:** `[uiLeading]` on `ui-sheet-header`, which today projects only `[uiTitle]` and `[uiTrailing]` ([sheet-header.ts:71-72](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/sheet-header/sheet-header.ts:71)), and the `[sheet-action]` slot on `ui-modal-sheet`, already planned — whose sibling `[sheet-accessory]` slot already ships ([modal-sheet.html:67](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/modal-sheet/modal-sheet.html:67)) and is what comment 4's summary strip lands in.

**Size: M for the pattern, and it is a hard dependency of M3**, because M5, M6 and M7 all push pages. It cannot be scheduled later than the first surface that needs it.

**The one open dependency this creates, stated so it is not discovered in a standup.** `/book`'s `.booking-seat-pill` was going to be retired by `ui-token` — its own template calls its hidden removal _"a secret"_ ([booking-services-step.html:87-93](../../libs/features/client/booking/src/lib/services-step/booking-services-step.html:87)). **That migration target disappears from this document's critical path.** `ui-token` should still be built, **for `/book`**, with a visible `✕` as the fix; it simply is no longer a dependency of the staff sheet and it moves out of M6 into the `/book` backlog.

**What `ui-chip` is left holding, and it is exactly right for all of it.** `ui-chip` is `selector: 'button[uiChip]'` ([chip.ts:11](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/chip/chip.ts:11)) with **two inputs** — `uiSelected` and `uiControlSize` ([chip.ts:27-28](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/chip/chip.ts:27)) — and a permanent `aria-pressed` host binding ([chip.ts:23](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/chip/chip.ts:23)). That is a toggle button and nothing else, which is why bending it into a two-cell token row was refused and why `uiChipRole="token"` stays withdrawn. On this surface it now has **exactly three jobs**, and each is a genuine toggle: the arrangement pair, the applied-promo run in `ПАРИ`, and §3.5's relative date row. **Anything that wanted a value cell, a `✕` or a second control is a row now.**

### 3.6.8 §3.7, amended — the clients field is this grammar, minus the barbers

Everything in §3.6.2–§3.6.6 applies unchanged. **Only the sources, the second line and the pushed page's contents differ — and the people field no longer holds barbers at all** (comments 2 + 7, §3.7).

|                          | Services                                                                 | Clients                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| The run                  | `button[uiListRow]` per leg + `＋ Добави услуга`                         | `button[uiListRow]` per client + `＋ Добави клиент`                                                                                                                                           |
| Sources                  | the resident catalogue                                                   | `UserSearchPort.search` ([user-search.port.ts:12-17](../../libs/application/governance/src/lib/ports/user-search.port.ts:12)) **only** — `/barbers` no longer feeds this field                |
