| Line 2                   | `{{minutes}} мин · {{price}}` `[· {{barber}}]`                           | `{{phone}}` + `Нов` / `2 неявявания` as a `span[uiBadge]` ([badge.ts:48-50](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/badge/badge.ts:48))                                                                |
| Second target in the row | none                                                                     | `a[uiButton][href^="tel:"] [uiIconOnly]` — **a peer target, not the row's action.** Tapping `☎` calls; tapping anywhere else pushes                                                           |
| Search page              | checkbox multi-select, catalogue rows, `⊕` create row **gated** (§3.6.4) | single-select, `⊕ Нов клиент „{{query}}“` **always last, always the literal typed text** (R26, unchanged)                                                                                     |
| Pushed page              | barber · duration · price · `Още` · remove                               | phone · last visit · no-shows · `↺ Същото като миналия път` · `Без клиент (на място)` · remove                                                                                                |
| Role gate                | `Цена` absent for `barber`                                               | the client **search** falls back to guest-only for `barber` until the `searchClients` callable ships (Q16). **Never an error** — a failure message trains a retry that will always be refused |

**Two rulings survive verbatim across all three re-cuts, and are restated here so they cannot be lost with the container that carried them:**

- **The client on a party of one is never removable.** Its remove row is **absent** from the client page, replaced by `Без клиент (на място)`, which clears `BookingContact` and swaps the subject to `SeatSubject.anonymous`.
- **A participant whose seat has a resolved outcome is not removable** — decidable row by row via `isResolved` ([transition-appointment.ts:87-92](../../apps/functions/src/lib/booking/transition-appointment.ts:87)). Its remove row is absent, it carries a status glyph, and it routes to the existing per-seat cancel path.

### 3.6.9 What navigation deletes — the geometry problem, closed

> **REVERSED, 2026-08-26.** This section used to rule: _"focusing either token field collapses the `Кога` disclosure to its one-line summary"_, because _"with the keyboard up on a 375×812 phone there is ~476px of sheet, and a 240px frame plus a field pair plus a height-capped suggestion grid does not fit."_ **The whole problem is deleted rather than solved.**

There is no suggestion popup to fit between a field and a keyboard, because the results own a page. There is no `Кога` disclosure to collapse, because comment 11 deleted the region titles and comment 5 left only the date's own calendar expanding from its own pill. **The one remaining rule is smaller and stronger:**

> **Ruling: pushing a page suspends everything behind it, and the root page keeps its scroll offset and its rendered frame.** The root goes `inert`; the calendar stays exactly as open or as closed as it was; nothing above the services group moves, before or after. On pop, the barber is looking at the same pixels he left, with one row's values changed.

The old formulation's one durable clause survives, re-pointed: **§3.5's typed path — `Начало` and `Времетраене` — may never be hidden behind a disclosure, a preference, a toggle or a breakpoint** (WCAG SC 2.5.7). A pushed page is not a disclosure over that path; it is a different screen entirely, and the path is intact the moment you return.

### Add-ons

Attached **to a service**, offered as a checkbox list inside that service page's `Още` disclosure (Acuity's exact placement, including admin-only items), each labelled with its deltas. **Orthogonal** (Booksy): a `+5 мин` add-on with no price shows only the time delta. **The placement is unchanged by the reversal — `Още` simply lives on a page now instead of inside an expansion.**

**An add-on extends its parent leg's duration rather than becoming a separate leg** (Fresha's rule). The frame grows by exactly the add-on's minutes and the block stays **one** drag target and **one** tap target. Phorest's three-visual-blocks approach is wrong on a phone. **R14 stands, with one addition** (§4.1 M2): a **zero-minute** add-on changes no geometry and stays a Regime A write; a duration-bearing one seeds the draft.

**⚠ There is no add-on relation in the catalog.** `upsellOnly` exists as a **real constructor property on the `Service` entity** ([service.ts:116](../../libs/domain/catalog/src/lib/service.ts:116)) — not merely view-model data; the VM reads it straight through ([catalog-vm.ts:67](../../libs/features/shared/catalog/src/lib/content/catalog-vm.ts:67), mapped at [catalog-to-vm.ts:105](../../libs/features/shared/catalog/src/lib/content/catalog-to-vm.ts:105)) and marketing uses it to _exclude_ those services from the shelf ([landing-content.service.ts:94](../../libs/features/marketing/landing/src/lib/content/landing-content.service.ts:94)). It says a service is an add-on; it does not say **what it attaches to**. `Service.upsellsFor` **does not exist**.

> **Ruling: the attachment relation is new and it is a catalog change, not a booking change.** `Service.upsellsFor: readonly ServiceId[]` on the domain entity, a mirrored `upsellsFor` array on the service document, an admin editor in the catalog surface, and a data pass over the existing `upsellOnly: true` rows to say which cuts each one hangs off. **Size M**, and it is a **prerequisite** for the add-on list — not a line item inside it. Until it ships, the interim heuristic is the honest one: **every `upsellOnly` service in the same category as the chosen service, ordered by `sortOrder`**, which the existing `services (categoryId, status, sortOrder)` index already serves. Say in the design that it is a heuristic; do not ship it pretending to be a curated list.

### The stacking model

| Arrangement                          | Frame rendering                                                                                                                                                               | Handles                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Sequential legs, one barber**      | **one block with internal seams** — 1px `--sys-color-separator` hairlines at each boundary, each leg labelled when its drawn height clears the label floor                    | top handle changes the start and therefore the **first** leg's duration; bottom handle changes the end and therefore the **last** leg's. One sentence, no special case for a single leg — _"the wash ran long"_ is exactly a top-handle drag |
| **Parallel legs, different barbers** | **one column — the opened chair.** The sibling leg is drawn _in that column_, in the other barber's tone at 7%, outlined rather than filled, and named on its own service row | the opened seat's handles only, bounded by the party envelope; the sibling leg carries **no handles**                                                                                                                                        |
| **Party split across chairs**        | same as parallel                                                                                                                                                              | same                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

**The label floor, swept across densities.** A leg gets its own label when its drawn height clears `--control-size-small` — `calc(var(--sys-space-unit) * 9)` ([tokens.css:66](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:66)) — and `--sys-space-unit` is `calc(0.25rem * var(--sys-density))` ([tokens.css:50-51](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:50)) with `[data-density]` setting `0.92` ([tokens.css:232](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:232)) and `1.08` ([tokens.css:235](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:235)). So the floor is **33.1px / 36.0px / 38.9px** at compact / regular / spacious.

> **Ruling: express the floor in space units, never in pixels, and the minute threshold comes out density-invariant.** Because both the floor and `--staff-minute-height` are multiples of `--sys-space-unit`, the density factor cancels: at §3.4's frame scale a leg is labelled from **15 minutes** up at all three densities, and on the day grid's own `--staff-slot-height` = `calc(var(--sys-space-unit) * 7)` ([staff-time-grid.css:19](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/time-grid/staff-time-grid.css:19)) — 25.8 / 28.0 / 30.2px per 15-minute slot, i.e. 1.72 / 1.87 / 2.02 px-per-minute — from **19 minutes** up. Hard-code `36px` anywhere in this and the compact user loses labels the regular user keeps.

The seam hairline stays a literal `1px`: it is a device rule inside a drawn block, not a list divider, and must not scale. It is untouched by ruling #1's deletion of the sheet's hairlines (§3.3.0).

Two chips appear **only when ≥2 legs share one subject**: `( Един след друг ) ( Едновременно )`. They sit in a `ui-flow` **beneath** the services group, outside it — a two-state toggle is not a row and must not be given a seam. These are `ui-chip`s and they are one of the three things on this surface that still is one (§3.6.7): the arrangement pair is a genuine two-state toggle, which is exactly and only what `ui-chip` models. `booking.schedule.arrangement.sequential` = `Влизате един след друг:` and `.parallel` = `Влизате заедно:` exist — but as **ledes with trailing colons**, not chip labels. The chips take **two new keys** with the same wording minus the colon; do not trim a shipped string at the call site. Selecting `Едновременно` with one barber **pushes the add-client page with the second seat pre-armed**, because `validateSeats` refuses one barber in two chairs at once ([appointment.ts:291-304](../../libs/domain/scheduling/src/lib/appointment.ts:291)) — the old formulation _"auto-opens the people field with the second barber slot focused"_ is re-pointed here, since there is neither a people field nor a barber slot any more.

### Totals

> **Ruling: no total under the run.** `Общо 28,00 €` appears **exactly once**, in `ПАРИ`. A services group that footed itself would give the sheet two places to read the same number, which is the thing R2 already forbids for time.

`Услуги` = `Σ leg.price` through `Money.add` → `Result`; a mixed-currency party yields `null` and renders `—` with a footnote, **never a wrong number** ([staff-dashboard.ts:1495-1505](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.ts:1495)). Every figure goes through `formatMoney(money, locale)` — see §3.8 for the one locale source — with `.staff-sheet__figures`, the sheet's tabular-numerals class (§3.3 R2), so the second lines align down the column exactly as the token value cells were supposed to.

### Empty

**An appointment with no services does not exist** — `validateSeats` refuses empty seats ([appointment.ts:277-282](../../libs/domain/scheduling/src/lib/appointment.ts:277)), and Fresha rules the same. Removing the last service disables `Запази` **with the reason in the label**: `Избери услуга`. The removal happens on the service's own page; popping back to a group holding only `＋ Добави услуга` is the honest picture of what just happened.

### Press parity

The service rows, the add row, the search results, the service page's menu rows and its destructive row all take `[data-interactive]`: hover under `@media (hover: hover)` ([modifiers.css:227-235](../../libs/ui/modifiers/modifiers.css:227)), **`:active` ungated** ([modifiers.css:243-250](../../libs/ui/modifiers/modifiers.css:243)). A row that only lights up under a mouse is a row that never lights up in this shop.

---

## 3.7 The clients section

> **REVERSED and RENAMED, 2026-08-26 (owner comments 2 + 7). `ХОРА` becomes `КЛИЕНТИ`, and it holds CLIENTS ONLY.** Barbers leave this field entirely: staff are assigned **per service**, on the service's own page (§3.6.3). The `Стол` row in `Кога` is deleted with them. The rows and their pushed pages are §3.6.2–§3.6.6 unchanged; **§3.6.8 is the only diff table and it is the normative one.** This section specifies what the field costs, what it writes, and where the barber went.
>
> The previous ruling — _"owner ask #2, 2026-08-26: `ХОРА` is the same token field as `УСЛУГИ`"_ — is withdrawn on both halves. It is not a token field (§3.6.1), and it is not "the same as `УСЛУГИ`" in its sources, because one of its two sources has been taken away from it.

### Where the barber went — comments 2 and 7, resolved together

The owner asked two questions that turn out to be one. _"Should the people field be split into barbers and clients?"_ (2). _"The `Стол` row repeats a barber who is already named below — that is redundant"_ (7).

> **Ruling: neither split nor keep. The people field holds clients, staffing is per-leg, and the shop-wide barber is named in three places, none of which is a field.**

**The judgement, defended, because this is a judgement and not a lookup.** A visit's staffing is genuinely **per-leg** — `Seat` carries its own `barberId`, `startsAt` and `terms` ([seat.ts:59-75](../../libs/domain/scheduling/src/lib/seat.ts:59)) — so _"Иван does the cut, Нико does the beard"_ is representable today, without an aggregate change. **A field that also lists barbers therefore holds a projection of the service rows**, and a projection you can edit is a second source of truth. Editing "Иван" in a people field would have to answer _which of his legs did you mean_, and there is no honest answer to that question at any level of UI polish. **Comment 7 is the identical defect one row higher**: `Стол` is a third projection of the same fact, sitting above both.

That is the same law comment 4 applies to the large title and comment 11 applies to the section eyebrows: **one fact, one place.** This document had it in three.

**So where does "who is working this visit" live? Three places, and each is a different verb.**

| Verb              | Where                                                                                                                | What it is                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Seen**          | the frame's gutter header — `.staff-frame__owner` **[new]**: the barber's avatar, tone swatch and name               | the frame draws **one chair's column**. Naming the column is labelling a picture, not restating a value. `staff.visit.chairValue` re-homes here rather than dying                          |
| **Read, per leg** | the service row's second line, `· {{barber}}`, **only when that leg's barber differs from the frame's chair**        | when they all agree the header has said it once, and a value repeated on every row is the duplication comment 7 objected to                                                                |
| **Changed**       | `⋯ → Смени стола` (R19) — one plain-language verdict per barber: `Свободен` / `Зает — Петър 10:30` / `Извън смяната` | it rewrites **every** leg's barber in one action. **A shop-wide reassignment is a command, and menus are for commands.** Reassigning one leg is a _value_, and it lives on that leg's page |

**R19 is promoted by this.** The chair-move menu was a convenience; it is now **the only shop-wide staffing control on the sheet**, and comments 2 and 7 make it load-bearing. It ships when the sheet ships, not when there is room.

**The frame header invents nothing.** `ui-avatar uiControlSize="small"` ([avatar.ts:65](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/avatar/avatar.ts:65)) inside `span.staff-scope__face` with `span.staff-scope__swatch [attr.data-barber-tone]` — **both classes already exist** at [staff-dashboard.css:1534](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.css:1534) and [:1540](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.css:1540), and the block sheet already renders exactly this composition at [staff-dashboard.html:1420-1434](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.html:1420). It is a paste of a shipped composition into a new position.

**What dies with the barbers.** The `Стол` `ui-list-row` in `Кога`; `staff.visit.searchBarbers` (`Бръснари`) as a rowgroup label; the barber half of this field's suggestion source; `barberNameOf` as a **people-field** input; and `staff.visit.people` (`Хора`), which becomes `staff.visit.clients` (`Клиенти`) and is used **only** as the group's `aria-label`, because comment 11 deleted every visible section title.

### The client rows

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  (av) Мартин Илиев                                   │  52px, two lines
│  +359 88 123 4567 · Нов                     ☎    ›   │  ☎ is its own target
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ＋ Добави клиент                                    │  → pushes the search
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
Или остави празно — клиент без запазен час.               when empty
```

_Gloss: `Нов` new · `Добави клиент` add a client · `Или остави празно — клиент без запазен час.` "Or leave it empty — a client without a booking."_

There is **no caret line and no field**: the caret line was the token field's affordance and it retired with it. The affordance is now the last row, `＋ Добави клиент`, which pushes the search page — one grammar for adding, shared with `УСЛУГИ` and learned once.

**`☎` is a peer target inside the row, not the row's action.** `a[uiButton][href^="tel:"] [uiIconOnly]` sits in `[uiTrailing]` beside the chevron; tapping it dials, tapping anywhere else pushes the client's page. Two targets in one row is legal precisely because both clear 44×44 and their accessible names differ — _"Обади се на Мартин Илиев"_ against the row's own composed name.

**The second line carries the shop's two facts and nothing else:** the phone, and a `span[uiBadge]` ([badge.ts:48-50](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/badge/badge.ts:48)) reading `Нов` or `2 неявявания`. No last-visit date, no spend, no tags — those are the client **page's** contents, and this line is a row, not a dossier.

**One field became two sources, and the two sources cost wildly different amounts.** Splitting them is what the next two subsections are for — and note that after comments 2 and 7 there is **one** source in this field: the client search. The barber list is still read, still free, and now feeds somewhere else.

### Barber search — free, and re-pointed

`/barbers` is `allow read: if true` ([firestore.rules:213](../../firestore.rules:213)). There is **no port to build, no callable to write and no permission to check.** The data is already in the component: `CatalogReader.listActiveBarbers` ([catalog-reader.port.ts:31](../../libs/application/catalog/src/lib/ports/catalog-reader.port.ts:31)) is injected here today and `barberNameOf` reads it ([staff-dashboard.ts:1507-1512](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.ts:1507)).

> **Re-pointed, 2026-08-26.** This subsection used to buy a **barber half of the people field's suggestion grid.** It now buys **three consumers, none of them this field**: the service page's `Бръснар` menu (§3.6.3), the `⋯ → Смени стола` verdict menu (R19), and the frame's owner header. The list, the injection and the cost are identical; only the destinations changed, and there are more of them.

**"Adding a barber is adding a seat" is deleted as a UI verb.** It was the token field's way of saying _"put my colleague's client in this 10:00 too"_, and growing an existing party was **already excluded from the UI in v1** (§3.3.9) and already blocked by the missing `addSeat` / `removeSeat` verbs on `Appointment` (**both still new**). With no barber tokens there is nothing left implying otherwise, which is one fewer promise the field makes and cannot keep. Merging two separate appointments stays excluded (§4.4).

**Size XS.** Filter a list that is already in memory — and now it is filtered into a menu instead of a grid, which is less code, not more.

### Client search — three prices, one per role

**The port, the use case, the adapter and the index all already exist.** `UserSearchPort.search(query)` ([user-search.port.ts:12-17](../../libs/application/governance/src/lib/ports/user-search.port.ts:12)) returns `{ userId, displayName, email }`; `SearchUsersUseCase` gates on a two-character minimum ([search-users.use-case.ts:9](../../libs/application/governance/src/lib/use-cases/search-users.use-case.ts:9)); `FirestoreUserSearchAdapter` runs `where('searchPrefixes','array-contains', q)` + `orderBy('searchName')` + `limit(20)` ([user-search.adapter.ts:41-69](../../libs/infrastructure/firestore/src/lib/user-search.adapter.ts:41)); `FirestoreProfileAdapter` writes both fields on every registered save ([profile.adapter.ts:39-55](../../libs/infrastructure/firestore/src/lib/profile.adapter.ts:39), called at [:109](../../libs/infrastructure/firestore/src/lib/profile.adapter.ts:109)); the composite index `users (searchPrefixes ARRAY_CONTAINS, searchName ASC)` is deployed ([firestore.indexes.json:118](../../firestore.indexes.json:118)); and the token is provided in the web app ([app.config.ts:225](../../apps/web/src/app/app.config.ts:225)). **Nothing named `findClients` exists anywhere and never did.**

> **Ruling: wire `UserSearchPort`. Do not build a second search.** Unchanged by the reversal — **the query is the same query; only the surface it renders into moved from a popup to a pushed page** (§3.6.4).

Three costs, because the rules split on role:

| Who                                     | What happens                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Size  |
| --------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----- |
| `receptionist` \| `admin` \| `sysadmin` | `allow list` on `/users` passes ([firestore.rules:96-97](../../firestore.rules:96)). Inject `USER_SEARCH_PORT`, render the results as rows. `UserSearchResult` carries no phone and no visit history, so widening it (`phone`, `lastVisitAtIso`) is the only real work                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | **S** |
| `barber`                                | `allow list` **denies** — the comment at [firestore.rules:92-94](../../firestore.rules:92) says listing is "front-desk and admin business only", and `worksTheBook()` ([firestore.rules:47-49](../../firestore.rules:47)) deliberately does not help here. A barber gets `permission-denied`, and the barber is exactly the persona this document says holds the phone one-handed mid-cut. Serving him needs a **new callable** `searchClients` (Admin SDK, `worksTheBook` gate, returns name + last visit + phone and nothing else) reusing `SearchUsersUseCase` behind an Admin-SDK `UserSearchPort` implementation | **M** |
| anyone, offline                         | the persistent Firestore cache serves the day but not a fresh query — see the states table                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | —     |

**Open question for §4.2 (Q16): does the barber get client search at all, or guest-only?** The **M** above buys him the search. Refusing it is a legitimate answer and costs zero — but it must be _decided_, not defaulted into by a rules file.

### Client quick-add — the data contract

The last result row is **always** `⊕ Нов клиент „{{query}}“` with the literal typed text (**R26, unchanged — only its container moved to the pushed search page**). What it writes has been unspecified; it is specified now.

**The default write is a seat, not an account.** `SeatSubject.anonymous(SeatLabel(query))` ([seat.ts:47-49](../../libs/domain/scheduling/src/lib/seat.ts:47)); a label that trims to empty or overruns `SEAT_LABEL_MAX_LENGTH` fails `SeatLabel.create` ([seat-label.ts:19-28](../../libs/domain/scheduling/src/lib/seat-label.ts:19)) and the row simply does not commit — the same refusal `toSubject` already performs server-side ([decide-booking.ts:492-495](../../apps/functions/src/use-cases/decide-booking.ts:492)). No document, no uid, no cost.

**Adding a phone is what promotes it, and it promotes it all the way.**

| Question                       | Answer                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Which fields?**              | Name (the typed query) and phone. Nothing else. `BookingContact` needs exactly `name` + `PhoneNumber` and treats `email` and `note` as nullable ([booking-contact.ts:44-49](../../libs/domain/scheduling/src/lib/booking-contact.ts:44))                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Is a phone required?**       | **Not for the seat; yes for an account.** The domain `User` takes a non-nullable `PhoneNumber` ([user.ts:53-62](../../libs/domain/accounts/src/lib/user.ts:53)), and the shop's only channel is the phone anyway (`notifyNone`: _"имаме само телефон"_). No phone → anonymous seat, `BookingContact` stays `null`, which the domain permits by design                                                                                  |
| **Duplicate detection?**       | `UserRepositoryPort.findByDestination` ([user-repository.port.ts:60-62](../../libs/application/identity/src/lib/ports/user-repository.port.ts:60)) on the normalised E.164 — exact match, **no new index** — and `auth.createUser` refuses a second account on the same `phoneNumber` regardless. A hit shows the existing client **as a row on the same page**: _"Този номер вече е на Мартин Илиев"_, with a row to use them instead |
| **Who becomes `ownerUserId`?** | The provisioned uid. `ownerUserId` is **derived**, not stored on the aggregate — `ownerUserIdOf` reads it off the `self` seat ([appointment-document.ts:309-319](../../libs/application/booking/src/lib/ports/appointment-document.ts:309)) — so giving the new client a `SeatSubject.account(uid, 'self')` seat is what makes the booking theirs, and the walk-in freeze (§3.9 #1) never happens for them                             |

> **Ruling: staff quick-create mints the same stub the OTP flow already mints — it does not invent a second kind of user.** The callable calls `provisionAuthUser({kind:'phone', …})` ([firebase-auth-token-adapter.ts:56-75](../../apps/functions/src/adapters/firebase-auth-token-adapter.ts:56)) and `UserRepositoryPort.provision({id, phone, email: null})` ([firestore-user-repository.ts:110-122](../../apps/functions/src/adapters/firestore-user-repository.ts:110)) — precisely what `verifyOtpChallenge` does on a first login. The record stays `registered: false` (that flag is derived from an absent `firstName`, [firestore-user-repository.ts:100-103](../../apps/functions/src/adapters/firestore-user-repository.ts:100)), and the moment that person verifies the same number themselves, `findByDestination` joins them to it — **with their whole visit history already attached.**

**Two consequences that must ship in the same PR.**

1. **This cannot be a client-side write.** [firestore.rules:99-101](../../firestore.rules:99) allows a `users/{uid}` create only when `isOwner(uid)` and `roles == ['client']`; staff creating a user is not covered by any rule today, and adding one would be a role-escalation surface. It is a **callable, Admin SDK, `worksTheBook` gate**, and nothing else.
2. **A provisioned stub is invisible to the search that just failed to find them.** `computeSearchFields` runs only on a registered save from `user.fullName()` ([profile.adapter.ts:109](../../libs/infrastructure/firestore/src/lib/profile.adapter.ts:109)); a stub has no name and therefore no `searchName` / `searchPrefixes`. The quick-create callable **writes both from the typed name**, or the client the barber just created cannot be found tomorrow.

**Size M** for the callable, on top of the **M** for barber-served search. **Open question for §4.2 (Q17): a staff-created client owns their own booking under this ruling — confirm that is wanted, versus a nullable `ownerUserId` plus a new `createdByUserId`.**

**Walk-in is the empty state, not a mode.** With no client the group's footnote reads `Или остави празно — клиент без запазен час.` and `contact` stays `null`.

### Two seats, one person

Ask #4 wants `AppointmentMultipleSelfSeatsError` ([appointment.ts:284-289](../../libs/domain/scheduling/src/lib/appointment.ts:284)) relaxed so one client can hold a cut and a beard back to back. The obvious relaxation — _"allow two `self` seats when their intervals don't intersect"_ — **does nothing for the case staff hit most.**

`toSubject` maps `{kind:'self'}` to `SeatSubject.account(ownerUserId, 'self')` ([decide-booking.ts:484-497](../../apps/functions/src/use-cases/decide-booking.ts:484)). A staff-created walk-in has no account, so **every seat is `anonymous`** and the self-seat invariant never fires at all — meaning a walk-in party of one can today be given two overlapping legs and the aggregate accepts it.

> **Ruling: replace the self-seat count rule with one pairwise interval-intersection rule applied across all seats, with no branch on subject kind.** Two seats may not intersect in time when they resolve to the same **subject identity**, where identity is the `UserId` for an `account` subject and the `SeatLabel` for an `anonymous` one ([seat.ts:38-57](../../libs/domain/scheduling/src/lib/seat.ts:38)). It is the same shape `validateSeats` already runs for barbers — `collidesWith` ([seat.ts:223-227](../../libs/domain/scheduling/src/lib/seat.ts:223)) keyed on `barberId` instead of subject — so the loop is a copy of [appointment.ts:294-304](../../libs/domain/scheduling/src/lib/appointment.ts:294) with one comparator swapped.

Effect: **loosens** the account case (sequential legs for one client become legal), **tightens** the anonymous case (a walk-in cannot hold two chairs at once), and leaves a father-and-son walk-in — two distinct labels — legal in parallel, which is the whole reason party bookings exist.

**One honest limitation:** `SeatLabel.equals` is exact string comparison on the trimmed value ([seat-label.ts:34-36](../../libs/domain/scheduling/src/lib/seat-label.ts:34)), so `мартин` and `Мартин` are two people to the domain. Normalise on the comparison (`toLocaleLowerCase`), not on the stored label — the barber typed the capital and should keep it.

**This ruling is untouched by comments 1, 2, 7 and 10.** It is a domain invariant, and the domain does not care what the sheet looks like — which is the test for whether a ruling belongs in Part 2 or Part 3.

### Chips, rows and tokens — settled, on the third try

> **Superseded a second time, 2026-08-26.** The first formulation ruled _"committed participants are rows; pending tokens inside the picker input are chips"_, and planned `ui-chip uiChipRole="token"` plus a new `[uiTrailing]` slot. The second withdrew all of it for _"every participant is a `ui-token`, committed or pending, and the primitive is new."_ **The second is now withdrawn too.** There are no tokens: **every participant is a `button[uiListRow]` that pushes a page**, and `ui-token` is cancelled as a dependency of this sheet (§3.6.7).

The three things the earlier formulations were protecting all survive, and two of them get _cheaper_ on a row:

- **The 44px floor stops being a fight.** It was a fight because `--control-size-regular` is `calc(var(--sys-space-unit) * 11)` ([tokens.css:75](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:75)) and resolves to **40.5px at `data-density="compact"`**, so a token's `✕` and `⌄` needed `min-block-size: max(44px, …)` on a straddling `::before`. **A `ui-list-row` at `uiSize="large"` clears the floor at every density on its own**, and the whole row is the target. The straddling construction survives in the DS for the frame handles (§3.4.4) and is not needed here.
- **The removal label is still the shipped one.** `booking.party.remove` = `Премахни {{name}}` already exists ([bg.json:259](../../libs/infrastructure/i18n/src/assets/i18n/bg.json:259)) and is what the client page's destructive row announces. This field still invents no new removal copy.
- **`/book`'s seat pill is still the migration target for `ui-token`** — its own template calls its second-press removal _"a secret"_ ([booking-services-step.html:87-93](../../libs/features/client/booking/src/lib/services-step/booking-services-step.html:87)) — but **that migration is no longer this document's dependency.** It moves to the `/book` backlog with the primitive (§3.6.7).

**Three re-cuts is not three mistakes; it is one fact found by elimination.** Chips could not carry a second value. Tokens could carry it and could not be opened safely on a phone. **A row carries the value on its second line and opens onto a page.** The load-bearing sentence never changed: _every participant carries a second fact, and that fact must be visible without a tap._

### Removal

> **REVERSED, 2026-08-26.** This section last ruled _"the token's `✕` is permanent and it is the removal"_, and before that _"no permanent `✕`; tap to disclose, remove from inside."_ **The `✕` is deleted with the token.** Removal is a **destructive `button[uiListRow]` at the bottom of the client's pushed page** — `Премахни клиента` — carrying `[uiForegroundStyle]="'destructive'"` ([foreground.directive.ts:10-11](../../libs/ui/modifiers/src/lib/foreground.directive.ts:10)), exactly as `Премахни услугата` does on the service page (§3.6.3).

The earlier ruling's argument was _"a `✕` at 44×44 that is always visible is the whole reason the token pattern is safe on a phone."_ **That argument was answering a hazard the token created.** With no token there is no hazard, and destroying a participant now costs the same two gestures Apple charges for deleting an event: go in, scroll to the bottom, tap the red row. **Calendar parity, and the corpus is unanimous** — no competitor puts a destructive control on a collapsed list row on a phone, because a mis-tap there is silent and immediate.

Two exceptions, both decidable without a round trip, and both restated in §3.6.8:

- **The client on a party of one is never removable** — that would produce an appointment with no subject. The destructive row is **absent** from their page, replaced by `Без клиент (на място)`, which clears `BookingContact` and swaps the subject to `SeatSubject.anonymous`. Fresha's exact semantics.
- **A participant whose seat already has a resolved outcome is not removable.** `isResolved` is per-seat ([transition-appointment.ts:87-92](../../apps/functions/src/lib/booking/transition-appointment.ts:87)), so this is decidable row by row. The destructive row is absent, the row carries a status glyph, and it routes to the existing per-seat cancel path (`cancelSeatId`, [staff-dashboard.ts:2395](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.ts:2395)) — **which already solved this correctly.**

### Enrichment — inside the client's pushed page

> **REVERSED, 2026-08-26.** This was _"§3.6.4's inline expansion with the people field's contents… the token stays where it is in the run, takes `[data-open]`, and the editor arrives as the next segment down."_ It is now **a page**, pushed by the row, at depth one, with the same contents and no `Готово`.

```
┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
│  ‹                                    │
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Мартин Илиев                         │  large title = the client
│  Клиент от 12 юли · 2 неявявания      │  consequence strip, quiet
│                                       │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │  Телефон      +359 88 123 4567 ☎│  │  44 · tel: is the trailing target
│  ├─────────────────────────────────┤  │
│  │  Последно     12 юли · Фейд      │  │  44 · read-only
│  ├─────────────────────────────────┤  │
│  │  ↺ Същото като миналия път      │  │  44 · one tap, back-fills УСЛУГИ
│  └─────────────────────────────────┘  │
│                                       │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │  Без клиент (на място)          │  │  party of one: this INSTEAD of
│  └─────────────────────────────────┘  │  Премахни клиента
└───────────────────────────────────────┘
```

_Gloss: `Телефон` phone · `Последно` last visit · `Клиент от` client since · `2 неявявания` 2 no-shows · `Същото като миналия път` same as last time · `Без клиент (на място)` no client (walk-in)._

**`↺ Същото като миналия път`** back-fills **services, barber and duration** from the client's most recent completed appointment and **leaves the time alone**. Apple's title-autocomplete semantics — _"Select a suggestion to fill in event details"_ — minus its documented defect: Apple overwrites invisibly and its own workaround advice is _"don't title the event the same as a previous one."_ Ours announces `Взехме услугите от 12 юли.` in the live region — **the same single `polite` region the sheet already owns** (§3.6.6), not a second one — and badges every changed value `по избор` until saved.

> **One addition the push makes possible and the expansion did not: `↺` pops back to root as it fires.** The rows it just wrote are in `УСЛУГИ`, which is on the root page; leaving the barber looking at a client page while the services silently changed behind it is precisely the _"did something happen?"_ failure NN/g documents for expanded content. **Popping is the animation of the consequence.** The live-region sentence then lands on a screen that shows what it is describing.

**The icon already exists**: `visit.repeat` → `replay` ([icon-registry.ts:175](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/icon/icon-registry.ts:175)), already pushed onto rebooked rows at [staff-dashboard.ts:2140](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.ts:2140).

**What it back-fills, it back-fills as rows** — the services it takes land in `УСЛУГИ` as ordinary service rows, each openable and each removable, so a barber who wanted three of the four undoes the fourth with one tap rather than starting over. **That payoff survives the reversal intact**; it was never a property of tokens, only of _not_ using a picker sheet.

It needs one new read — `lastVisitFor(clientId)` (**new** port method). `searchWindow(nowIso, limit)` ([appointment-repository.port.ts:66-69](../../libs/application/booking/src/lib/ports/appointment-repository.port.ts:66)) half-provides it, and the `appointments (ownerUserId, timeSlot.startIso)` index is already deployed. **Highest speed-per-line-of-code in the whole redesign.**

`2 неявявания` is read-only history. The consequence of a no-show is currently modelled nowhere the barber can see it.

### The clients field's other states

Every one of these renders **on the pushed search page**, which owns the viewport. **None of them is a popup, none is height-capped, and none of them competes with a keyboard for the same 290pt** — which is the reversal paying for itself in the smallest and least glamorous place.

| State                             | Rendering                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Loading**                       | three `ui-skeleton` rows at `--control-size-large` (47.8 / 52.0 / 56.2px across `[data-density]`); the field stays live and the query is preserved                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Zero results**                  | **not an empty state** — the quick-create row, alone                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Search failed**                 | one row: `Търсенето не сработи. Добави като гост.` with the quick-create still offered, query preserved, retry on tap. **The degraded path still books**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Not permitted (role `barber`)** | **Not an error.** No results section at all, no client-shaped copy, and the quick-create row promoted to first position with `⊕ Добави клиент „{{query}}“`. There is nothing broken here — a barber composing a walk-in has everything he needs — and any copy implying a failure would train him to retry a request that will always be refused                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Offline**                       | **the search field itself is removed, not disabled**, under `staff.visit.offlineClientSearch` = `Няма връзка — търсенето на клиенти не работи.`, and **the quick-create row is absent too, because creating a client is a write.** The refusal happens once, on the way in, and again only at `Запази` — never four times. The client rows already on the appointment render normally and their pages are fully live, because they edit a draft. **There is no offline mode**, and `data-locked="offline"` is a reason rendered as one footnote, never a tier (§3.2, §3.3 R0 amended 2026-08-26) |
| **Settled / cancelled**           | the rows are read rows, `＋ Добави клиент` is absent, and **no page can be pushed** — the rows are not buttons (§3.6.5)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

**Nothing in `staff-day.store.ts` models connectivity** — it has `loading` ([:557](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-day.store.ts:557)) and a per-appointment `_errors` map ([:661](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-day.store.ts:661)) and nothing else, and the persistent cache means the day renders while every write fails. That gap is the same one §3.3.9 names and it is unchanged by these twelve comments.

### Press parity

The client rows, the `☎`, the add row, the search results, the quick-create row and the client page's `↺` all take `[data-interactive]`: hover `@media (hover: hover)`-gated ([modifiers.css:227-235](../../libs/ui/modifiers/modifiers.css:227)), **`:active` ungated** ([modifiers.css:243-250](../../libs/ui/modifiers/modifiers.css:243)). There is no hover-only affordance anywhere in this field — §3.6.6 rules that every one of them is permanently visible, and a row that only lights up under a mouse is a row that never lights up in this shop.

## 3.8 The money section

**Ask #6 (applied promos) is deferred to M8, the last milestone. Nothing promo-shaped renders in M1–M7** — no chip, no strike-through, no `Отстъпка` row, no `Промоция` row, no placeholder. Everything in this section before the honesty gate describes M8; everything about price override describes M7. Read it as a specification, not a schedule.

⚠ **Amended 2026-08-26 (comment 3).** The owner asked for two things and they have two different costs, so they ship in two different milestones: **applying** a promo is a `Промоция` row in this group that pushes a page (**M8**, with the domain behind it), and **browsing** the shop's promos is a read-only catalogue page off `⋯` (**M7**, because a catalogue you can only read needs nothing on an appointment). The browse page is **not** a promo state on a visit and does not weaken the honesty gate below — it is a price list, reachable from a menu, with nothing to apply and nothing to pretend.

**The locale, named once.** `formatMoney(money, locale)` takes a locale ([format-money.ts:18](../../libs/domain/kernel/src/lib/format-money.ts:18)) and every `28,00 €` in this document is the **bare `bg`** rendering — the tag Transloco actually holds ([language.service.ts:35](../../libs/features/shared/shell/src/lib/language.service.ts:35)), never `bg-BG`. **The source is `CatalogPresenter.locale()`** — `computed(() => this.language.activeLang())` ([catalog-presenter.service.ts:25](../../libs/features/shared/catalog/src/lib/content/catalog-presenter.service.ts:25)) — which this component already injects and already uses for every date it formats. **`seatsPrice` is the one caller that bypasses it**, reaching for `this.transloco.getActiveLang()` directly ([staff-dashboard.ts:1504](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.ts:1504)); that is a plain method call, not a signal read, so a language switch does not invalidate the computed that holds it and the price keeps the old locale until something else re-renders the row. **Align it in the price PR.** One locale source, one line, forever.

### Price override

⚠ **Re-homed 2026-08-26 (comments 1 + 10, Ruling C).** This section read _"**On the token, never on the total.** The token editor's `Цена` … renders in `.staff-sheet__disclosure` **beneath the opened token — never in a sheet** (§3.6.4, R10 amended)."_ **The token is deleted and the inline editor with it.** Everything below is unchanged in substance — _editing is overriding_, the role gate removes the cell rather than greying it, provenance ships in the same PR — and only the carrier moved: a **pushed page inside the sheet's own navigation stack**, one level deep, `‹` to come back. Not a sheet on a sheet, not a popover, not a panel under the row.

**On the service, never on the total.** The service page's `Цена` is an ordinary pre-filled `input[uiTextField] inputmode="decimal"` (Fresha: _editing is overriding_), suffixed `€` and re-rendered through `formatMoney(money, locale)` on blur, so what the barber sees after typing `18` is `18,00 €`. It commits **live into the draft**: no `Готово`, no `Приложи`, no second commit boundary on the child (§3.6.4 ruling 3, reversed). `Запази` in the dock is still the only thing that reaches the server.

⚠ **The per-leg `Отстъпка` peer is deleted, and this section already contains the reason.** `DiscountInput` is `{ id, label, value, grantedAt, minSpend? }` and carries **no seat and no service reference at all** ([discount-application.ts:16-23](../../libs/domain/engagement/src/lib/discount-application.ts:16)) — a per-line discount is not expressible in the domain today in any form. A field on a leg's page that can only ever write a cart-level number is a lie about where the money went. **Ad-hoc discounting is cart-level and lives on the promo page below;** `discount` (`Отстъпка`) and `discountNone` (`Без`) re-home there as that arm's label and its resting value.

**Role-gated — absent, not disabled.** `Цена` **does not render at all** for a `barber`; it renders for `receptionist | admin | sysadmin`. A read-only control is announced as _"disabled"_ by TalkBack and styled by nothing, which is the failure §3.2 cites to justify the ruling — **the role gate removes the row, it does not grey it** (§3.2, §3.6.4 ruling 5). ⚠ _Singular since 2026-08-26: it was `Цена` and `Отстъпка`; the `Отстъпка` peer is gone, so there is one row to remove instead of two cells to hide._ **A barber may stretch his own time; he may not discount the shop's money.** This forces plan item E4 — a role model on this surface — to land with the price PR rather than after it, and it is the same three-role list `firestore.rules` already uses for listing clients ([firestore.rules:96-97](../../firestore.rules:96)).

⚠ **Widened 2026-08-26 (comment 3), and the split is not the obvious one.** The rule above stands but was drawn too wide, because "discounting" was covering two acts the domain already distinguishes:

| Act                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Who                                 | Why                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Honouring a grant the client already holds** — `CouponGrantRepository.findUsableForUser` ([coupon-grant-repository.port.ts:22](../../libs/application/engagement/src/lib/ports/coupon-grant-repository.port.ts:22)) | **`barber` too**                    | This is not discounting. The shop made the promise; the barber is keeping it. Refusing a code the client is holding, at the chair, because the receptionist stepped out, is the shop breaking its own word |
| **Authoring an ad-hoc discount** — a number a human invents at the counter                                                                                                                                            | `receptionist \| admin \| sysadmin` | This is spending the shop's money, and it is the act the original rule was about                                                                                                                           |
| **Browsing the catalogue** (`⋯ → Всички промоции`)                                                                                                                                                                    | everyone who can open this sheet    | Reading a price list is not a permission                                                                                                                                                                   |

**Refusal copy, never a disabled control:** `promoApplyDenied` = `Само рецепция или управител може да добавя отстъпки.` The ad-hoc arm is **absent** for a barber and that sentence is the promo page's footnote — the same construction as the missing `Цена` cell, for the same reason.

**Provenance persists or the data is gone.** `appointmentToDocument` writes `terms.priceMinorUnits`, `currencyCode`, `durationMinutes`, `setupMinutes` and `cleanupMinutes` verbatim, with **no catalogue baseline beside them** ([appointment-document.ts:67-72](../../libs/application/booking/src/lib/ports/appointment-document.ts:67)), so an override round-trips **indistinguishably from a catalogue value** the moment it ships. `seats[].catalogDurationMinutes` and `seats[].catalogPriceMinorUnits` (**both new**) must land in the **same PR**, not a later one — analytics can never afterwards tell a 45-minute fade from a 30-minute fade someone stretched, and existing rows are unrecoverable, the same sentence this document already writes about `arrivedAt` and `barberPref`.

A leg whose value differs from the catalogue carries `data-overridden` → a 3px leading bar in `--sys-color-warning` and a `по избор` badge (`uiBadge uiTone="accent" uiProminence="decreased"` — both real inputs, [badge.ts:48-50](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/badge/badge.ts:48)). ⚠ **Re-homed 2026-08-26:** that bar and that badge now sit on the **service `ui-list-row`'s second line** in the root page, beside `18,00 € (беше 20,00 €)` — the surviving `moneyWas` shape, renamed `priceOverridden` — so an override is legible **without opening anything**, which the token's value cell only managed by being open. The child page carries the same badge on the `Цена` row while you are standing on it.

### Promos — two arms, three surfaces

⚠ **Extended 2026-08-26 (comment 3). R5's two arms are unchanged; what changed is that they now reach the barber through three named surfaces instead of one field.**

| Surface            | What it is                                                                                                     | Where                | Milestone |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------- | --------- |
| **Apply**          | the `Промоция` row in `ПАРИ`, which **pushes a page**                                                          | this group, below    | **M8**    |
| **Browse**         | `⋯ → Всички промоции` — the same catalogue page in **read mode**, reachable with no appointment context at all | the sheet's `⋯` menu | **M7**    |
| **Honour a grant** | not a surface but a permission: a `barber` may apply a code the client already holds                           | the apply page       | **M8**    |

**Declarative (Booksy's model, the correct default).** A promo attaches because the booking _matched a rule_ — a grant on the client, a happy hour, a last-minute window. It renders as an accent chip with the original price struck through. Staff-removable ones carry `✕`; rule-driven ones do not, and tapping them says which rule fired. **This is one of `ui-chip`'s three remaining jobs on this surface** — the applied-promo run — beside the arrangement pair and the relative date row (§3.10).

⚠ **One mechanical note, because §3.10 rules `ui-chip` back down to its two real inputs and this run would otherwise contradict it.** `ui-chip` has no `[uiTrailing]` slot and is not getting one ([chip.ts:27-28](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/chip/chip.ts:27)) — that was the withdrawn `uiChipRole="token"` plan. **The removable promo's `✕` is therefore a PEER `button[uiButton] [uiIconOnly]` beside the chip inside the `ui-flow`, not a control inside it** — the same construction as the `☎` on a client row, which is a peer target and not the row's action. Two targets, two accessible names, no slot, no new input.

**Imperative (Fresha's model, the override).** A cart-level `Отстъпка за целия час` with a fixed/percentage segmented pair, on the apply page, for `receptionist | admin | sysadmin` only. ⚠ **The per-leg half of this arm is deleted** (above): the domain has no per-line targeting, so there was never a leg for it to attach to.

### The `Промоция` row, and the page behind it

**A derivation is not typed over — but the _entry point_ to one is a row.** The money group renders what the engine computed; the promo itself is chosen somewhere you can read the terms, which is a page.

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Услуги                     28,00 €  │  44
├──────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Промоция                   Няма  ›  │  44   ← button[uiListRow], pushes
├──────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Отстъпки                   −8,00 €  │  conditional — the engine's line
├──────────────────────────────────────┤
│  В салона                   20,00 €  │  52, weight 600, never prominent
└──────────────────────────────────────┘
```

_Gloss: `Промоция` promo · `Няма` none · `Отстъпки` discounts · `В салона` at the shop._

**Ruling: the row's trailing value is the applied promo's name, or the literal `Няма` — never a placeholder and never a bare `›`.** It is the same law as the `Ден` pill (Ruling A): a row that owns a value always shows the value it owns. The glyph is `nav.disclosure` (`›`), never `field.expand` (`⌄`), because this row **travels** — and that distinction is load-bearing across the whole sheet after 2026-08-26 (§3.10).

**The page.** One level deep in the same `ui-sheet-nav` stack as the service and client pages — **depth is exactly one, everywhere, and that is a law** (Ruling C). Top to bottom:

1. `input[uiTextField]` labelled `Код за отстъпка` (promo code). A code that does not resolve renders `promoInvalid` = `Няма такъв код.`; one that resolves but does not match this appointment renders `promoNotEligible` = `Кодът не важи за този час.` **Two different sentences, because they are two different problems** — and neither is _"invalid"_.
2. The client's usable grants, as `ui-list-row`s with `[uiSelected]`, off `CouponGrantRepository.findUsableForUser`. **Applicable to a `barber`.**
3. The shop's active promos below a rowgroup label, each naming code, terms and validity.
4. The ad-hoc arm, last — `Отстъпка за целия час` with its fixed/percentage pair. **Absent for a `barber`**, with `promoApplyDenied` as the page's footnote.

**Commit is live into the draft, like every other pushed page** — no `Готово` on the child, `Запази` in the dock. Applied promos render back in `ПАРИ` as the `Отстъпки` line plus the `button[uiChip]` run.

**The browse page is the same page in read mode**, opened from `⋯ → Всички промоции` with no appointment context: code, name, terms, validity, `minSpend`, and nothing selectable. **This is the half a barber needs most**, because the question at the chair is _"is there still a code for a first haircut?"_ — and it is answerable in M7, a milestone before anything can be applied.

**Offline.** The `Промоция` row shows `Няма връзка` and does not push. **Settled.** It shows its applied value and does not push. Both are the standing rules (§3.3.9), not new ones.

**What already exists is more than the earlier draft credited.** `DiscountApplication.apply(subtotal, discounts, {capPercent})` ([discount-application.ts:65-93](../../libs/domain/engagement/src/lib/discount-application.ts:65)) is built and tested, **and so is its application use-case**: `ApplyDiscountsUseCase` ([apply-discounts.use-case.ts:34-58](../../libs/application/engagement/src/lib/use-cases/apply-discounts.use-case.ts:34)) loads a user's usable grants through `CouponGrantRepository.findUsableForUser` ([coupon-grant-repository.port.ts:22](../../libs/application/engagement/src/lib/ports/coupon-grant-repository.port.ts:22), adapter at [coupon-grant-repository.adapter.ts:420](../../libs/infrastructure/firestore/src/lib/coupon-grant-repository.adapter.ts:420)) and calls `apply()` already. **What is missing is a caller from the scheduling side** — nothing in booking or staff constructs the use case. That is the M8 work: a call site, not an engine.

**The cascade rule, restated as what the code actually does** — because the rule this document previously stated is not implemented anywhere:

> **Every discount applies to the running remainder, in one total order: kind rank (`fixed_amount` → `percent_off` → `free_service`, [coupon-value.ts:73-82](../../libs/domain/engagement/src/lib/coupon-value.ts:73)) → magnitude → `grantedAt` → `id`. A `minSpend` that fails drops the discount silently. A `capPercent`, if given, then trims the **trailing** lines until the total fits.**

Every tiebreak key is a property of the discount itself, never its array position ([discount-application.ts:97-110](../../libs/domain/engagement/src/lib/discount-application.ts:97); cap at [:179-207](../../libs/domain/engagement/src/lib/discount-application.ts:179)). **There is no per-line targeting and no add-on concept:** `DiscountInput` is `{ id, label, value, grantedAt, minSpend? }` ([discount-application.ts:16-23](../../libs/domain/engagement/src/lib/discount-application.ts:16)) and carries no seat or service reference at all, so _"fixed amounts apply to the lines they name"_ is not expressible today in any form.

> **Ruling: the shipped cart-level rule is the M8 rule.** Per-line targeting is a domain extension — `DiscountInput.appliesTo: readonly SeatId[]` plus a per-line pass in `apply()` — and it belongs in M8's **XL** scope with its own decision, not smuggled in as documentation of code that does something else. **The UI renders a `DiscountBreakdown` and nothing else**; a second UI-side evaluator would guarantee divergence.

`--sys-color-promo` / `--sys-color-on-promo` exist ([theme-light.css:44-45](../../libs/ui/tokens/theme-light.css:44), [theme-dark.css:40-41](../../libs/ui/tokens/theme-dark.css:40)) and are used nowhere outside the theme files. **This is what they are for.**

### Deposit

**Render, never create.** `Депозит (платен) −10,00 €` when one exists. There is no payment concept anywhere in the domain; taking money turns this sheet into a POS. The row is conditional, so its absence costs nothing.

### Honesty gate

`Appointment` has `subtotal()` ([appointment.ts:363](../../libs/domain/scheduling/src/lib/appointment.ts:363)) and **no `discounts` and no `total()`.** Until it does, **compose shows the subtotal only, with no badge, no strike-through, and the row does not navigate.** Draw nothing that cannot persist — the same rule as the notify switch (Q6) and the `customService` create row (Q20), both of which are **absent** until the thing behind them exists.

⚠ **The gate is not weakened by comment 3, and the two places it bites are worth naming.** **(a) The `Промоция` row does not render before M8** — not greyed, not showing `Няма` over a domain that cannot hold an answer. M7's browse page is reachable from `⋯` and is a _catalogue_, not a promo state; nothing on the appointment changes when you read it, which is exactly why it can ship a milestone early. **(b) The row is absent over an empty cart even after M8** — a new appointment with no services renders `0,00 €` and no `Промоция` row at all, because a promo over an empty cart is a control with nothing to do. It appears with the first service.

### Struck prices and screen readers

`line-through` is invisible to a screen reader. Every struck figure carries an `aria-label` naming **both** amounts: _"беше 28,00 евро, сега 20,00 евро."_

### Press parity

The `✕` on a removable promo chip, the promo chip itself (which is tappable to say which rule fired), and **the `Промоция` row** all take `[data-interactive]`: hover `@media (hover: hover)`-gated ([modifiers.css:227-235](../../libs/ui/modifiers/modifiers.css:227)), **`:active` ungated** ([modifiers.css:243-250](../../libs/ui/modifiers/modifiers.css:243)). The chip `✕` takes the same `max(44px, …)` target floor every other target on this sheet takes. ⚠ **Amended 2026-08-26:** the `Отстъпка` disclosure is gone with the token editor; the row that replaced it is a `button[uiListRow]` and takes `uiInteractive`, which carries the same gated-hover / ungated-`:active` pair for free.

## 3.10 Every component, token, i18n key and copy string

### Components used, by region

Split by status, because the previous single-column version read as an inventory of things that exist. It was not. **Everything in the right-hand column has to be built.**

⚠ **Re-cut 2026-08-26, and the direction of the re-cut is the headline: this table got SHORTER.** The twelve comments replace two novel, unstandardised primitives — `span[uiToken]` and `[uiCombobox]`, together with the APG grid-combobox popup whose pattern the working group has had open as [aria-practices#1512](https://github.com/w3c/aria-practices/issues/1512) since 2020 — with **navigation**, which every platform has already solved. One genuinely new pattern component is born (`ui-sheet-nav`); two big ones are cancelled. **State that as a net simplification in the review, not as churn.**

**Four near-misses that read as existing and are not.** `[uiTrailing]` is real — as a content-projection slot on `ui-sheet-header` ([sheet-header.ts:72](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/sheet-header/sheet-header.ts:72)) and `ui-list-row` ([list-row.ts:79](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-row/list-row.ts:79)). It is not on `ui-chip`. **`[uiLeading]` on `ui-sheet-header` is NOT real** — that component projects exactly `[uiTitle]` and `[uiTrailing]` and nothing else ([sheet-header.ts:71-72](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/sheet-header/sheet-header.ts:71)), so the pushed page's `‹` has nowhere to go until `ui-sheet-nav` adds the slot. `uiPlacement` is real — on `ui-menu`, `ui-toolbar` and `ui-sheet`. It is not on `staff-time-grid`. And the two primitives this sheet leans on hardest are smaller than they look: **`ui-chip` has two inputs** (`uiSelected`, `uiControlSize` — [chip.ts:27-28](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/chip/chip.ts:27)) and **`ui-text-field` has two** (`uiControlSize`, `uiInvalid` — [text-field.ts:27-28](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/text-field/text-field.ts:27)). Nothing else.

⚠ **That smallness used to be the argument FOR `ui-token`. As of 2026-08-26 it is the argument against needing one here.** The sentence this paragraph carried — _"why `ui-token` is a new primitive rather than a chip with attributes, and why `[uiCombobox]` has to be hoisted out of `ui-phone-field` before either token field can be typed into"_ — described a surface that no longer exists. **`ui-chip` is not bent into anything**, because the date pill is a plain `button` with `.staff-sheet__pill` and six declarations, and services and clients are `ui-list-row`s. `ui-chip` keeps its two inputs and three jobs (below). **`ui-token` should still be built — for `/book`, whose `.booking-seat-pill` calls its own hidden removal "a secret" — but it is no longer a dependency of this sheet and it leaves M6 for the `/book` backlog.**

⚠ **`uiChipRole` is not cosmetic — the kind switch cannot ship without it.** `button[uiChip]` binds `aria-pressed` from `uiSelected` on the host ([chip.ts:23](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/chip/chip.ts:23)). Put `role="radio"` on that element and you get a radio carrying a stale `aria-pressed` — two contradictory state attributes on one control. `uiChipRole="radio"` must suppress the host binding, not merely add a role. ⚠ **Narrowed 2026-08-26: `"radio"` is the only variant left.** The `"token"` half is withdrawn — a token is a two-cell `role="row"` with a value cell, a tone rail, an open control and a remove control, and bending a toggle button into that shape would leave `ui-chip` with two mutually exclusive personalities and a host binding each has to suppress.

⚠ **And after the twelve comments, `ui-chip` has exactly three jobs on this surface, all of them the job it was designed for — a bounded set of mutually-comparable choices:** the **arrangement pair** (`Един след друг` / `Едновременно`), the **applied-promo run**, and the **relative date row** (`Днес` / `Утре` / `В петък`). Nothing else on this sheet is a chip. **The `Ден` pill is deliberately NOT one** — `ui-chip` binds `aria-pressed` from `uiSelected` on the host ([chip.ts:23](../../libs/ui/controls/src/lib/chip/chip.ts:23)), and a disclosure trigger for a form value is not a toggle button; it is a `button` in `[uiTrailing]` with `.staff-sheet__pill`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. Bending the chip there would have been the `uiChipRole="token"` mistake a second time. **This closes the `ui-chip` overload question.**

### Tokens

Everything below derives from `--sys-space-unit`, and **`--sys-space-unit` is not a constant**: `calc(0.25rem * var(--sys-density))` ([tokens.css:51](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:51)), with `[data-density]` setting `0.92` ([:232](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:232)) and `1.08` ([:235](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:235)). Every absolute pixel figure in this document is therefore a range.

| ------------------ | -------------- | ------------- | --------------- |

**Ruling: `--staff-minute-height` is a refactor of `--staff-slot-height`, not a new number.** The grid owns `--staff-slot-height: calc(var(--sys-space-unit) * 7)` today and the frame needs a per-minute scale to share. Introduce `--staff-minute-height: calc(var(--sys-space-unit) * 7 / 15)` and redefine the slot as `--staff-slot-height: calc(var(--staff-minute-height) * 15)`. That is algebraically the same expression — the existing 28px slot survives byte-for-byte at every density — and the two consumers ([:279](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/time-grid/staff-time-grid.css:279), [:295](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/time-grid/staff-time-grid.css:295)) never notice. Anyone who writes a fresh number here has forked the scale.

**Ruling: the frame's _window_ is density-invariant, and that is deliberate.** 60 units of height over 0.6 units per minute is **exactly 100 minutes at all three densities**. Density changes how big the frame is, never how much time it holds — so §3.4's window arithmetic and §3.9's "the neighbour is off-screen beyond ~25 minutes" hold everywhere without re-derivation. Only §3.11's touch geometry has to be re-derived, and it is, below.

**Ruling: the rulings of 2026-08-26 add no token — and the twelve comments of the same day add none either.** Not one `--sys-*`, not one `--staff-*`, across both passes.

⚠ **Re-cut 2026-08-26.** This paragraph used to spend itself on the service and people **tokens**, which are deleted. Everything it ruled survives, pointed at what actually ships:

- **The `Ден` pill** is `--sys-color-accent` at 12%, `--control-radius-capsule` ([tokens.css:101](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:101)) and `--control-size-small` ([tokens.css:66](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:66)) — six declarations, no token.
- **Field fills stay `--sys-color-fill`** ([tokens.css:137](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:137)) — translucent, systemFill parity, never an opaque surface. The pill is _accent-tinted_ precisely because it is a trigger and not a field; the two must not converge.
- **The height ladder** is `--control-size-small` / `-regular` / `-large` ([tokens.css:66](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:66), [:75](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:75), [:76](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:76)) under the same `max(…, 44px)` floor every other target on this sheet takes.
- **The inline calendar's segment** takes `ui-list-group`'s own half-unit seam ([list-group.css:8](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-group/list-group.css:8)) and the `--control-radius-subtle` / `--control-radius-prominent` pair already listed — that is what makes it read as part of the run rather than a panel dropped into it.
- **The pushed page** borrows motion and elevation that already exist (row above). **The consequence strip** is `--sys-color-tertiary-label`, nothing more.
- **Barber identity** stays `--sys-identity-0..4`, now on the frame's owner header rather than a token's rail.

**A new custom property for the pill, for the calendar segment, for the push or for the move means someone has found a token that already exists and not looked.**
