```
staff-sheet__pill             staff-sheet__consequence    staff-sheet__total
staff-frame                   staff-frame__gutter         staff-frame__column
staff-frame__owner            staff-frame__handle         staff-frame__body
staff-frame__readout          staff-frame__shoulder       staff-frame__neighbour
staff-frame__seam             staff-frame__clip           staff-frame__jump

data-dragging   data-moving    data-dirty     data-conflict   data-outside-roster
data-overridden data-locked="settled|partly|cancelled|denied|offline"
data-edge="start|end"          data-placement="slots|proportional"
data-tier="peek|compose"       data-total
```

**Deleted, 2026-08-26 (first pass):** `.staff-sheet__ghost-row` (the `⊕ Добави услуга` row was replaced by the field's own placeholder — and by the time the twelve comments landed, by a real `＋ Добави услуга` list row) · `.staff-sheet__service-rail` · `data-editor="frame|clock"` (there is no editor to switch) · `.staff-sheet__undo` (the inline undo row died with the ± nudge; undo is a toast in the shared `role="status"` region, §3.9 #13).

⚠ **Deleted, 2026-08-26 (the twelve comments):** `.staff-sheet__tokens` and `.staff-sheet__token-label` (**there is no token field**, Ruling C) · `data-token-kind="catalog|custom"` · `data-unresolved` · `data-ambiguous` (the three resolution states belonged to a token; a pushed search page has selected rows and a `Няма съвпадение` sentence instead) · `data-open` (nothing on this surface opens in place except the calendar, and that is `aria-expanded` on the pill, not a styling hook).

⚠ **Born the same day:** `.staff-sheet__pill` (the `Ден` trigger and the `Начало` input's wrapper — six declarations, no new token) · `.staff-sheet__consequence` (the pushed page's live `10:00 – 10:45 · Иван` line) · `.staff-frame__owner` (the frame's gutter header, comments 2 + 7).

**Q13 closes at net zero: three classes born, three deleted, and the count is unchanged at four.** It reads now as `.staff-sheet__disclosure`, `.staff-sheet__pill`, `.staff-sheet__consequence` and the `.staff-frame__*` family. `.staff-sheet__figures` and `.staff-sheet__time-field` were already counted, and `.staff-sheet__total` is a modifier of the first of those (`[data-total]`), not a fifth file. **A redesign that reverses three rulings and adds no net CSS is the strongest evidence available that the reversals were toward the system rather than away from it.**

**`staff-visit__field` is deleted from this list — it was a copy, and the standing ruling is REUSE, NEVER COPY.** `.staff-block__field` already exists ([staff-dashboard.css:934](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.css:934)) and already wraps precisely the labelled `input[uiTextField] type="time" step="300"` From/To pair ([staff-dashboard.html:1459-1484](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.html:1459)). **Ruling: rename `.staff-block__field` → `.staff-sheet__time-field`.** That rename rides along with `.staff-cancel__body` → `.staff-sheet__body` ([staff-dashboard.css:924](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.css:924)) — same file, same PR, one review. Q13's recommendation is superseded accordingly.

⚠ **Amended 2026-08-26 (Ruling B): the rename still happens, and it now has exactly one consumer instead of two.** `От`/`До` leaves the appointment sheet — the end time is derived and never stored — and stays in the **block sheet**, which has no catalogue, no services and no derivable length, and whose two edges are genuinely the two facts the barber holds in his head. **That is still not a copy**; it is a rename of the one file that owns the pair, done once, in the milestone that touches the markup anyway. **Say this out loud in the ADR or somebody will "harmonise" the two sheets and break the good one.**

⚠ **One place `ui-list-group`'s own rules do not reach.** `> :not(.ui-list-row) { display: contents }` ([list-group.css:27](../../libs/ui/patterns/src/lib/list-group/list-group.css:27)) and the outer-corner rules key on `.ui-list-row`, so a disclosure panel as a group child gets **no surface and no corners**. Six lines of feature CSS paint `--sys-color-surface-secondary`, subtle inner corners, and prominent bottom corners at `:last-child`. **If a second surface wants this, promote it to a `[uiListDisclosure]` slot contract. Not before.**

⚠ **Amended 2026-08-26: that gotcha survives with ONE consumer instead of three, and the line above is now more likely to stay unreached — which is the good outcome.** The token editor is gone (Ruling C) and the `Кога` region no longer discloses as a whole (comment 11), so **the only non-row child of a `ui-list-group` on this surface is the date calendar** (Ruling A): the relative chip row plus `ui-calendar-grid`, sitting as a _sibling segment of the same group_ so it inherits the half-unit seam and the inner/outer corner treatment for free. That is precisely why the calendar reads as part of the run and not as a panel dropped into it.

Everything else in the sheet stays what it is today: **zero bespoke CSS, 100% design-system primitives.** The frame, its handles and its draggable body are the only genuinely new pixels _in this feature_. ⚠ **The clause that used to follow — _"the token field's pixels are new too, but they live in `ui-token` and `[uiCombobox]`, in the design system, where `/book` inherits them"_ — is struck.** There is no token field here. The new design-system pixels this sheet now pays for are `ui-sheet-nav`'s, and every consumer of a modal sheet inherits those.

### i18n — namespace `staff.visit.*`

⚠ **Re-cut 2026-08-26 by the twelve comments. Every strikethrough, rename and `[new]` below is dated to that day**, and the three shapes of change are worth naming before the table so a reader can skim it:

- **Dies** — the key has no renderer left (`when`, `people`, `searchBarbers`, `done`, the five `token*` labels, `chair` as a row label).
- **Re-homed** — the string is unchanged, the surface moved (`chairValue` → the frame's owner header; `serviceLine` → the service row's second line; `searchServices` / `resultCount` / `suggestionsLabel` → the pushed search page).
- **Born** — a new surface needs a new string (the static title, the summary strip, the duration ladder, the promo page, the three `＋ Добави…` rows).

**Renames are renames, not new keys.** `tokenAdded` → `serviceAdded`, `tokenRemoved` → `serviceRemoved`, `tokenNoMatch` → `noMatch`, `tokenValueOverridden` → `priceOverridden`, `tokenCustom` → `customService`, `addPerson` → `addClient`. Same Bulgarian, same English, one word of the key. A key that still says `token` after 2026-08-26 is a key nobody renamed.

`bg` is the source of truth. Every existing `staff.day.visit*` key **moves here**; four of the five orphans (`visitOpen`, `visitService`, `visitArrived`, `visitDuration`) finally bind, and the fifth — `visitWhen` — is **replaced rather than bound**, because comment 11 deletes every visible section title and comment 5 deletes the `Кога` summary row, so nothing renders it. That is the same treatment `visitArrived` already got, one milestone earlier. `staff.day.act.*`, `staff.day.cancel*`, `staff.day.block*`, `appointments.status.*` stay where they are. Both catalogues stay at exact parity. Plurals go through the existing `pluralOf(count)` → `Intl.PluralRules` pattern ([staff-dashboard.ts:628](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.ts:628), [plural-form.ts](../../libs/infrastructure/i18n/src/lib/plural-form.ts)) — **no MessageFormat plugin.**

**Every money string in this table comes from `formatMoney(money, locale)`** ([format-money.ts:18](../../libs/domain/kernel/src/lib/format-money.ts:18)) — the locale is a required second argument, and the staff dashboard already passes `transloco.getActiveLang()` ([staff-dashboard.ts:1504](../../libs/features/staff/dashboard/src/lib/staff-dashboard/staff-dashboard.ts:1504)). That tag is the bare `'bg'` / `'en'` from `LanguageService.activeLang` ([language.service.ts:35](../../libs/features/shared/shell/src/lib/language.service.ts:35)), not `bg-BG`. **So `28,00 €` in every example below is the `bg` rendering; the same `Money` renders `€28.00` under `en`.** Fraction digits come from the currency, never from the caller. No component in this sheet builds a price string by hand.

| Key                                                                                  | Bulgarian                                                                                                                                      | English gloss                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

#### Compose-time validation copy — never a saved state

One key was in the money block and does not belong there.

| Key          | Bulgarian                       | Where it renders                                                        |
| ------------ | ------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `moneyMixed` | Различни валути — не се сумира. | **The compose tier only, as a save-blocker.** Never the money read-out. |

**Ruling: `moneyMixed` describes a draft, not an appointment.** `validateSeats` rejects a mixed-currency appointment at construction with `AppointmentMixedCurrencyError` ([appointment.ts:310](../../libs/domain/scheduling/src/lib/appointment.ts:310)), which is exactly why `subtotal()` can throw `'unreachable: mixed currency'` ([appointment.ts:370](../../libs/domain/scheduling/src/lib/appointment.ts:370)) instead of returning a `Result`. **A saved appointment cannot hold two currencies, so the money block can never render this sentence.** The unsaved draft can — briefly, if a service priced in another currency enters the cart — and the honest place for the copy is beside the disabled `Запази`, as the reason in the label. With EUR as the only currency in the catalogue this is a guard against a future, not a state a barber will meet this year. It stays because the server refusal `mixed_currency` needs a client-side twin; it does not stay in the money block.

### Errors — namespace `errors.booking.staffEdit.*`

**Mandatory**, because `translateDomainError` is the render path for every refusal and an unlisted key renders as the raw code.

**The mapping convention, stated rather than implied.** `translateDomainError` computes the key as `` `errors.${error.code}` `` ([translate-domain-error.ts:29](../../libs/infrastructure/i18n/src/lib/translate-domain-error.ts:29)) and falls back to the bare code string when the catalogue misses. So a callable throwing `code: 'booking.staffEdit.conflict'` renders `errors.booking.staffEdit.conflict`, and **`booking.staffEdit.X` → `errors.booking.staffEdit.X` is the whole rule.** No registry, no switch, no adapter.

**The catalogue holds a nested `errors.booking` group with `flow.*` and `waitlist.*`, _plus_ flat dotted keys at the `errors` root** — `booking.gateway.failed`, twelve `booking.commit.*`, `booking.cancel.window_closed`, four `booking.contact.*` and five `booking.transition.*` — all of which resolve as `errors.booking.*` through Transloco's flattening. `errors.booking.staffEdit.*` is a new namespace beside them, in both `bg` and `en`.

⚠ **And the existing appointment callables never reach `translateDomainError` at all.** `transitionAppointment` throws `booking.transition.unauthenticated` ([transition-appointment.ts:106](../../apps/functions/src/lib/booking/transition-appointment.ts:106)), `cancelAppointment` throws `booking.cancel.not_found` ([cancel-appointment.ts:58](../../apps/functions/src/lib/booking/cancel-appointment.ts:58)) and `booking.cancel.window_closed` ([cancel-appointment.ts:99](../../apps/functions/src/lib/booking/cancel-appointment.ts:99)), `markArrived` throws `booking.arrived.forbidden` ([mark-arrived.ts:47](../../apps/functions/src/lib/booking/mark-arrived.ts:47)) — and every one of them is collapsed by `CallableBookingGateway` into a coarse `failure` bucket ([booking-gateway.adapter.ts:45-85](../../libs/infrastructure/firestore/src/lib/booking-gateway.adapter.ts:45)), where `booking.cancel.window_closed` and `booking.arrived.not_allowed` become the same `invalid_request`. **Ruling: `staffEdit` skips that taxonomy.** The staff sheet calls `translateFunctionsError` directly on the callable's `details.code`, so every refusal keeps its own sentence in the region that earned it. A coarse bucket is right for a client who can only retry; it is wrong for a barber who can fix the thing the server objected to.

| Code                                    | Key                                        | Bulgarian                                                   | Status                                                          |
| --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `booking.staffEdit.unauthenticated`     | `errors.booking.staffEdit.unauthenticated` | Сесията е изтекла. Влез отново.                             | **new**                                                         |
| `booking.staffEdit.not_found`           | `…not_found`                               | Часът вече го няма.                                         | **new**                                                         |
| `booking.staffEdit.invalid_input`       | `…invalid_input`                           | Тази промяна не е валидна.                                  | **new**                                                         |
| `booking.staffEdit.min_duration`        | `…min_duration`                            | Часът трябва да е поне {{minutes}} мин.                     | **new**                                                         |
| `booking.staffEdit.mixed_currency`      | `…mixed_currency`                          | Услугите са в различни валути.                              | **new**                                                         |
| `booking.staffEdit.conflict`            | `…conflict`                                | Времето вече е заето от друг час.                           | **new**                                                         |
| `booking.staffEdit.outside_window`      | `…outside_window`                          | Извън работното време на бръснаря.                          | **new**                                                         |
| `booking.staffEdit.resolved_seat`       | `…resolved_seat`                           | Часът вече е започнал и не може да се мести.                | **new**                                                         |
| `booking.staffEdit.not_staff`           | `…not_staff`                               | Нямаш право да променяш този час.                           | **new**                                                         |
| `booking.staffEdit.service_not_offered` | `…service_not_offered`                     | {{barber}} не прави тази услуга.                            | **new**                                                         |
| `booking.staffEdit.stale`               | `…stale`                                   | Часът е променен другаде. Презареди.                        | **new**                                                         |
| `booking.staffEdit.no_services`         | `…no_services`                             | Часът трябва да има поне една услуга.                       | **new**                                                         |
| `booking.staffEdit.before_arrival`      | `…before_arrival`                          | Клиентът вече е дошъл — часът не може да свърши преди това. | **new** — the server twin of the `beforeArrival` clamp (§3.4.5) |

The first five are the refusals every write callable in this codebase already throws in some form and `staffEdit` will inevitably throw too — omitting them is how a barber ends up staring at the literal string `booking.staffEdit.not_found` on a phone.

⚠ **One code that must NOT be added, 2026-08-26 (Ruling B): `booking.staffEdit.invalid_range`.** With duration as the stored fact and the end derived, **`До ≤ От` is unrepresentable** — a non-negative duration has no invalid state, and the ladder's sub-floor rows are _disabled_, not validated. NN/g's _“remove illogical date options”_ and Nielsen #5 are satisfied **by construction**, which is strictly better than by validation. Writing the error key anyway would be documenting a refusal the server can never issue, and the next person to read the catalogue would go looking for the control that produces it. `min_duration` is the only length refusal, and it is already above.

### One live copy bug this redesign forces

`staff.day.act.confirmed` = **«Дойде»** and `staff.day.act.arrived` = **«Дойде»** — verified in `bg.json`. Two different edges render the identical word. Today they never appear together; the redesign puts the verb beside the status, which makes it visible. **Fix: `act.confirmed` → «Потвърди».** One line.

The guarantee is unchanged and cheaper: **nobody is ever one blind `Enter` from a destructive verb**, and the strip carries three facts where the title carried one                                                                                  | —                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

The root page goes `inert`, keeps its scroll offset and its rendered frame                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `‹` pops · leading-edge swipe pops · `Esc` pops the child and only at root closes the sheet · **browser Back pops the child**, because a history entry is pushed and this _is_ navigation · a swipe-down on a child **pops to root, it does not close the sheet** — the sheet's dismiss gesture is suspended while a child is presented, per the HIG's _“Back… is not intended to dismiss a sheet”_                                                                                                                                                                                         | on push, focus moves to the **child container** (`tabindex="-1"`, labelled by its title) — **not** the first control, so a price field cannot steal a keyboard on entry. **Ruling: the touch floor is a literal 44px, never `--control-size-regular`.** `--control-size-regular` is `calc(var(--sys-space-unit) * 11)` ([tokens.css:75](../../libs/ui/tokens/tokens.css:75)), which is **40.5px at `data-density="compact"`** — under the HIG floor the table above claims everywhere. Every hit target in this sheet therefore takes `min-block-size: max(var(--control-size-regular), 44px)` and `--control-size-large` gets the same treatment against 52. Density scales the ink; it does not shrink the thumb. The alternative — pinning the sheet to `data-density="regular"` — was rejected: a barber who chose compact chose it for a reason, and the reason is fitting more of the day on screen, not smaller buttons.

**Ruling: re-derived at 0.92, because compact is the worst case.** The frame runs at 2.21px/min at compact density, so:

|                                                                    | compact (0.92) | regular (1.0) | spacious (1.08) |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------- | ------------- | --------------- |
| Block height for a **full 44px** hit per handle (`h ≥ 44px`)       | **20 min**     | 19 min        | 17 min          |
| Block height for **two 44px hits that never overlap** (`h ≥ 88px`) | **40 min**     | 37 min        | 34 min          |

Q3's "below 37 minutes the handles fall under 44pt" is the regular-density figure. **The number to design against is 40**, and it now carries a second job: **40 minutes of block (88px at compact) is also the body-drag suppression floor**, because two non-overlapping 44px handles and a draggable body need exactly the same height. Below it the two handles share their clearance, `min(44px, h/2 + 22px)` starts giving ground and the body stops being draggable at all; below 20 minutes neither handle reaches 44 either. A 15-minute leg is under the floor at every density, which is precisely why the typed rows are not a convenience — **they are the only guaranteed path to a short appointment's edges, and below 88px of block they are the only path to moving it at all.** They may never be hidden behind the frame, behind a disclosure, behind a preference or behind a width breakpoint: **SC 2.5.7 Dragging Movements is satisfied by their permanent presence**, and any proposal to collapse them is a conformance regression before it is a taste question (§3.5).

⚠ **Re-pointed 2026-08-26, and the clause survives verbatim.** The typed path is now **`Начало` + `Времетраене`**, not `От`/`До` (Ruling B), and it sits **beneath** the frame rather than above it (comment 9). Neither change touches the conformance argument: 2.5.7 requires the non-drag alternative to exist, not to come first, and a duration menu is _more_ reachable than a second time field, not less. What the re-order did dissolve is the _occlusion_ reason the old ordering also carried — there is no keypad-raising field left in this region at all, because `Начало` raises the platform's own picker and `Времетраене` is a menu.

**Every hover affordance introduced here carries an ungated `:active` mirror; hover styling is `@media (hover: hover)`-gated.** That is the standing ruling and it covers, specifically: the frame handle (`data-dragging` is a drag state, not a press state — the handle needs both), **the block body** (`data-moving` is likewise not a press state), **the `Ден` pill**, **the day cells** (`button[uiDay] uiInteractive`), **every `button[uiListRow]` that pushes** — services, clients, `Промоция`, `＋ Добави…`, and the destructive rows — the search pages' result rows, the add-on chips, the chair-verdict menu items, and the `⋯` trigger. ⚠ **Re-cut 2026-08-26:** the sentence this paragraph used to end on — _“on the token there is no hover-revealed affordance at any point; the `✕` and the `⌄` are permanently drawn”_ — is superseded by something stronger. **There is no hover-revealed affordance anywhere on this surface**, because there is no glyph whose presence is conditional: every row that travels draws `›` at rest, and every row that drops a menu draws `⌄` at rest. A phone has no hover, and a barber who taps and sees nothing taps again.

**Glyph discipline is load-bearing, and it is an accessibility contract before it is a visual one.** `⌄` (`field.expand`) = **a menu drops here, or a picker expands here**. `›` (`nav.disclosure`) = **you go somewhere and come back.** Nothing = the value is the control. Users learn in one tap which rows travel — and screen-reader users get the same distinction for free, because one shape carries `aria-expanded` and the other deliberately does not.

**Colour is never alone, anywhere.** Status = tone + word. Conflict = destructive ink + ⚠ glyph + a sentence. Outside-roster = warning tone + hatch + footnote. Padding = 45° hatch at 10% + a label. Barber identity = rail hue + the name in the meta line. Neighbour = 7% tone + outline. **Hue carries the category; pattern carries the certainty.**

**Focus rings via `:focus-visible` only**, never bare `:focus`. ⚠ Verify the frame's handle rings are not clipped — `outline` is not clipped by `overflow` on the same element, but the 2px ring plus 2px offset must be checked against `.staff-frame__clip`.

**Live regions: exactly three in the whole surface, and still three after both passes of 2026-08-26.** One `role="status"` for commits, drops, **the body-drag's moves** and drag cancellations; one `role="alert"` for refusals; one `aria-live="polite"` for search results and value-plus-consequence announcements — carrying `resultCount`, `serviceAdded`, `serviceRemoved` and the duration menu's _“Времетраене 30 минути. Край 10:30.”_ alike. The sliders need none, the block borrows the frame's rather than opening a fourth, **and the pushed pages open none at all**: a push announces itself through the focus move and a pop through the row's own updated accessible name. **Navigation is the cheapest accessibility mechanism on this sheet, which is the argument Ruling C rests on.**

**No `div[role="button"][tabindex="0"]` anywhere**, including the frame's blocks and handles.

**`aria-grabbed` / `aria-dropeffect` are not used** — deprecated in ARIA 1.1+.

**Announce on drop, not on every pixel.** Continuous 5-minute announcements would flood a screen reader; the slider's `aria-valuetext` handles keyboard stepping natively and the pointer drag announces once on release — or once on cancel. **The body-drag obeys the same rule**: once on drop, once per keyboard step, in the same region. And the shapes differ on purpose — a move names both endpoints and the unchanged duration, a resize names **one** endpoint, because announcing both times after a resize hides the thing that actually changed.

**The add-on heuristic, written against real code.** The earlier formulation named `Service.upsellsFor`, which **does not exist anywhere in the repo** and is M9's work. What does exist, and is enough for the interim:

- `Service.upsellOnly: boolean` — a real constructor property on the domain entity ([service.ts:116](../../libs/domain/catalog/src/lib/service.ts:116)), not merely VM data; the VM reads it straight through ([catalog-to-vm.ts:105](../../libs/features/shared/catalog/src/lib/content/catalog-to-vm.ts:105)).
- `Service.categoryId: ServiceCategoryId` ([service.ts:108](../../libs/domain/catalog/src/lib/service.ts:108)).
- `conflictingWith(selection, candidate, catalog)` ([service-conflicts.ts:102](../../libs/domain/catalog/src/lib/service-conflicts.ts:102)), built on `servicesConflict(a, b, catalog)` ([service-conflicts.ts:68](../../libs/domain/catalog/src/lib/service-conflicts.ts:68)) — both exported from the catalog barrel ([index.ts:22](../../libs/domain/catalog/src/index.ts:22)).

So the chip strip is: _services where `upsellOnly` is true, whose `categoryId` matches the anchor leg's, and for which `conflictingWith(seatSelection, candidate, catalog)` is empty._ Use `conflictingWith`, not a hand-rolled pairwise loop — its signature already scopes the check to **one seat**, which is the standing ruling a call site would otherwise have to remember. **The heuristic is a stopgap and says so in the code comment**; the authored relation replaces it in M9 and the chip strip's inputs do not change when it does.

# Part 4 — Delivery plan

## 4.1 Milestones

Each is independently valuable and independently shippable.

**The boundary that is not negotiable is M1 → M2.** M0 and M1 touch no server: M0 repairs data and layout truths, M1 renders facts the view model already computes and throws away. Every _write_ affordance on this surface — the add-on chips, the running-late chips, the chair-move menu, the typed time editor, the frame — waits for `staffEditAppointment` (**new callable**, M2). An earlier draft of this plan put the add-on chips and a `±5` nudge row inside M1, the nudge _"rendered disabled behind `staff.day.notBuiltYet`"_. That was wrong three times over: it violates §3.8's honesty gate, Q6 (_"a live-looking switch over a dead channel is worse than a sentence"_) and §3.9 #12 (_"a row that is absent is honest; a row that is **disabled** is a promise"_). **The nudge itself is now gone entirely** — the owner deleted the `±` pair on 2026-08-26 and the block body drags instead (§3.4.9) — and the chips that replaced it are in M2, because a chip that seeds a draft is worth nothing until something can commit the draft. The claim that "everything after M1 depends on the callable" was false while M1 itself depended on it; with the chips moved, M1 is genuinely server-free and the sentence is true again.

**Standing definition of done, every milestone.** Every new interactive surface named below — the frame handles, **the draggable block body**, the `Ден` pill and its day cells, **every `button[uiListRow]` that pushes a page** (services, clients, `Промоция`, the `＋ Добави…` rows, the destructive rows), the search pages' result rows, the add-on chips, the buttons in the docked bar — ships an **ungated `:active` mirror** of its hover affordance, with the hover styling itself inside `@media (hover: hover)`. A phone has no hover; a tap that produces no visible press reads as a dropped tap. `data-dragging` (**new attribute**) is a drag state, not a press state, and does not discharge this. This is not a polish pass at the end of M9.

- **The running-late pill — its READ half only.** `Закъснява 8 мин` as status text, computed from the clock. ⚠ The `+10 / +15 / +20` chips beside it in §3.3.9 each _move the appointment_, and after the 2026-08-26 rulings a move seeds a draft that only `Запази` can commit: they go to M2 as item 2.12.

### M3 · Compose without the frame

The appointment-keyed editor view model (**first**, and validated against a two-barber-party fixture — `toRow` filters seats to one barber, and the staff-edit payload replaces _all_ seats, so a sheet that can only see one barber's legs **drops the other's on the first save**). The draft store with `dirty` × `stale`. `uiDismissGuard` (**new directive**) on `ui-modal-sheet`. `Начало` with native `min`/`max` and the `Времетраене` ladder menu. `Ден` with its inline calendar. The staff note as an on-demand reveal. The honesty line. The destructive group. The stale banner. Save / discard / undo.

⚠ **M3 gains one hard dependency and loses a field pair, 2026-08-26.**

**Gains `ui-sheet-nav` (§3.12).** M5, M6, M7 and M8 all push pages, so the pattern component cannot be later than the first milestone that ships a real editor — and M3's own minimal create (3.6) already wants the add-service page. Building the stack once, here, is what keeps depth at exactly one everywhere.

**Loses `От`/`До` and its four validation signals** (Ruling B): `draftEndValue`, `endMinAttr` / `endMaxAttr`, `endInvalid` and the `commitTyped('end', …)` arm all go, and `draftEndMinute` becomes a `computed()` that **is no longer writable anywhere**. What replaces them is one `input[type=time]` and one `ui-menu` of ≤8 rows.

**And `Ден` gains its calendar** (Ruling A): `ui-calendar-grid uiSize="regular"` inline, as a sibling segment of the same `ui-list-group`, with the nested date-picker sheet deleted.

**3.6 · The minimal walk-in — hoisted here, deliberately.** Owner ask #8 is _"add or edit, as fast as possible"_, and in the plan as first drafted the **add** half did not appear until M6, the seventh milestone. Half an ask deferred past six milestones is a dropped ask wearing a schedule. **Recommendation: hoist a minimal create into M3** — one guest seat, one service, `Сега`, this chair, no party, no kind switch. Everything richer stays in M6. (There is no picker sheet left to exclude: after 2026-08-26 adding a service is **a pushed page inside this sheet's own nav stack**, and M3's minimal create simply does not ship it yet. ⚠ **But `ui-sheet-nav` itself is in M3 regardless** — 3.6 wants the add-service page the moment it exists, which is one more reason the component cannot be later.)

This is not free, and the cost is named: it drags the walk-in blocker (M6's 6.1 below) forward with it — `ownerUserId` must become nullable through `CommitBookingUseCase` → `decideBooking` → `toSubject`, plus a staff-attributed `createdByUserId`, an **M** on its own. It also cannot start until **Q17** is answered, because who owns a staff-created walk-in changes the shape of the create payload. If the owner would rather not pay that in M3, then the alternative must be stated out loud rather than left implicit: **editing ships first by design, because every existing booking is already an object staff cannot move, and repairing that is worth more per week than shortening a path that today runs through `/book` and works.** Pick one, in writing.

⚠ **One thing M3's time region is not.** It is the typed rows **alone** — and that is the frame **not existing yet**, not a "clock mode". There is no mode: the frame joins in M4, with no toggle in between and nothing to remember per device.

The frame arrives in M4 as a **second, redundant editor of the same three values**, which is exactly the relationship a direct-manipulation surface should have to a typed one. And per comment 9 it arrives **above** them, not below.

**Value:** typed rescheduling, a second note, a sheet that cannot lose your work — and, with 3.6, the first appointment ever created from behind the counter.
